raw.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (f/m/d)
raw.description:
About Valova

We are building the AI operations platform for European hospitals, so every clinician can focus on patients.

Behind every patient sits a chain of admin work: documentation, coding, billing, audits, scheduling. It runs through disconnected systems and endless manual hand-offs, while most German hospitals already operate at a loss.

We start where the impact is measurable from day one: case to cash. Valova codes every case, defends it in audits and makes sure the money lands. From there we take on every workflow that runs a hospital, until one agentic system handles the routine and people decide the exceptions. First Germany, then Europe.

Doctors, engineers and operators, on-site in Munich and Berlin. Join us!

Why this role matters

Valova only works as well as it fits into the hospital. Our product creates the most value when it’s deeply connected to a hospital’s systems and built around how coders and medical controlling actually work. Today, connecting to a hospital information system can take months. That’s time hospitals keep losing revenue and coders keep working by hand.

That’s where you come in. As Forward Deployed Engineer, you own technical go-lives from start to finish: from the first sandbox to production, from the interface to the workflow on the ward. You’re the bridge between hospital IT, the people who use Valova and our engineering team.

Your impact is easy to see: in hospitals that go live faster, in integrations that run reliably, and in a product that gets better with every deployment because you bring back what you learn.

This is a hands-on engineering role with real code in production and direct influence on our roadmap. It’s not a support desk, not a pre-sales role and not project management where others do the building. And it’s not a desk job: you’ll regularly be on site in hospitals

How the role sits in the team

You report directly to Christian, our CTO, and work day to day with our engineering team on connectors, deployments and internal tooling. With Malte and our product team, you turn what you see in hospitals into clear requirements. In hospital projects, you work hand in hand with our customer success and sales team and on the hospital side with IT leads, KIS vendors, coders and medical controlling.

What you will do

  • Bring hospitals live: You take hospitals from sandbox to production, deploy Valova on hospital VMs and connect it to KIS systems such as SAP i.s.h.med, Orbis or Dedalus.

  • Build the connections: You build and maintain interfaces (HL7, FHIR, archive and document exports) together with hospital IT and their partners.

  • Set up Valova for each customer: You configure document types, case filtering, department rules and coding workflows.

  • Learn from the ward: You work on site with coders and medical controlling and turn their friction into clear product requirements.

  • Make deployments repeatable: You write the code that makes the next go-live faster: connectors, scripts, monitoring and internal tooling.

  • Earn the hospital’s trust: You answer technical questions in security and data protection reviews (BSI C5, GDPR).

What we are looking for:

  • Engineering experience: At least two years in software engineering, and you’re comfortable with Linux, Docker and basic networking.

  • Integration know-how: You’ve worked on system integrations. Experience with HL7/FHIR or SAP environments is a big plus.

  • Customer focus: You enjoy working with customers and explain technical topics clearly to IT leads and coders alike.

  • High ownership: You move things forward, even when three parties are involved.

  • Travel: You’re happy to spend around 30 percent of your time at hospitals across Germany.

  • Languages: You speak fluent German and English, since our customers work in German.

  • Location: You work from our office in Munich or Berlin.

Missing one or two points, but convinced you’re the right person for this role? Apply anyway. We’re looking forward to meeting you!

What you get

  • Work that means something, every day. Your agents are the core of our product and directly help improve the German healthcare system.

  • Ownership from week one. You take over real projects with a clear outcome and your name on it, not a list of tasks someone else defined.

  • Direct access to the founders. You work day to day with our founders Sophia, a physician and ex-McKinsey consultant, and Christian, who has founded two health tech startups and spent a decade building clinical systems. No layers, no waiting weeks for approvals.

  • Trust and freedom. We trust you to solve problems your way, and the team has your back 100%.

  • Learning at startup speed. You will see more in one year here than in three years elsewhere, across models, infrastructure, product and customers, with a team that has a proven track record of deploying AI in healthcare.

  • One team, in the heart of the city. We work together on-site at WeWork Odeonsplatz in Munich and WeWork in central Berlin. Fully serviced offices with coffee, meeting rooms and phone booths mean zero admin, and the city-center location means short commutes, easy access to customers and investors, and lunch spots around every corner.

  • Team events that bring Munich and Berlin together, because the people you build with should also be the people you celebrate with.

What success looks like

  • After 3 months, you know Valova’s stack inside out and have taken a hospital through its first technical setup together with our team.

  • After 6 months, you’ve taken at least two hospitals live, and a new KIS connection takes weeks instead of months.

  • After 12 months, our deployments are largely repeatable: connectors, scripts and monitoring you built make every go-live faster.

  • Throughout, what you learn in hospitals shapes our roadmap, and hospital IT teams see you as their trusted contact at Valova.

How it works

Just upload your CV with your application. We’ll get in touch with you for the next steps:

  1. Intro call (30 min): We get to know each other, talk about your background and answer your first questions.

  2. Technical interview with Christian (CTO) (60 min): We dive into your engineering experience and the integrations you’ve built.

  3. Case: You work through a realistic hospital integration scenario and present it to the team.

  4. References: We speak with two or three people you’ve worked with, such as former managers or colleagues.

  5. Meet the team: You spend a day with us on-site in Munich or Berlin, meet our founders Sophia and Christian and see how we work day to day.

  6. Offer: If it’s a match for both sides, you’ll hear from us quickly.

We look forward to your application, regardless of gender, background, religion, disability, age or sexual identity.

Deine Mission

Wir suchen Dich als Test Engineer (m/w/d) am Standort Berlin (hybrid).

Deine Aufgaben dabei sind:

  • Du entwickelst und baust neue Hardware-in-the-Loop-(HiL)-Testumgebungen für die Integration und den Test von Software auf
  • Testframeworks zur Automatisierung von Testprozeduren entwickelst du kontinuierlich weiter
  • Die Konzeption und Implementierung von CI/CD-Pipelines mit GitLab CI/CD gehört zu deinen Aufgaben
  • In enger Abstimmung mit Hardware- und Softwareentwicklern integrierst du einzelne Komponenten und Module zu vollständigen Flugfunkgeräten
  • Gemeinsam mit Hardware- und Softwareteams führst du Fehlersuchen und Root-Cause-Analysen durch
  • Testfälle definierst du, erstellst Testprozeduren und wertest Testergebnisse aus. Die Ergebnisse dokumentierst du in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Hardware- und Softwareteams
  • Messgeräte wie Oszilloskope, Signalgeneratoren oder Spektrumanalysatoren bindest du an Testumgebungen an und automatisierst deren Einsatz

Dein Profil

Folgende Kenntnisse und Fähigkeiten solltest Du auf jeden Fall mitbringen:

  • Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Elektrotechnik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
  • Erfahrung in der hardwarenahen Softwareentwicklung sowie im Testen komplexer Systeme (z. B. Mikrocontroller, SoCs oder RF-/Funktechnik), idealerweise im militärischen oder sicherheitskritischen Umfeld, bringst du mit
  • Im Bereich Mobilfunk, insbesondere Datenübertragung, Netzwerke und ISO/OSI-Referenzmodell, verfügst du über fundierte Kenntnisse
  • Idealerweise konntest du bereits Erfahrungen in der Testautomatisierung sowie in der Entwicklung von Testframeworks sammeln
  • Fundierte Erfahrung im Aufbau von CI/CD-Pipelines mit GitLab CI/CD sowie Kenntnisse in Container-Technologien (z. B. Docker oder Podman) zeichnen dich ausGute Programmierkenntnisse in C/C++ sowie Erfahrung mit CMake runden dein Profil ab
  • Mit Linux und Versionsverwaltungssystemen wie Git gehst du sicher um
  • Für die effektive Kommunikation im Projektumfeld sowie mit unseren deutschsprachigen Kunden ist ein sehr gutes mündliches und schriftliches Deutsch erforderlich.

Das bieten wir Dir

Wir sind der Überzeugung, dass folgende Rahmenbedingungen die besten Voraussetzungen für Effizienz und kreative Lösungsfindungen bieten:

  • Aktives Mitwirken an innovativen Zukunftstechnologien
  • Flexibles New-Work-Modell mit hybriden Arbeitsmöglichkeiten
  • Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag
  • Givve-Card als steuerfreier Unternehmensbenefit
  • Maximale Entscheidungs- und Gestaltungsspielräume
  • Individuelle Karriereplanung und Entwicklungsperspektiven
  • Wissenstransfer und Synergieeffekte durch ein starkes Team
  • Technologische Vielfalt mit spannenden Einblicken in sicherheitsrelevante Systeme

Und: Herausforderungen, die wirklich Spaß machen!

title: Consultant (m/w/d) SAP Data Engineering & Databricks
description: Seit über 25 Jahren verwandeln wir bei der Windhoff Group Daten in echte Geschäftschancen – von klassischer Business Intelligence bis zur KI-getriebenen Automatisierung. Dabei denken wir ganzheitlich: Wir begleiten unsere Kunden End-to-End, von der Strategie über die technische Umsetzung bis zum produktiven Betrieb. Ob BI-Reporting, Data Warehousing, Predictive Analytics oder KI-Lösungen – unser Anspruch ist es, aus Daten messbaren Mehrwert zu machen. Als Teil unseres Teams wirst du gemeinsam mit erfahrenen Kolleg:innen an anspruchsvollen Projekten arbeiten und dich in der gesamten Data & AI-Landschaft in die Richtung weiterentwickeln, die zu dir passt. Warum solltest du jetzt bei Windhoff starten? Windhoff wird in der aktuellen Lünendonk®-Studie 2025/2026 explizit als einer der 20 führenden Anbieter von Data & AI Services in Deutschland genannt. Getragen wird unser Wachstum von unserem Gesellschafter Aurelius, einem globalen Private-Equity-Investor, der seit 2023 an der Windhoff Group beteiligt ist. Unser SAP-Kerngeschäft bauen wir dabei gezielt zu einer Multi-Vendor-Strategie aus – mit Databricks, Snowflake, Dremio sowie den Cloud-Plattformen Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud und AWS (u. a. Amazon Athena). Du profitierst von einem Marktumfeld, das deutlich stärker wächst als der klassische IT-Dienstleistungsmarkt – und von einem Unternehmen, das dieses Wachstum aktiv mitgestaltet, statt nur zu verwalten. Neben unserer fachlichen Expertise sind wir ein Arbeitgeber, der Vielfalt fördert und sicherstellt, dass alle Mitarbeitenden fair behandelt werden. Teile uns mit, wenn wir auf etwas besonders Rücksicht nehmen sollen - wie zum Beispiel auf bestimmte Arbeitszeiten oder andere Rahmenbedingungen, deine Situation im Privatleben oder besondere Bedürfnisse bei der Arbeit. Klingt nach einem Traumjob? Dann jetzt Teil des Teams werden! Aufgaben Du analysierst die fachlichen und technischen Anforderungen unserer Kunden und setzt sie in Data-Engineering-Lösungen um, je nach Projekt auf Basis des SAP-Portfolios (SAP BW/4HANA, SAP Datasphere, SAP Business Data Cloud) oder mit Databricks. Du entwirfst skalierbare Lakehouse-Architekturen und entwickelst Datenplattformen, die zuverlässig, performant und wirtschaftlich nutzbar sind. Du konzipierst und implementierst Datenmodelle sowie ETL-/ELT-Strecken, häufig in hybriden Szenarien, in denen SAP mit Databricks, Snowflake, Dremio und den gängigen Cloud-Plattformen zusammenspielt. Du begleitest deine Projekte von der Anforderungsaufnahme über Konzeption und Implementierung bis zum Test und zur Übergabe in den Echtbetrieb beim Kunden. Je nach Karrierestufe übernimmst du die Verantwortung für Teilprojekte oder ganze Projekte und für das Windhoff Projektteam. Als Lead Consultant entwickelst du außerdem deine KollegInnen fachlich weiter. Du baust unseren Databricks-Fachbereich mit auf und gestaltest unsere Multi-Vendor-Strategie mit SAP als Kern aktiv mit. Durch Wissenstransfer, Projektpräsentationen und interne wie externe Technologie-Events gibst du dein Wissen an KollegInnen weiter. Qualifikation Du hast relevante Berufserfahrung im SAP Data Engineering oder mit Databricks, zum Beispiel als SAP Data Engineer, SAP BW Consultant, SAP Datasphere Consultant oder Data Engineer. Du kennst dich mit SAP Datasphere und dem Databricks Lakehouse aus, beherrschst SQL-Script und Python sicher und hast ETL-/ELT-Prozesse bereits erfolgreich umgesetzt. Erfahrung mit Delta Lake, der Medallion-Architektur und Databricks Workflows ist von Vorteil. Snowflake, Dremio sowie die Cloud-Plattformen Microsoft Azure und AWS sind für dich kein Fremdkörper, sondern Teil einer ganzheitlichen Dateninfrastruktur. Kenntnisse in ABAP und in Frontend-Tools wie SAP Analysis for Office und der SAP Analytics Cloud sind gerne gesehen und runden dein Profil ab. Du arbeitest analytisch und lösungsorientiert und berätst deine Kunden technisch wie fachlich auf Augenhöhe. Durch deine hohe Eigeninitiative und sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit bringst du deine Ideen sowohl intern als auch bei unseren Kunden erfolgreich ein. Dabei übernimmst du gerne Verantwortung, auch über die reine Umsetzung hinaus. Hierfür sind auch verhandlungssichere Deutsch- (C1-Niveau) und gute Englischkenntnisse (mindestens B2-Niveau) erforderlich. Deine Perspektive Bei uns steigst du auf der Stufe ein, die zu deiner Erfahrung passt. Von dort aus entwickelst du dich weiter: Als Consultant arbeitest du in unseren Projektteams mit und verantwortest eigene Arbeitspakete. So lernst du die Data-Engineering-Welt rund um SAP und Databricks in echten Kundenprojekten kennen. Als Senior Consultant verantwortest du Teilprojekte oder ganze Projekte und leitest das Windhoff Projektteam. Du bist für unsere Kunden die zentrale fachliche Ansprechperson. Als Lead Consultant verantwortest du mehrere Projekte und Projektteams und entwickelst deine KollegInnen fachlich weiter. Außerdem baust du unseren Databricks-Fachbereich aktiv mit auf. Als Principal übernimmst du die Verantwortung für Kundenbeziehungen und prägst unsere technologische Ausrichtung und unsere Multi-Vendor-Strategie mit. Benefits Wir stellen standortunabhängig ein. Du kannst – je nach Projekt – zu 90 % von zuhause aus oder an einem unserer Standorte arbeiten, wenn dieser für dich gut erreichbar ist. Zu gelegentlichen Kundenterminen und Teamevents startest du von deinem Lebensmittelpunkt aus, egal wo in Deutschland du wohnst. title: MD-Expert:in (m/w/d) – Prüfmanagement
description: Über Valova Wir entwickeln KI-Software für Krankenhäuser , die administrative Prozesse in Dokumentation, Kodierung und Abrechnung automatisiert. Damit entlasten wir Klinikteams, sichern Erlöse und schaffen mehr Zeit für Patient. Unser ambitioniertes Team aus Medizin, Technologie und Business arbeitet daran, die Krankenhausverwaltung nachhaltig zu verändern. Warum diese Rolle zählt In der MD-Prüfung werden Erlöse gesichert oder verloren. Jede verpasste Frist, jede fehlende Unterlage und jede schwache Begründung kostet Kliniken Geld, das sie längst erwirtschaftet haben, und ab 2027 steigen die Prüfquoten deutlich. Valova ist gebaut, um das zu ändern, aber nur, wenn unsere Software MD-Prüfungen so gut versteht wie die besten Expert:innen auf beiden Seiten des Tisches. Genau hier kommst Du ins Spiel. Als unsere MD-Expertin bzw. unser MD-Experte sorgst Du dafür, dass Valova den Prüfprozess von Anfang bis Ende beherrscht , und bringst unser Produkt in den Klinikalltag. Du bist die Brücke zwischen Prüfpraxis und Code und zwischen unserem Team und den Menschen, die täglich mit Valova arbeiten. Was Du bewirkst, siehst Du schwarz auf weiß: in weniger verlorenen Prüfungen, erfolgreichen Widersprüchen und Stunden, die das Medizincontrolling zurückgewinnt. Deine Aufgaben Valova die MD-Prüfung beibringen: Du übersetzt Prüfgegenstände, Fristen nach PrüfvV und die Prüfquotensystematik in klare fachliche Anforderungen. Prüfrisiken früh erkennen: Du entwickelst Regeln und Testfälle, die prüfanfällige Fälle und Dokumentationslücken erkennen, bevor die Rechnung rausgeht. Die Verteidigung aufbauen: Du legst fest, wie Valova für jeden Fall eine belegbare Argumentation vorbereitet, von der Unterlagenauswahl bis zum Widerspruch. Veränderungen im Blick behalten: Du verfolgst PrüfvV, Prüfquoten und Rechtsprechung und bringst Änderungen ins Produkt. Was Du mitbringst Fundierte Ausbildung: Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung in einem Gesundheitsfachberuf mit Weiterbildung zur Kodierfachkraft oder im Medizincontrolling, oder ein Medizinstudium. MD-Erfahrung: Mindestens drei Jahre im MD-Prüfgeschehen, idealerweise als Gutachter:in beim Medizinischen Dienst, alternativ im Medizincontrolling einer Klinik. Sicher im Detail: Du kennst Dich mit ICD-10-GM, OPS, DKR und PrüfvV aus und weißt, woran ein Gutachten scheitert. Präzises Denken: Du hinterfragst gern Prozesse und beschreibst Regeln so genau, dass Software sie umsetzen kann. Kommunikationsstärke: Du bist im Gespräch mit Ärzt:innen, MD, Kostenträgern und Technik gleichermaßen sicher. Ein Plus: Erfahrung mit KIS- oder Prüfmanagement-Software (z. B. Orbis, SAP IS-H, i.s.h.med) oder Software-Einführungen, Erfahrung mit Sozialgerichtsverfahren sowie erste Erfahrung mit Datenanalyse (Excel, SQL) oder KI-Anwendungen. Dir fehlen ein oder zwei Punkte, aber Du bist überzeugt, die richtige Person für diese Rolle zu sein? Dann bewirb Dich trotzdem. Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen. Was wir Dir bieten Flexible Arbeitszeit. 30 bis 40 Stunden pro Woche, Du entscheidest. Unbefristeter Vertrag. 100 % remote in ganz Deutschland, optional mit dem Team in München oder Berlin. Faires Gehalt, orientiert an Deiner Erfahrung und mindestens auf Klinik-Niveau. Die konkrete Spanne nennen wir Dir schon im ersten Gespräch. Sinn mit Hebel. Statt Rückstände in einer Klinik abzuarbeiten, entlastest Du Kodierteams in vielen Kliniken gleichzeitig. Direkter Draht zu den Gründern. Du arbeitest täglich mit Sophia, Ärztin und ehemalige McKinsey-Beraterin, und Christian, der zwei Health-Tech-Startups gegründet und ein Jahrzehnt lang klinische Systeme gebaut hat. Keine Hierarchieebenen, kein wochenlanges Warten auf Freigaben. Reisen ohne Kosten für Dich. Reisekosten übernehmen wir. description: About Pangea Propulsion: We are a company dedicated to developing advanced propulsion systems for the space industry based on three key principles: high efficiency, sustainability, and reusability. We are revolutionizing the space industry with ground-breaking innovations that allow us to offer the best performance to cost propulsion systems. Our goal is to be the propulsion provider for the next generation of spacecraft, which is essential to meet demands and compete in the booming space market of the next decade. We are a passionate, multicultural, and multidisciplinary team pushing the boundaries of what is possible in space propulsion technology. We have already made history by successfully testing the world's first 3D-printed Methalox Aerospike engine, marking a significant milestone for the space industry. We are looking for talented professionals to join our international teams in Barcelona and Toulouse. We want to be a key player in improving diversity in the Aerospace sector as, in Pangea, we believe that diversity (gender, age, race, sexual orientation, beliefs, disability, culture, etc.) is a key to success. Within Pangea, everyone can grow with the same opportunities. We encourage you to apply. Individually we are different, but together we are an amazing team! We are looking for a Structural Analysis Engineer in Toulouse. About the role: As a Structural Analysis Engineer, you will be a key technical contributor within Pangea Propulsion’s Structural Analysis team, operating with autonomy on thermomechanical, dynamic, and nonlinear structural problems. You will own analysis campaigns end-to-end: from problem framing, modelling, validation, to results interpretation and design recommendations - directly influencing the architecture, performance, and robustness of the next generation of propulsion systems. Within the team, you will serve as a technical reference point for advanced structural analysis methods , help shape internal best practices, and elevate the quality of analyses across projects. A core part of your role will be coaching and guiding junior and consolidated analysts, transferring knowledge, reviewing technical work, and contributing to a high-performance engineering culture. In this position, you will also take ownership of complex structural analysis problems and contribute to defining modelling strategies and analysis standards for the team. Familiarity with rocket propulsion hardware - or strong motivation to learn - will allow you to make an immediate impact. Key responsibilities · Perform and lead FEA campaigns including static, modal, thermo-mechanical, dynamic and transient analyses, dealing efficiently with non-linear problems (contacts, plasticity, large deformation etc.) · Plan, build, verify, document and maintain high-fidelity and robust FE models with traceability to loads, material properties, requirements, and assumptions. · Provide clear, high-impact design feedback to mechanical design and propulsion teams at both part and subsystem level. · Develop and improve analysis methodologies, scripts, subroutines, benchmarks, and guidelines. · Lead cross disciplinary interactions with mechanical design, fluidic analysis, and test teams to ensure coherent modelling strategies and proper load mapping. · Participate in design reviews, presenting methods, assumptions, results, and recommendations with clarity, conciseness and technical rigor. · Mentor junior and consolidated engineers, helping them develop modelling skills, physics intuition, validation strategies, and efficient workflows. · Review and challenge analysis approaches to ensure modelling robustness and consistency across projects. What you need to be successful · Master’s degree (or higher) in Aerospace, Mechanical, or related engineering disciplines. · Minimum 5+ years of professional experience performing advanced structural analyses using commercial FEA tools (preferably Abaqus). · Proven ability to run non-linear, thermo-mechanical, and dynamic analyses with a high level of autonomy and technical ownership. · Strong understanding of structural mechanics, vibrations, fatigue, fracture, material behavior, and numerical methods. · Demonstrated experience framing analysis problems, defining assumptions, and ensuring consistency with loads and system requirements. · Ability to interpret results critically, identify anomalies, and propose sound engineering solutions. · Excellent communication skills—able to articulate assumptions, limitations, and design implications clearly to multidisciplinary teams. · Proactive mindset, ownership attitude, and passion for sharing knowledge and elevating team capability. · Fluent English. Other useful skills · Experience in any of the following topics: fatigue (high cycle and low cycle), fracture mechanics, rotodynamics, test-correlation, topology optimization or probabilistic structural methods. · Knowledge of rocket propulsion systems: injector heads, thrust chambers, turbomachinery, feed systems, thermal & dynamic environments, etc. · Proficiency with meshing tools (e.g., MeshWorks) and scripting languages (Python, MATLAB). · Experience writing Abaqus subroutines (UMAT, USDFLD, UEL, etc.). · Experience working with ECSS, AIAA and other aerospace structural verification standards. · Master’s degree (or higher) in Aerospace, Mechanical, or related engineering disciplines.

· Knowledge of rocket propulsion systems: injector heads, thrust chambers, turbomachinery, feed systems, thermal & dynamic environments, etc.

· Proficiency with meshing tools (e.g., MeshWorks) and scripting languages (Python, MATLAB).

title: Field CTO, London
description:
Location: London, UK

Travel: Frequent travel across EMEA required

ABOUT WEKA

WEKA is architecting a new approach to the enterprise data stack, built for the AI era. The WEKA Data Platform sets the standard for AI infrastructure with a cloud and AI-native software solution that can be deployed anywhere. It transforms legacy data silos into data pipelines that make GPUs, AI, and other performance-intensive workloads run faster, work more efficiently, and consume less energy.

WEKA is a pre-IPO, growth-stage company on a hyper-growth trajectory. We've raised $375M in capital from dozens of world-class venture capital and strategic investors. We help the world's most innovative enterprises and research organizations (including 12 of the Fortune 50), reach discoveries, insights, and outcomes faster and more sustainably.

We're passionate about helping our customers overcome complex data challenges to accelerate their innovation and grow their businesses. If you share our passion, we would love for you to join us on this exciting journey.

WHAT'S COOL ABOUT THIS JOB

As WEKA's Field CTO for EDA and AI, based in London and covering the broader EMEA region, you'll sit at the intersection of two of the most demanding compute domains in the industry: semiconductor design (EDA) and AI infrastructure. You'll work directly with chip designers, foundries, and AI teams across EMEA to architect solutions on the WEKA Data Platform, investigate new innovations across both fields, and champion WEKA as the platform of choice for design and AI workloads. You'll collaborate with the wider CTO Office to translate customer requirements into solutions and architectures, and act as the region's technical evangelist for WEKA in EDA and AI.

RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE

  • Connect WEKA's EDA and AI customers across EMEA to the broader WEKA team, alongside other members of the CTO Office.
  • Partner with the GTM team to develop and deliver compelling technical presentations, demonstrations, and customer workshops that showcase WEKA's value proposition in semiconductor design and AI workloads.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to GTM teams and customers, providing deep technical expertise on how WEKA's technology solves EDA and AI-specific technical and business challenges.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders across product, engineering, and marketing to align customer needs, technology strategy, and product roadmap.
  • Deliver advisory services to the field, working with WEKA's presales and post-sales organizations to drive successful outcomes on both types of engagements.
  • Provide oversight on large, complex EDA and AI customer engagements across the region where appropriate.
  • Champion technical innovation across functions inside and outside GTM, staying current on emerging EDA and AI technologies and assessing their impact on the business.
  • Cultivate partnerships with technology providers (EDA vendors, foundries, hyperscalers, GPU vendors) to address customer requirements and expand WEKA's reach and influence across EMEA.
  • Represent WEKA at industry events, conferences, and workshops across the region, establishing thought leadership in EDA and AI infrastructure.
  • Identify emerging market trends and technologies across EDA and AI to inform product development and go-to-market strategy.

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 15+ years of technical experience in relevant industries
  • Proven experience architecting AI infrastructure environments; hands-on experience with EDA (Electronic Design Automation) workflows and semiconductor design compute environments.
  • Proven track record deploying and utilizing multiple AI frameworks and technologies.
  • Excellent English communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical audiences across a diverse regional customer base.
  • Demonstrated experience and proven skills as a technical evangelist, including designing and running customer workshops.
  • Comfortable with frequent travel across EMEA.
  • Ability to translate technical terms into business value for varied audiences, specifically across traditional enterprises adopting AI, foundational model builders, neocloud providers and semiconductor design houses. 
  • Experience building and maintaining strong relationships with customers and partners.
  • A collaborative, results-oriented mindset with a strong work ethic and genuine passion for staying ahead of the technology curve.

Concerned you don't meet every qualification? Don't let it stop you from applying.

WEKA is committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this position but don't meet every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be the right candidate for this or other positions at WEKA.

title: Director of Product, AML & Fraud Prevention
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

At Vinted we are devoted to making second-hand the first choice worldwide. Vinted Pay is the regulated payments entity that makes it possible through enabling Vinted users to spend money, receive money, keep money and payout, while keeping them safe from financial crime.

We are establishing a new AML & Fraud Prevention product domain within Vinted Pay. As a regulated financial institution operating across Europe, our obligations grow as we grow: anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing controls, sanctions screening, KYC, transaction monitoring are protecting our members and our balance sheet from fraud and other illegal activities. Today these capabilities sit across several teams and tools. This domain will own them end to end, and turn financial crime prevention into a mature product: controls that satisfy regulators without adding friction for the honest majority.

This is a newly created domain. As its leader you will work with your functional peers (Engineering, Data, Design) to assess the status quo and construct the long-term vision. You will be responsible for setting domain goals, delivering on already identified opportunities, hiring, and executing the product vision.

You’ll report to the leader of Engineering/Product/Design/Analytics at Vinted Pay, and partner with Product Directors across Vinted Pay and the wider marketplace, as well as with our Compliance, Legal, Risk, Risk Operations, Engineering, Design and Analytics functions.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Drive and align the AML & Fraud Prevention domain on a single, unified vision, expressed through measurable objectives and key results

title: Senior Software Engineer, Embedded UI
description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.

 

Roku is changing how the world watches TV

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

 

What does the team work on?

This team spends most of its time working on customer focused features that improve the user experience, from content discovery and search to Roku pay and subscription to embedded software and firmware, and much more. Our product roadmap helps us accelerate our growth and scale, putting surprising new features into the hands of tens of millions of Roku users worldwide. Our developers and engineers are owners. They are motivated from within, finding and taking on a feature or project simply because that problem needs to be solved and shipped. But that individual must work together with different engineering teams, UI design, product teams, and business leadership to make things happen, which means that engineers succeed here because they can maintain that independent spirit and motivation within a deeply collaborative environment. We are the pragmatic dreamers inventing and re-inventing the world of streaming media.

 

What is the role?

As a Senior Software Engineer on the OS UI/SDK team, you will design, develop, and deliver engaging platform features — including screensavers, static and dynamic wallpapers, trivia, featured experiences, and AI-driven content initiatives — that reach millions of Roku users worldwide. You will leverage AI and machine learning technologies to develop new capabilities that enhance user experiences across the Roku platform. This role requires a proactive, ownership-driven approach where you will create proof-of-concept prototypes in a startup-minded environment and then adapt those prototypes for production-grade deployment. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional partners in UI/UX design, product management, backend engineering, and business leadership to translate ideas into impactful solutions. You will investigate, diagnose, and resolve technical issues to maintain high-quality, commercially viable products. This is an opportunity to shape the future of streaming entertainment through innovation and a deep commitment to engineering excellence.

 

How will I use AI at Roku?

At Roku, we don't just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We're looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they've used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact.

We value your AI skills if have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.

 

What are the responsibilities of the role?

  • Design and develop features for new experiences on the Roku platform, including screensavers, wallpapers, trivia, and featured experiences
  • Build proof-of-concept prototypes to validate ideas rapidly, working with a startup mindset to iterate quickly and deliver solutions
  • Collaborate with UI/UX design, backend engineering, and product management teams to create and implement new user experiences
  • Adapt proof-of-concept solutions into production-ready, scalable implementations
  • Leverage AI, machine learning, and large language model technologies to develop innovative platform features
  • Investigate, diagnose, and resolve technical issues to maintain commercially viable solutions
  • Contribute to API design decisions, understanding considerations and trade-offs
  • Work across cloud development, content management, and UI development to deliver end-to-end feature solutions

 

What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku?

  • Extensive experience in a software engineering environment
  • Demonstrated project work using AI/ML and LLM technologies
  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as JavaScript, TypeScript, React Native, Python, BrightScript, or related technologies
  • Experience working in an embedded environment
  • Experience in productionising solutions, including content management, UI development, cloud development, and cloud backend integration
  • Knowledge of core OS concepts such as memory management and multi-threading
  • Experience in API design, with an understanding of considerations and trade-offs
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams
  • Consumer electronics experience in media, content, or ad product development is a plus
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field

What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?

Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

 

What are some of the benefits?

Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.

 

Accommodations

Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to  

What should I know about Roku's culture?

Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV.

We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002.

title: Senior Technical Account Manager (UK)
description:
At Dragos, the mission is personal. The systems we protect deliver the water you drink, power your home, and keep the hospitals your community depends on running. Those critical infrastructure systems that power our civilization around the world are under attack every day by adversaries. When those systems fail, people are immediately at risk. We are the global leader in xOT cybersecurity, combining technology, threat intelligence, and expert services. The people here chose this work because they understand what is at stake. Here, you will find a remote-first mission-driven team across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and APAC built on authenticity, transparency, and trust. If safeguarding the systems that protect your family, friends, and community is the kind of work that matters to you, you are in the right place. 

About the Role: 

Dragos is seeking a Senior Technical Account Manager (TAM) to serve as a trusted advisor to some of the most critical infrastructure and industrial organisations across Europe.

In this role, you will help customers maximise the value of their investment in Dragos solutions while strengthening their Operational Technology (OT) cybersecurity capabilities. You will work closely with cybersecurity, engineering, operations, and executive stakeholders to understand business priorities, operational challenges, and security objectives, translating these into practical, measurable outcomes.

Through advisory engagements, goal-setting workshops, technical enablement, and ongoing guidance, you will help customers operationalise key use cases, improve cyber resilience, and mature their OT security programmes over time.

This role combines deep OT/ICS cybersecurity expertise with strong relationship management and consulting skills. You will help customers navigate complex security challenges, align initiatives with recognised industry frameworks, and build sustainable programmes that reduce risk and improve operational resilience.

As the voice of the customer, you will provide valuable feedback and insights to internal teams, helping shape product innovation, customer experience improvements, and future capabilities. Success in this role requires technical credibility, business acumen, curiosity, resilience, and a genuine passion for helping customers achieve meaningful outcomes while advancing Dragos' mission of Safeguarding Civilisation.

 

Responsibilities: 

  • Serve as a trusted advisor and technical advocate for assigned customer accounts. 
  • Lead customer onboarding and adoption, helping customers maximise the value of their investment in Dragos.
  • Facilitate goal-setting workshops and planning sessions to align platform capabilities with customer objectives and success measures.
  • Guide customers in the operationalisation of key use cases and integration of Dragos into existing security and operational workflows. 
  • Provide ongoing technical guidance, best practices, and recommendations to improve platform utilisation and cybersecurity maturity. 
  • Monitor customer health, platform adoption, and utilisation trends, proactively identifying risks to customer success and value realisation. 
  • Support the development and execution of engagement and recovery plans for at-risk or underutilised accounts. 
  • Conduct regular account reviews and value realisation discussions, demonstrating progress against customer goals and identifying opportunities for continuous improvement. 
  • Deliver technical enablement, workshops, and training to improve customer proficiency and self-sufficiency. 
  • Collaborate with Customer Success, Support, Product, Services, and Sales teams to deliver seamless customer experience and represent the voice of the customer.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for OT cybersecurity topics, contributing to customer workshops, QBR and executive briefings.
  • Travel throughout the European region as required (up to 30%).

Qualifications: 

  • 3+ years' experience working in OT, ICS, or critical infrastructure environments, with knowledge of ICS, SCADA, or DCS systems. 
  • Experience in security operations, threat detection, threat intelligence, vulnerability management, or related cybersecurity disciplines. 
  • Strong understanding of industrial cybersecurity, OT/ICS environments, cyber risk management, and security operations workflows. 
  • Experience applying frameworks such as ISA/IEC 62443, NIST CSF, SANS ICS Five Critical Controls, CAF, the Cyber Resilience Act, and other relevant European frameworks to improve cybersecurity maturity and customer outcomes. 
  • Ability to engage and influence both technical and business stakeholders, delivering workshops, training, and advisory engagements. 
  • Strong communication, relationship management, and problem-solving skills, with a customer-first mindset focused on driving value realisation. 
  • Familiarity with critical infrastructure regulations and cyber resilience requirements across Europe is highly regarded.
  • Multilingual candidates, particularly those speaking German and other European languages, are highly preferred.

Compensation: 

  • OTE:  £88,000.00
  • Competitive Equity Package  
  • Comprehensive Benefits Plan

How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future. 🎯 The Role We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who is curious about the modeling problem underneath cyber risk and wants to help shape a young product. You will join OpenCRQ as its fourth engineer and work across the data model, backend and product surface. You will shape these decisions with the squad and experienced engineering and product leaders across Filigran. OpenCRQ replaces that color with a financial estimate and a traceable chain of evidence: which threat actors are active, which assets they can reach, which controls have proven effective and what the remaining exposure could cost. Every step is computed from live data and must withstand a simple question from a board: “Where does that figure come from?” That is what makes this an engineering problem rather than a reporting one. OpenCRQ is Filigran’s cyber risk quantification product. It combines threat intelligence from OpenCTI, exposure and control validation from OpenAEV, and agentic workflows through XTM One. You will have the autonomy to drive the work, while using the squad to challenge assumptions and improve the outcome. The quantification engine. Turn threat frequency, control effectiveness and asset value into probabilistic loss distributions. Model complex relationships across OpenCRQ, OpenCTI, OpenAEV and customer systems. Map threat intelligence, including intrusion sets, techniques, campaigns and observations, to assets, vulnerabilities, exposures and control coverage. Process hundreds of thousands of findings per tenant through delta syncs, long-running backfills and feeds with imperfect timestamps. You will help design observable, recoverable pipelines while extending tenant isolation as the domain grows. The agentic surface. Design the contracts used by XTM One agents and the plain-language explanations behind risk figures. Made a major ingestion or calculation path more observable, recoverable and reproducible. Defined or implemented a durable contract between OpenCRQ and another Filigran product or an open standard, without making the internal model brittle. Helped ship risk results that users can trace back to the evidence that produced them. The squad is small enough for you to influence its direction, without working in isolation. You will collaborate with the VP of Technology, CTO and Principal Engineers on technical standards, and with the OpenCTI, OpenAEV and XTM One teams on cross-product contracts and integrations. These relationships bring domain knowledge and broader technical context into the squad’s decisions as it grows. ✨ What will help you succeed We do not expect you to arrive with expertise in cyber risk or every standard named below. We are looking for a strong software engineer who can learn quickly, work autonomously and use the squad to challenge and improve decisions. Thoughtful use of coding agents: you know where they accelerate engineering and where their output needs careful verification. Filigran stands out in the cybersecurity ecosystem through its open-source, AI-powered and threat-informed approach to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative.

As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future.

 

🎯 The Role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who is curious about the modeling problem underneath cyber risk and wants to help shape a young product.

You will join OpenCRQ as its fourth engineer and work across the data model, backend and product surface. Many foundations are still being defined, giving you meaningful influence beyond the features you directly own.

You will shape these decisions with the squad and experienced engineering and product leaders across Filigran. We value constructive disagreement, clear reasoning and shared outcomes, and we expect everyone to ask for context, challenge assumptions and learn from one another.

🧩 The problem you would be working on

Ask a CISO what a cyber risk could cost, and the answer often still begins with a color: red, amber or green, often produced by a spreadsheet disconnected from current evidence.

OpenCRQ replaces that color with a financial estimate and a traceable chain of evidence: which threat actors are active, which assets they can reach, which controls have proven effective and what the remaining exposure could cost.

Every step is computed from live data and must withstand a simple question from a board: “Where does that figure come from?” That is what makes this an engineering problem rather than a reporting one.

OpenCRQ is Filigran’s cyber risk quantification product. It combines threat intelligence from OpenCTI, exposure and control validation from OpenAEV, and agentic workflows through XTM One. As these products become more connected, the squad will define what agents can ask of the risk model, which evidence they can use and how their answers remain safe and explainable.

🛠️ What you would work on

  • End-to-end product ownership. Take product problems from early ideation and technical design through implementation, end-to-end testing and validation with users. You will have the autonomy to drive the work, while using the squad to challenge assumptions and improve the outcome.

  • The quantification engine. Turn threat frequency, control effectiveness and asset value into probabilistic loss distributions. Build general-purpose quantitative models that can evolve as assumptions and available evidence change, without losing reproducibility or explainability.

  • The correlation layer. Model complex relationships across OpenCRQ, OpenCTI, OpenAEV and customer systems. Map threat intelligence, including intrusion sets, techniques, campaigns and observations, to assets, vulnerabilities, exposures and control coverage. This includes adapting OpenCRQ to open standards and schemas such as STIX and OCSF, without coupling the product to a single representation.

  • Reliable ingestion at scale. Process hundreds of thousands of findings per tenant through delta syncs, long-running backfills and feeds with imperfect timestamps. You will help design observable, recoverable pipelines while extending tenant isolation as the domain grows.

  • The agentic surface. Design the contracts used by XTM One agents and the plain-language explanations behind risk figures. Together, the squad will define what models can safely do in a product whose outputs inform board-level decisions.

🏆 What success could look like

Priorities will evolve with the product, but within your first 6 to 12 months you could have:

  • Taken a meaningful product problem from early ideation through implementation, end-to-end testing and validation with users.

  • Shaped a core part of OpenCRQ’s interconnected data model or quantification engine and documented the trade-offs behind it.

  • Made a major ingestion or calculation path more observable, recoverable and reproducible.

  • Defined or implemented a durable contract between OpenCRQ and another Filigran product or an open standard, without making the internal model brittle.

  • Helped ship risk results that users can trace back to the evidence that produced them.

  • Contributed to the open-source release and to engineering practices the growing squad can build on.

🌐 Open source, like the rest of Filigran

OpenCRQ is about to become Open source, alongside OpenCTI and OpenAEV. You will contribute visibly to a product whose risk calculations can be inspected, challenged and improved by the organizations running it.

👥 The squad

You will join two senior engineers and a staff engineer, reporting to OpenCRQ’s Engineering Manager. The squad is small enough for you to influence its direction, without working in isolation.

You will collaborate with the VP of Technology, CTO and Principal Engineers on technical standards, and with the OpenCTI, OpenAEV and XTM One teams on cross-product contracts and integrations. These relationships bring domain knowledge and broader technical context into the squad’s decisions as it grows.

✨ What will help you succeed

We do not expect you to arrive with expertise in cyber risk or every standard named below. We are looking for a strong software engineer who can learn quickly, work autonomously and use the squad to challenge and improve decisions.

  • A track record of taking complex product problems from an ambiguous idea to a validated outcome: framing the problem, making technical decisions, implementing the solution, testing it end to end and checking that it solves the user’s need.

  • Strong experience with a modern TypeScript stack and practical knowledge of PostgreSQL beyond the ORM. You treat failure modes and observability as part of the design.

  • The ability to reason about complex relationships across systems and design interconnected data models that remain coherent as concepts and integrations evolve.

  • Comfort turning quantitative concepts into maintainable software. Formal training in statistics is not required, but you should be willing to work with probability distributions, orders of magnitude and models whose assumptions evolve over time.

  • Thoughtful use of coding agents: you know where they accelerate engineering and where their output needs careful verification.

  • Fluent English is required.

💡 Useful, but not required

Any of the following would help, but none is expected:

  • Experience in cybersecurity, GRC or risk quantification.

  • Familiarity with STIX/TAXII, OCSF, MITRE ATT&CK or other open cybersecurity standards and frameworks.

  • Experience shipping features involving LLM agents, RAG or MCP.

⚙️ The stack

TypeScript end to end: React, Vite and TanStack Router on the frontend; Node.js, Fastify and tRPC on the backend; PostgreSQL with a code-first schema and Drizzle, all in one monorepo.

OpenCRQ ships as a container, both as SaaS and on customer-managed infrastructure. We use OpenTelemetry for traces, metrics and logs, alongside Prometheus and continuous profiling.

A significant part of the design work happens at the boundaries between OpenCRQ, the rest of Filigran’s product suite and customer security tooling. You will work directly with the teams that own those systems rather than having to navigate those boundaries alone.

🌱 Why Join Filigran? More than just a job.

We are a fast-growing, global and remote-first company, and we believe the best work combines purpose, impact and innovation. You’ll work alongside talented people across the world who care about what they build, how they build it, and the impact they make on the broader cybersecurity ecosystem.

⭐ Be part of something bigger

We believe we do work that matters. Our open-source approach means that work extends beyond Filigran. You’re contributing to technology and ideas that strengthen a global community of defenders and help make cybersecurity more open and collaborative.

💻 Work at the edge of what’s next

We bring together cybersecurity, open source and AI — giving you the opportunity to work with emerging technologies, experiment with new ways of working, and contribute to how they are applied in practice.

🌍 Global opportunity without borders

Be part of a fast-growing, truly international team — collaborating across Europe, North America, APJ and beyond, with the flexibility of a remote-first environment. As we grow, you’ll have opportunities to expand your scope, take ownership, learn quickly and grow with us.

🧭 A culture grounded in CORE

Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity define how we work together — with openness, ownership, collaboration and respect. These are the principles that guide how we make decisions, treat people and grow together, especially when no one’s watching.

The PACE is fast. The expectations are high. The contribution matters. Working at TYTAN is more than a job, this is a mission. We push boundaries, think big, and hold ourselves to the highest standard. Our mission and values guide everything we do, and we're looking for people who are driven by ownership, embrace challenges, and are energized by meaningful work. If you're motivated by impact and thrive in dynamic environments, you'll fit right in.

At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect European sovereignty.

We are looking for a hands-on engineer who knows the Microsoft security stack in depth. You secure our endpoints and identities, own detection and incident response, and run our vulnerability management. Today much of this runs with external partners: in 2027 you take it over and keep us ready for ISO 27001 and NIS2.

Your roadmap to make an impact

Harden endpoints and identities

  • Tune Microsoft Defender XDR across endpoints, mail, identities and cloud apps

  • Maintain Intune security baselines: BitLocker, LAPS, attack surface reduction and device compliance

  • Review and test Conditional Access, MFA and Privileged Identity Management with the Infrastructure & Cloud Lead

  • Help apply Microsoft Purview data protection, such as sensitivity labels and data loss prevention

Detect and respond

  • Take over detection tuning and ownership from our managed SOC step by step in 2027

  • Connect logs to Microsoft Sentinel and build and tune detection rules

  • Steer our managed SOC and SOAR service: alert quality, escalations and service reviews

  • Lead incident response in-house and write runbooks the team can follow

Manage vulnerabilities

  • Run vulnerability management across endpoints, servers, cloud and network devices

  • Prioritise findings by risk and drive fixes with the owning teams

  • Publish a monthly vulnerability report with trends and open risks

Secure production and engineering

  • Support security of shop-floor, lab and test-bench networks with the Infrastructure & Cloud Lead

  • Work with our Information Security Officers on secure CI/CD and supply-chain checks

Stay audit-ready

  • Prepare the technical side of ISO 27001 certification and NIS2

  • Provide technical evidence and put our security policies into practice

  • Document systems, detections and runbooks so the team can rely on them


  • 4+ years of hands-on security engineering in a Microsoft environment: Defender XDR, Entra ID and Intune

  • Proven deployment and tuning of Microsoft Defender XDR (Endpoint, Office 365, Identity) in a live tenant

  • Hands-on with Microsoft Sentinel or another SIEM: log onboarding, detection rules and alert tuning

  • Real incident response experience, from triage to lessons learned, and runbooks others can follow

  • You have run vulnerability management in a live environment: scanning, prioritisation, remediation and reporting

  • Endpoint hardening with Intune: security baselines, BitLocker, LAPS and attack surface reduction rules

  • Solid knowledge of Conditional Access, MFA and privileged access in Entra ID

  • Scripting and security automation with PowerShell and Microsoft Graph

  • Experience working with a managed SOC or external partners, and with ISO 27001 or NIS2 audits

  • Fluent English; fluent in German is close to a must

  • Based in Munich or willing to relocate

  • Eligible to work in the German defense sector: you sign confidentiality and export-control obligations and pass a security check

Nice to have

  • Certifications such as SC-200, SC-100, AZ-500, SC-300 or GCIH

  • Strong KQL for threat hunting and detection engineering

  • Microsoft Purview: sensitivity labels, data loss prevention and insider risk

  • OT security awareness, for example IEC 62443

  • Purple teaming or attack simulation experience

  • German BSI IT-Grundschutz

  • Fluent German and already based in Munich (a big plus)

  • Experience in a regulated or security-sensitive industry

Why TYTAN?

  • Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defense systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security

  • Shape scalable defense capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale

  • Contribute to networked air defense: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defense architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors

  • Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback

  • Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact

  • Define a new generation of defense technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company

  • Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe

Our Benefits

  • Virtual stock options: Participate in our success through virtual stock options (VSOPs) at the company's current valuation

  • Monthly allowances: €106/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit

  • Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us

  • Referral bonus: Earn a reward when someone you refer joins the team

  • Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together

  • Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands

  • Flexibility: Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration

About us

At TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all.

WE are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fairness and inclusivity. We do not prioritize any specific religion, gender, nationality, or background. Due to security clearance requirements, affiliations with countries listed under § 13 para. 1 no. 17 SÜG may affect the application process.

Please note that we currently do not offer visa sponsorship, so we’re only able to consider candidates who already have a valid work permit. All qualified applicants are hereby encouraged to apply.

Everything we build is a node: from small embedded devices to full compute systems and ground infrastructure. Together they operate as one network, in the field and over denied, degraded and intermittent links. You design how this works end to end: how nodes find and connect to each other, how trust propagates, how they communicate, and how every node exposes what the application stack needs. And you build it: the network itself, the node agent that runs on every node, the node API and the SDK.

Your roadmap to make an impact

  • System design: Own the end-to-end design of how our systems connect and communicate: topology, links, transports, delivery semantics and failure behaviour. When a new requirement lands, such as operating a system beyond line of sight over LEO satellite or cellular links, you design how it works: latency budget, link selection and failover, security, and what keeps working when the link drops

  • The network: Build it: addressing plans, routing, segmentation and multi-homing across tactical radio, cellular, satcom and wired links, with dynamic routing and link selection for nodes that move and links that fail

  • Secure links: IPsec/IKEv2 or WireGuard overlays with certificate authentication from hardware-backed keys, including rekeying, NAT traversal and behaviour on link loss

  • Trust: Design how trust propagates from production to the field: device identity, certificate lifecycle, mutual authentication, authorisation tiers, revocation and signed commands that keep working without backend connectivity

  • Node agent: Design and build the agent that runs on every node and exposes identity, health, software state, connectivity and updates through one API, served locally, over the network and in compact form over constrained links. Devices too small to run it are represented through their parent node

  • Node API and SDK: One resource model for every node type, versioned and backward compatible across a fleet that never updates all at once, with SDKs generated from the contract for the languages our teams use

  • Discovery and directory: How nodes find each other with and without infrastructure, and a directory that survives restarts and shows what should exist versus what is present, at fleet scale without polling every node

  • Communication: Build on proven middleware and transports instead of reinventing them, define delivery semantics per traffic class, and engineer QoS so command and control traffic survives congestion on constrained links

  • Network as code: Configuration templated, version controlled, validated in CI and shipped as part of the system release

  • Verification: Network emulation that reproduces measured field link profiles, fault injection in CI, and network test campaigns at test ranges and flight tests with root cause from packet captures

  • Direction: Write the design documents and contracts that embedded, backend and application engineers build against, and review designs


  • Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications or a related field, or equivalent experience

  • 5+ years building networked or distributed systems in production, combining software engineering with hands-on network engineering, including technical ownership of a core component other teams depend on

  • Designed a networked system end to end, and can reason through a new connectivity scenario from first principles: topology, latency budget, failure modes and security

  • Expert in Rust, Go or C++, working proficiency in Python, and comfortable reading and writing C++

  • Strong networking across the stack: IP addressing and routing, UDP, TCP and QUIC internals, congestion control, multicast, NAT traversal, MTU and fragmentation; fluent with Wireshark and tcpdump

  • Expert Linux networking: iproute2, policy routing, network namespaces, VRFs, bridges, VLANs, nftables, tc and netem

  • Production experience with IPsec (strongSwan or libreswan) and WireGuard, including PKI-based authentication

  • Routing: OSPF and BGP (ideally FRRouting or BIRD), and how latency, loss and link quality shape routing and protocol design in dynamic networks

  • Applied security: PKI and certificate lifecycle, mTLS, hardware-backed keys (TPM or secure elements) and authorisation models

  • Built services that run on devices: Linux daemons, systemd, local IPC and resource-constrained environments

  • Experience with middleware such as DDS, ROS 2, Zenoh, ZeroMQ, NATS or gRPC, including discovery, flow control, serialisation and QoS

  • API and contract design consumed by many teams: schema evolution, versioning and backward compatibility

  • Written design documents that other teams implemented against

  • Willingness to travel to test sites and flight tests (around 20%)

Nice to haves

  • Systems built for denied, degraded, intermittent or limited (DDIL) connectivity: defense, robotic fleets, autonomous vehicles, space

  • Beyond-line-of-sight operation over LEO satellite, cellular or long-range radio links

  • Integration of MANET or mesh radios (e.g. Silvus, Doodle Labs, Persistent Systems) and MANET routing such as OLSR or B.A.T.M.A.N.

  • Network emulation with EMANE, CORE, ns-3 or Linux netem

  • Time synchronisation with PTP/gPTP

  • Replication and coordination (Raft, gossip, CRDTs, logical clocks)

  • Embedded ARM targets, RTOS or mixed Linux and RTOS systems

  • Tactical datalinks, defense crypto equipment or interoperability standards such as STANAG 4586

Why TYTAN?

  • Shape scalable defense capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale

  • Contribute to networked air defense: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defense architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors

  • Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback

  • Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact

  • Define a new generation of defense technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company

  • Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe

Our Benefits

  • Virtual stock options: Participate in our success through virtual stock options (VSOPs) at the company's current valuation

  • Monthly allowances: €106/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit

  • Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us

  • Referral bonus: Earn a reward when someone you refer joins the team

  • Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together

  • Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands

title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) Business Development Management/Marketing
description: Für unser Business Development Management/Marketing Team suchen wir einen engagierten Werkstudenten (m/w/d). Die Deutsche Extrakt Kaffee GmbH zählt zu den führenden Herstellern von löslichen Kaffee- und Getränkespezialitäten. Mit Innovationskraft, technologischem Know-How und einem breiten internationalen Kundenportfolio gestalten wir täglich die Zukunft moderner Heißgetränke. Nachhaltiger Unternehmenserfolg ist für uns eine echte Teamleistung - und das macht die Zusammenarbeit in der DEK aus. Wir bieten ein modernes Umfeld, in dem Ideen willkommen sind und Sie Ihre gestalterischen sowie organisatorischen Fähigkeiten aktiv einbringen können. Wenn Sie strukturiert arbeiten, Interesse am Business Development mitbringen und praktische Erfahrung sammeln möchten, sind Sie bei uns genau richtig. Folgende Aufgaben erwarten Sie bei uns als Werkstudent (m/w/d) Business Development Management/Marketing: Sie werden eigenverantwortlich Arbeiten, praktische Erfahrungen sammeln und sich mit neuen Ideen direkt mit einbringen. Sie helfen bei der Analyse von Marktzahlen mit verschiedensten Programmen sowie der Hilfe von KI. Sie unterstützen bei der Erstellung von Kalkulationen als auch der Bewertung wirtschaftlicher Potenziale. Sie sind an der Organisation von Vertriebsmessen beteiligt und helfen vor Ort bei der Umsetzung. Sie nutzen KI-gestützte Tools, um Markttrends, Kundenbedürfnisse und mögliche Geschäftspotenziale zu recherchieren. Sie unterstützen bei der Erstellung und Aufbereitung von Angebotsunterlagen und vertriebsrelevanten Dokumenten. Sie designen Projekt-Visualisierungs-Graphiken mit der Hilfe von KI. Sie unterstützen mit der systematischen Analyse von Wettbewerbern. Sie helfen bei Verkostungen sowie dem Musterversand. Unser Team ergänzen Sie ideal als eingeschriebene:r Student:in eines wirtschaftswissenschaftlichen Studiengangs beispielweise Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Marketing, Business Development oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs. Sie zeichnen sich durch eine strukturierte, eigenständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie analytisches Denken und Interesse an Markt- und Wettbewerbsentwicklung aus. Sie bringen Freude daran mit, neue Ideen zu entwickeln, praktische Erfahrungen zu sammeln und Themen nach dem Credo “Machen & Lernen” aktiv voranzutreiben. Der sichere Umgang mit MS Office, insbesondere Excel und PowerPoint, ist ein Vorteil. Interesse an KI-gestützten Recherche- und Analysemethoden sowie erste Erfahrungen im Bereich Marketing, Vertrieb oder Business Development sind wünschenswert, jedoch keine Voraussetzung. Unser Angebot Bei uns erwartet Sie nicht nur ein sicherer Arbeitsplatz, sondern auch eine langfristige Perspektive in einem international tätigen Familienunternehmen. Sie erhalten eine attraktive Vergütung, ergänzt durch Weihnachtsgeld, Urlaubsgeld sowie regelmäßige Gehaltsanpassungen. Wir möchten, dass Sie sich bei uns langfristig wohlfühlen und Ihre Arbeit flexibel gestalten können. Deshalb bieten wir Ihnen moderne Arbeitsbedingungen mit Gleitzeit, flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und der Möglichkeit mobil zu arbeiten. Wir bieten Ihnen ein attraktives Vergütungsmodell. Gemeinsam wachsen: Wir fördern Ihre persönliche und fachliche Weiterentwicklung durch individuelle Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und externe Qualifizierungsangebote. Bei uns erhalten Sie Gestaltungsspielraum und die Möglichkeit, Verantwortung für spannende Projekte und Produkte zu übernehmen. Karriere mit Geschmack: Sie erhalten monatliche Freikontingente, damit Sie auch nach der Arbeit erstklassigen Kaffee, Cappuccino und Trinkschokoladen genießen können. Damit nicht nur unsere Produkte überzeugen, sondern auch Ihr Arbeitsalltag angenehm bleibt, wird in unserer betriebseigenen Kantine täglich frisch gekocht. Dank unserer Kooperation mit dem Fürstenberg Institut erhalten Sie und Ihre Familienangehörigen Zugang zu professioneller und vertraulicher Beratung – bei beruflichen, privaten oder familiären Themen. Unsere Mitarbeitenden liegen uns am Herzen. Neben den vielfältigen Angeboten gehören auch kleine Aufmerksamkeiten zu Geburtstagen, Ostern, Nikolaus oder Weihnachten bei uns einfach dazu. Dürfen wir uns kurz vorstellen? Familiär. International. Langfristig. Besondere Qualität entsteht, wenn Tradition und Moderne miteinander harmonieren. Wir gehen respektvoll, offen und hilfsbereit miteinander um und geben jeden Tag unser Bestes, um erstklassige Kaffee-Spezialitäten zu produzieren. Bei der DEK arbeiten Sie in einem internationalen Umfeld und spüren zugleich die Vorteile eines inhabergeführten Familienunternehmens. Kontakt Ihre Ansprechpartnerin Haben Sie Fragen zur Position oder zum Bewerbungsverfahren? Wenden Sie sich gerne an Jennifer Brunsiek unter 040 75304 394 oder per E-Mail: Wir freuen uns über geeignete Bewerbungen unabhängig von Geschlecht, kultureller und sozialer Herkunft, Alter, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung oder sexueller Identität.
