title: Founding Full-Stack Engineer
description: Founding Full-Stack Engineer Build the software systems around planqor.ai: the real-time decision layer that steers discrete manufacturing when production plans get disrupted. Born on the shop floor, co-founded by senior production experts, and with direct access to high-impact industry problems. Work directly with our CTO and shape a greenfield product spanning Python backend, data, visualization, frontend, infrastructure, and integration with our optimization core. Backed by investors who have built and scaled successful companies. Remote-first or from our office in Munich, competitive pay + VSOP, no puzzle interviews. The opportunity Factories have invested billions in automation, yet production is still steered largely by people. Every night, a plan is computed for the next day, and the first disruption makes it obsolete. From then on, planners and shift leads juggle dependencies by hand. That is expensive, rarely optimal, and wastes much of what these factories were built for. We are building the layer that takes over when the plan gets disrupted. It connects to factory data, models production, detects disruptions and bottlenecks as they emerge, simulates responses and recommends the best one. About us planqor.ai was born on the shop floor. Our founding team brings deep production expertise, strong industry networks. We have the runway to build deliberately and the experience of people who have built and scaled successful companies before. On the technical side, we combine deep algorithmic and software-engineering competence with modern optimization methods, GenAI-assisted development and fast, pragmatic iteration. We are in stealth and very early, which means you can shape much of what comes next. What you'll own The product layer: Turn complex optimization systems into software planners can actually use. Backend and data: Build Python services, APIs, data models, and pipelines around our optimization engine. Interfaces and visualization: Make schedules, bottlenecks, dependencies, and alternative decisions understandable and interactive. Integration: Connect native C++ components, factory data, and product workflows into one coherent system. Infrastructure: Own CI/CD, containers, deployment, observability, and the supporting services we need. The team: Grow into leading software engineering at planqor.ai as we scale: hiring, mentoring, and setting direction. You set your own priorities and structure your work toward clear goals. No ticket queue, no micromanagement. How we build Our product sits at the boundary between algorithms, software systems, and real industrial operations. We care about building systems that are easy to integrate, responsive, understandable, and maintainable as both the product and the underlying algorithms evolve. We use GenAI extensively to prototype, implement, and explore alternatives. But generating code is not the hard part. The value lies in designing the right system, choosing good abstractions, validating behavior, and knowing what is worth building. There are no points for cleverness. The simplest system that reliably solves the real problem wins. What you'll bring Strong Python and backend engineering. You are comfortable designing APIs, services, libraries, and maintainable system boundaries. Full-stack product skills. You can work with TypeScript, React, or similar technologies and build interfaces that make complex systems understandable. Data and integration. You can design data models and pipelines, work with databases, and connect messy external systems to clean internal interfaces. Systems thinking. You think beyond individual services or screens: how data, algorithms, product, and infrastructure fit together. Infrastructure fundamentals. You are comfortable with Docker, CI/CD, deployment, observability, and operating services. Independence. You can turn an underspecified operational problem into working software without waiting for a detailed spec. Fluent English. German and experience in manufacturing or industrial planning are useful but not required. Bonus: C++ and native Python bindings such as pybind11 or nanobind; data visualization; optimization, scheduling, simulation, or other algorithmic systems; enterprise integrations such as ERP / SAP. What you'll get Real ownership: shape the product architecture from line one, working directly with our CTO. A clear growth path into leading the software engineering team. A real problem worth solving. We equip you with the hardware, compute, and tools you work best with. Remote-first or from our Munich office, with regular in-person workshops. Competitive pay + VSOP. The process (fast, real conversations, no puzzles) Send your CV. Talk with our CTO about your work and how you approach hard problems. Meet our CEO and selected investors. We care about building systems that are easy to integrate, responsive, understandable, and maintainable as both the product and the underlying algorithms evolve.

We use GenAI extensively to prototype, implement, and explore alternatives. But generating code is not the hard part. The value lies in designing the right system, choosing good abstractions, validating behavior, and knowing what is worth building.

There are no points for cleverness. The simplest system that reliably solves the real problem wins.

What you'll bring

  • Strong Python and backend engineering. You are comfortable designing APIs, services, libraries, and maintainable system boundaries.

  • Full-stack product skills. You can work with TypeScript, React, or similar technologies and build interfaces that make complex systems understandable.

  • Data and integration. You can design data models and pipelines, work with databases, and connect messy external systems to clean internal interfaces.

  • Systems thinking. You think beyond individual services or screens: how data, algorithms, product, and infrastructure fit together.

  • Infrastructure fundamentals. You are comfortable with Docker, CI/CD, deployment, observability, and operating services.

  • Independence. You can turn an underspecified operational problem into working software without waiting for a detailed spec.

  • Fluent English. German and experience in manufacturing or industrial planning are useful but not required.

Bonus: C++ and native Python bindings such as pybind11 or nanobind; data visualization; optimization, scheduling, simulation, or other algorithmic systems; enterprise integrations such as ERP / SAP.

What you'll get

  • Real ownership: shape the product architecture from line one, working directly with our CTO.

  • A clear growth path into leading the software engineering team.

  • A real problem worth solving.

  • We equip you with the hardware, compute, and tools you work best with.

  • Remote-first or from our Munich office, with regular in-person workshops.

  • Competitive pay + VSOP.

The process (fast, real conversations, no puzzles)

  1. Send your CV.

  2. Talk with our CTO about your work and how you approach hard problems.

  3. Meet our CEO and selected investors.

title: PR Teamlead (m/w/d)
description: Overview PR steht vor einem strukturellen Bruch. Vertrauen verschiebt sich, Sichtbarkeit wird neu verteilt, KI wächst exponentiell. Wir bei getpress glauben, dass Reputation in den nächsten zehn Jahren der entscheidende Wettbewerbsvorsprung für Unternehmen wird. Deshalb bauen wir die PR Company der Zukunft. Outcome-getrieben statt Retainer-Stunden. KI-first statt KI-on-top. Automatisiert, wo es skaliert und menschlich, wo es wirklich zählt. Unser über 40-köpfiges Team aus Journalist*innen und PR-Strateg*innen hat seit 2017 die PR für 450+ der spannendsten Wachstumsunternehmen Europas gesteuert – und will mehr. Als PR Teamlead bist du nicht nur senior in deiner eigenen PR-Expertise, sondern gibst dein Wissen weiter, entwickelst erfahrene PR-Köpfe und Nachwuchstalente und trägst Verantwortung für ein wachsendes Kundenportfolio. Bist du dabei? Deine Rolle Als Teamlead arbeitest du nicht mehr selbst operativ auf Kund*innen, sondern ausschließlich über dein Team – dein Impact entsteht durch gute Führung, nicht durch eigene Pitches. Teamentwicklung: Du bist Vorbild und Fels in der Brandung. Mit weekly 1:1s, regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen und individuellen Entwicklungsplänen erkennst du Stärken und Entwicklungspotenziale. Du entwickelst deine Teammitglieder individuell, vom Junior bis zum Senior. Kundenportfolio: Du hast den Überblick über den Status aller Kund*innen im Team, bist strategische Ansprechperson auf Entscheiderebene und erkennst frühzeitig Risiken, ebenso wie Upsell-Potenziale und Wachstumschancen. So sorgst du langfristig für ein gesundes Portfolio in deinem Team. Unternehmerisches Handeln: Dein Team ist eine kleine unternehmerische Einheit innerhalb von getpress: Du triffst strategische Entscheidungen auf Basis von KPIs und steuerst Team- und Kundenplanung. Dabei bist du nicht scheu, Entscheidungen zu treffen, zu priorisieren und zu delegieren. Sales & Recruiting: Du arbeitest punktuell eng mit dem Sales-Team zusammen, etwa bei Neukund*innenpitches. Genauso eng arbeitest du mit People & Culture zusammen, wenn es um Mitarbeiterentwicklung, Onboarding und Recruiting geht. Struktur & Qualität: Du baust Prozesse, die dein Team wirklich braucht, basierend auf den Bedürfnissen, die du erkennst. Du sorgst für gemeinsame Routinen, begleitest das Onboarding und trägst die Verantwortung für die Qualitätssicherung im Team. Wer du bist Du bringst über 4 Jahre Erfahrung in der operativen PR mit (idealerweise im Agenturumfeld) und hast selbst Kund*innen aus dem Mittelstand und vergleichbaren Unternehmensgrößen direkt betreut, weiterentwickelt und nachweislich in deutschen Leit- und Fachmedien platziert. Diese Erfahrung ist deine Basis. Du hast bereits ein Team geführt und weiterentwickelt, disziplinarisch wie fachlich. Idealerweise hast du schon Change-Prozesse begleitet und weißt, wie man ein Team sicher durch Phasen des Wandels führt. Du bringst erprobte Führungsskills, eine hohe emotionale Intelligenz und ein ehrliches Interesse für Menschen und ihre Entwicklung mit. Du denkst unternehmerisch und hast ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für Geschäftsstrategien. KPIs nutzt du bewusst und regelmäßig, um daraus strategische Entscheidungen abzuleiten. Du bist Kommunikator*in durch und durch – im Team hörst du zu und nimmst Menschen mit; extern kommunizierst du souverän mit Kund*innen und Stakeholdern über Hierarchieebenen hinweg, vom CEO bis zum Marketing-Ansprechpartner. Der Einsatz von KI in der PR-Arbeit ist für dich gelebter Alltag, keine Theorie. Du bist neugierig, testest aus, was möglich ist und teilst dein Wissen im Team. Du sprichst Deutsch auf C2-Niveau, kannst auch auf Englisch professionell kommunizieren und lebst in Deutschland. Was dich erwartet Echte PR-Arbeit. Bei uns geht es um echte Pressearbeit, individuell und zielgerichtet. Keine Standard-Pressemitteilungen, sondern individuelles Pitchen bei Journalist*innen in einer breiten Range an Medien. Optimismus. Wir glauben, dass man aus Fehlern lernt und dass eine optimistische Grundhaltung den Unterschied macht. Das merkt man nicht nur in unserem Daily Doing, sondern auch bei spontanen Coffee-Talks oder unseren regelmäßigen Teamevents, ob digital oder vor Ort. Impact. Wir haben hohe Standards an unsere eigene Arbeit, aber auch an die Unternehmen, mit denen wir zusammenarbeiten. Vor allem in Europa gibt es mehr Hidden Champions als sichtbare Erfolgsgeschichten. Das ist die Lücke, die wir schließen wollen. Sparring. Du stehst nie alleine da: Regelmäßiges Sparring gehört bei uns zum Alltag. Mit deiner eigenen Führungskraft, unserer Head of PR, ebenso wie mit anderen Teamleads, dem C-Level oder People & Culture, je nachdem, welches Thema gerade ansteht. Perspektive. Auch als Teamlead lernt man nicht aus. Wir planen langfristig und wollen deine persönliche Entwicklung fördern. Du startest mit einem unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag, und mit unserem Wachstum wächst auch der Raum, dein Wissen einzubringen und mit uns zu lernen. Etwa indem du uns bei Projekten oder der Entwicklung neuer Services unterstützt. Flexibilität. Wir arbeiten hybrid, remote (in DE) oder im Office. Wir haben zwar Kernerreichbarkeitszeiten, aber wann du arbeitest, entscheidest du abgestimmt auf die Bedürfnisse von Team und Kund*innen. Vertrauen, Eigenständigkeit und Kommunikation sind für uns das A und O und sorgen dafür, dass wir Job und Privatleben gut miteinander vereinen können. Benefits und Sweet Treats. Du kannst aus drei frei wählbaren Sachbezügen wählen, von einer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge mit 20% Zuschuss auf deine Einzahlungen profitieren, 180 Tage im Jahr aus dem EU-Ausland arbeiten, dich auf regelmäßige Teamevents freuen. Und das Beste: Du startest mit 27 Urlaubstagen, aber je länger du bei uns bist, desto mehr Urlaubstage bekommst du dazu. Wie gehts weiter? Wenn du jetzt denkst: ,,Klingt nach mir!'', dann bewirb dich ohne Anschreiben bei uns und wer weiß, vielleicht bist du schon schneller als gedacht Teil unseres getpress-Teams! Unsere Kunden – von Privatpersonen über Wirtschaftsunternehmen bis hin zu Hochschulen – profitieren von einem vielseitigen Leistungsportfolio: Seminare, Webinare und Coachings, ergänzt durch individuelle Services wie die Entwicklung und Moderation von Assessment Centern sowie gezielte Outplacement-Begleitung.

Zur Unterstützung unseres Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine/n

Werkstudent (m/w/d) - Karriereberatung, Coaching und Marketing

Arbeitsort: Du unterstützt unser Team, aus dem Homeoffice, regelmäßig vor Ort in unseren Büros in Kaarst oder Düsseldorf und bei gemeinsamen Außenterminen.

Start & Dauer: Gerne ab sofort. Wir wünschen uns eine langfristige Zusammenarbeit, in der Du Dich einbringen, weiterentwickeln und mit uns wachsen kannst.

Aufgaben

Lust auf ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld mit einem offenen Team? Bei uns kannst Du richtig was bewegen – das sind Deine Aufgaben:

  • Du arbeitest aktiv an der Konzeptionierung von kundenspezifischen Führungstrainings mit (Erarbeitung von didaktischen Konzepten, Präsensationen, Übungen)

  • Du machst unseren Karriereblog zur ersten Anlaufstelle für Berufseinsteiger*innen und Aufsteige*rinnen: Mit Themen, die bewegen, und Texten, die hängen bleiben. Dies wird in den nächsten Monaten zu Deinen festen Aufgaben gehören. (noch ist der Blog im Aufbau und nicht sichtbar).

  • Du tauchst tief in aktuelle Trends ein, führst Benchmarks durch und hilfst mit, neue Angebote zu entwickeln, die unsere Kundschaft begeistert. Hierbei arbeitest Du eng mit den Kolleg*innen zusammen.

  • Website, LinkedIn, Instagram? Du gestaltest mit und sorgst dafür, dass unser digitales Gesicht genauso stark ist wie unsere Inhalte. Hierbei kannst Du Deine Ideen einbringen und verwirklichen.

  • Du erstellst und optimierst Bewerbungsunterlagen im Kundenauftrag und arbeitest hierbei mit den Kolleg*innen zusammen.

  • Du wirkst bei Potenzialanalysen, Trainings und Coachings mit – lernst dabei jede Menge über Methoden, Persönlichkeitsprofile und wie man Entwicklung richtig begleitet.

  • Unser Team unterstützt Du in vielfältigen administrativen Aufgaben, wie Korrespondenz, Terminplanung, vorbereitende Buchhaltung und vielem mehr.

Qualifikation

Du absolvierst einen kaufmännischen Studiengang wie z. B. Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder Wirtschaftspsychologie und bist interessiert an dem Thema Personalentwicklung, Coaching und Marketing. Außerdem bringst Du folgende Kenntnisse und Fähigkeiten mit:

  • Du überzeugst uns mit Deiner offenen und sympathischen Persönlichkeit.

  • An Dein vielseitiges Aufgabengebiet gehst Du motiviert und zielstrebig heran. Zudem besitzt Du ein gutes Organisationstalent.

  • Du bringst eine hohe Begeisterungs- und Lernfähigkeit mit und arbeitest Dich selbständig in neue Themen ein.

  • Der Umgang mit KI ist Dir nicht fremd – Du nutzt sie, um Inhalte effizient zu erstellen, Aufgaben smart zu lösen und kreative Prozesse zu unterstützen (falls nicht, lernst Du es bei uns)

  • In der Zusammenarbeit mit Kolleg*innen und Kund*innen überzeugst Du durch Teamgeist, Kommunikationsstärke und ein verbindliches Auftreten.

  • Du arbeitest sicher mit den MS-Office-Programmen.

Benefits

Lust auf eine spannende Herausforderung mit echtem Praxisbezug?

Bei uns bist Du mittendrin statt nur dabei! Du hast direkten Kundenkontakt und erhältst vielfältige Einblicke in die Welt der Karriereberatung und des Coachings. In unserem offenen, hilfsbereiten Team findest Du nicht nur Know-how, sondern auch jede Menge gute Laune.

Du hast Interesse an diesem Werkstudentenjob?

Dann wollen wir Dich kennenlernen! Dein Ansprechpartner Herr Christian Richter erwartet Deine aussagekräftige Bewerbung.

Rückfragen beantwortet Dir Herr Richter gerne telefonisch unter 0211 - 863 94 11.

title: Product Frontend Engineer
description: quinn is becoming the way people employ, across the globe, through one app. quinn is an app-based, managed payroll and employment-administration service. We run it for private households employing a cleaner, nanny, or caretaker, and for businesses that manage employment relationships at scale. The customer stays the legal employer: quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, and handles social insurance, taxes, and filings on their behalf, automated end to end. Where everyone else sells software, quinn sells the outcome. We don't sell payroll software. We run payroll. The purpose behind it is simple: Fair employment. For all. Correct and fair employment, made simple and accessible for any employer and any employee, in any market quinn enters. Where this is going Think about what Revolut did to banking. All of the complexity (the regulation, the clearing, the compliance) handled invisibly in the background, and one simple experience at the front. Nobody using Revolut thinks about what happens behind the screen when they open a new account, swap currencies or send money abroad. It just works, in a couple of taps. Nobody should have to think about it in order to employ someone either. That is what quinn is building, and it is further along than most people assume: a profitable core business, running today in Switzerland, Germany and the UK, expanding into new markets both by launching and by acquiring. By 2030 quinn intends to be the destination brand for fair employment across six countries and more, on one platform, with one experience. One platform means one frontend. One experience means it looks and behaves like quinn whether you are in Zurich or in London, a household or a company. In this strategy that is not a nice-to-have. It is the strategy. Which is why the surface matters more than anything else. Everything quinn does is designed to disappear. The interface is the only part the customer ever sees, and it is the whole proof that the complexity behind it is really handled. Why this role exists Today , quinn runs on several separate web apps: one per product and market, each with its own frontend, grown over the years as the company grew. Our backend engineers built them alongside everything else, plus an internal admin tool that grew the same way. They all work: thousands of employers run payroll through them every month. But nobody was ever tasked with owning the frontend development, so each one got built the way frontend is built by Backend Developers, seen as a hassle rather than the main aspect users interactive with. What comes next is one frontend that replaces all of them, built from scratch: one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, in the browser first, then in the App Store and Google Play from the same work. Alongside it, the frontend of Maestro, the internal tool that replaces the old admin for batch processes. The phone app is the surface that matters most, so everything is built for it from the first screen rather than adapted to it afterwards. That is the opening. How we work We are AI-native, and we mean it operationally rather than as a slogan. AI is how the work gets done here. It is why a small team ships like a large one, and it is a large part of how one person will be able to hold the standard we are describing. We expect you to be at the front of that. Not to have heard of the tools, to live in them, and to build your own leverage with them: scaffolding, visual regression checks, design-token pipelines, whatever takes manual work out of the way. And we expect the judgement that has to come with it. AI writes code that looks right and is subtly wrong: structure that doesn't scale, patterns that fall apart three screens later, components that work once and never again. You take the speed and throw away the rest. AI never lowers the bar here. It is the reason the bar can be this high. Tasks What you will own Everything on the screen: The frontend of the quinn app and the web app. App first. One app for everyone who uses quinn: the employer, the employee, and our own support team working inside the customer's account. The frontend of Maestro, our internal batch tool. Desktop and dense: queues, runs, tables, filters, multi-select, keyboard shortcuts. A different discipline from the app, built on the same components. The component library across quinn Home and quinn Business: one frontend, one experience, every market and every device. Whether the app feels native: response, scrolling, gestures, transitions, biometric login, push. Nothing that gives away it isn't native. The quality of what you ship. Nothing leaves your hands half-finished. Where design ends, engineering begins. We have a design team, and they own how quinn looks and behaves: the flows, the visual design, the tokens, the component specs. You don't design. You own everything from there: how it is built, and everything a design file cannot reasonably specify, such as gestures, keyboard, safe areas, what happens between the drawn breakpoints, the loading, offline, pending and failed states, what a three-line German label does to a layout that was designed for English. You are in the room before design starts, saying what already exists in the library and what a new pattern costs. Not at the end, receiving a handover. When you and design disagree, they decide how it looks and behaves and you decide how it is built. Nothing enters the component library without both of you. Requirements Who we are looking for You care about interfaces more than anyone else in the room. You see the two-pixel misalignment without being told, and it bothers you until it is fixed. You build and maintain UI components and design systems, not one-off screens. You can build a mobile app that feels like one. And you can also build a desktop tool full of tables, filters and keyboard shortcuts, because Maestro is one. You understand UX and how people actually behave, not only how a screen looks. And you write code other people can take over: scalable, structured, documented. Not something that only works while you are in the building. You are independent and decisive. Nobody will spec every detail for you and nobody will review your pixels. You are fluent in English, no other language is required. And if you have a portfolio, a live product, or anything you have shipped that you are proud of, show it to us. Not a requirement, but it tells us more than a CV does. Most importantly: you want this one. Not a frontend role at a company where the frontend is a chore. This one, the app nobody has built yet, the standard nobody has set yet, and a company where getting it right actually decides whether the strategy works. The Team We are a small, fast, direct team. We do not have a lot of process or a lot of hierarchy. We do have a clear strategy, an ambitious plan, and five values we actually mean: Be open, Own it, Speak up, Keep it simple, Bias for action. This is one of the most important hires we will make this year. We are not rushing it and we are not filling a seat. We are looking for the person who reads this and thinks: finally. description: Gestalte die digitale Zukunft von Finance & HR aktiv mit! In einem dynamischen und technologieorientierten Umfeld werden digitale Lösungen entwickelt und betrieben, die einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Modernisierung zentraler gesellschaftlicher Strukturen leisten. Im Mittelpunkt Deiner neuen Aufgabe stehen zwei zentrale Business-Applikationen: Oracle NetSuite und Personio . Beide Systeme sind bereits etabliert und sollen nun weiter stabilisiert, intelligent miteinander vernetzt und kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt werden. Darüber hinaus spielen Automatisierung und der Einsatz künstlicher Intelligenz eine zunehmend wichtige Rolle. Zur Verstärkung des IT-Teams suchen wir eine technisch versierte Persönlichkeit, die Geschäftsprozesse versteht, gerne hands-on arbeitet und die Weiterentwicklung der Systemlandschaft aktiv mitgestalten möchte.. Deine Aufgaben Systemverantwortung & Weiterentwicklung: Du übernimmst die Konfiguration, Administration und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung von Oracle NetSuite und Personio. Dazu gehören unter anderem Workflows, Formulare, Rollen- und Berechtigungskonzepte, Saved Searches sowie Reports. Business Process Management: Gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen Finance, Controlling, Einkauf und HR analysierst Du bestehende Prozesse und Anforderungen und entwickelst passende technische Lösungen – von der Konzeption über die Umsetzung bis zum Go-live. Steuerung externer Dienstleister: Bei komplexeren Entwicklungen und Schnittstellen arbeitest Du mit externen Implementierungspartnern zusammen. Integration & Automatisierung: Du entwickelst die Anbindung der Systeme an weitere Anwendungen weiter und identifizierst Potenziale für Automatisierung und den Einsatz von KI, insbesondere in Finanz- und HR-Prozessen. Berufserfahrung: Du bringst mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der Konfiguration, Administration und Weiterentwicklung von ERP- oder HR-Systemen mit. Idealerweise hast Du bereits mit Oracle NetSuite gearbeitet. Kenntnisse in Personio oder vergleichbaren HR-Systemen sind ebenfalls willkommen. Technisches Know-how: Du verfügst über ein gutes Verständnis von Skripting, beispielsweise JavaScript oder SuiteScript, SQL-Datenbanken und REST-APIs. title: Senior Lead Claims Operations (m/f/x)
description: Who We Are At Progyny Global, part of the Progyny, Inc. family, we're on a mission to make fertility, pregnancy, and family-forming care accessible worldwide. By combining world-class clinical expertise with innovative technology, we deliver inclusive, culturally competent support that helps individuals and families navigate some of life's most important journeys. With Progyny's support and global reach, we're expanding access to care and breaking down barriers so that more people can build the families they want, wherever they are in the world. Role Overview We’re looking for a hands-on Senior Lead Claims Operations to lead our small claims team, strengthen our global claims operations, and drive the development of the tools that support our members and team. Our members come to us during one of the hardest phases of their lives. A fertility journey is physically and emotionally exhausting, and a slow reimbursement or an unclear answer adds stress nobody should have to carry. That is why member experience sits at the heart of every claims process we run: we respond fast, we explain decisions clearly, and we treat every piece of member feedback as important. We want our members to feel the difference to a traditional insurer at every step. This is a player-coach role combining team leadership, operational oversight, and product improvement. You’ll guide and develop the team, manage quality and workload, and continuously improve our processes. You’ll also stay close to daily operations by handling complex or escalated cases, reviewing selected claims, and stepping in during periods of increased demand. Your routine caseload will be significantly smaller than that of a Claims Processor, allowing you to focus where your experience and judgement have the greatest impact. Working closely with the VP Member Experience, Legal, Clinical Operations, and Finance, you’ll help maintain a fair, consistent, and compliant claims framework across our markets. You’ll bring practical judgement to reviewing contracts, invoices, and claims documentation, recognising country-specific requirements and knowing when specialist input is needed. You’ll also drive the continuous development of our internal claims processing tool, member-facing claims submission experience, and wallet in partnership with Product and Engineering. You’ll translate operational and member needs into clear requirements, help prioritise improvements, and ensure new features meet those requirements before launch. We’re looking for a collaborative, pragmatic leader who combines strong analytical skills with precision and attention to detail. You’ll enjoy being close to the work, use data to guide decisions, take ownership of improvements, and understand the impact every claim can have on a member’s journey. What you will do Team leadership and daily operations Lead and develop our claims team through coaching, feedback, and regular quality reviews. Coordinate workloads, priorities, and coverage to meet service levels and maintain a sustainable workload. Handle complex or escalated cases, review selected claims, and support processing during periods of increased demand. Define clear targets and SLAs for the team, such as turnaround times, processing accuracy, and member satisfaction. Track them continuously, report on progress to the VP Member Experience, and drive measurable improvements quarter over quarter. Process improvement and member experience Use operational data and team insights to identify recurring issues and improve workflows across markets and product lines. Maintain consistent claims decisions, clear documentation, and effective escalation and quality-assurance processes. Ensure members receive accurate, timely, and empathetic communication throughout the claims journey. Claims products, wallet, automation and AI Drive improvements to our internal claims processing tool, member-facing claims submission experience, and wallet with Product and Engineering, and identify where AI can make claims work faster and more accurate. Define product requirements and acceptance criteria, including where AI may support a decision and where human review remains mandatory, and help prioritise enhancements based on member needs, operational impact, data protection, and risk. Coordinate user acceptance testing, validate features before launch, and prepare the team through updated workflows and training. Monitor results after launch, including the quality and accuracy of AI outputs, and drive further improvements. Claims framework, regulatory requirements, and controls Review provider contracts, invoices, and claims documentation for market-specific contractual and regulatory requirements, involving Legal, Clinical Operations, or Finance where needed. Maintain the claims framework and translate agreed requirements into practical workflows, controls, and guidance. Partner with Finance on payment accuracy and reconciliation, support audits, and address control or compliance gaps. Requirements At least 5 years of experience in claims, healthcare benefits, reimbursement, insurance operations, or a related field, including three years coordinating or leading a team. Hands-on expertise in complex claims, quality assurance, operational controls, and financial reconciliation. Hands-on experience using AI tools in your daily work, ideally in operational workflows such as document processing or case handling, with a clear sense of where human judgement and data protection require oversight. Experience reviewing contracts, invoices, and claims documentation against market-specific contractual and regulatory requirements, recognising when specialist input is needed. Experience defining product requirements with Product and Engineering, testing new features, and supporting operational rollouts. Experience improving processes and managing competing priorities in a fast-paced environment, ideally within a technology company or scale-up. Strong analytical skills, precision, and attention to detail, using operational KPIs to guide decisions and improvements. Clear communication, sound judgement, and a collaborative, empathetic leadership style focused on the member experience. Professional fluency in English. Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent

YOUR IMPACT

  • Shape the future of Proxima’s simulation platform: we design and develop the platform; stellarator researchers and engineers use it to mature the design of Alpha and Stellaris; you will imagine and build with us novel solutions for simulation tools that spark joy and reduce time-to-insight

  • Accelerate Stellarator R&D, at the company at its forefront: we work side by side with researchers and engineers to ensure what we build immediately boosts the speed Proxima Fusion’s Stellarator design program

WHAT YOU WILL DO

You will join the Simulation Platform Team, a software platform team that balances development of core products with direct support to researchers, adapting to the Stellarator design program’s strategy and priorities. In your first six months you will e.g. add features to our in-house simulation pipeline automation system and ensure that AI agents can work with it efficiently.

  • On the platform engineering side you will design, develop and maintain next-generation software solutions for stellarator simulation and design, targeted to human and agentic use; for example:

    • Python libraries enabling automation of large-scale simulation workflows

    • cloud-based data storage that keeps everyone in sync

    • web applications that foster cross-domain collaboration and knowledge discovery

    • integration of AI tools where they actually provide leverage

  • You will also work together with our researchers to apply our tools to specific use cases, working as an internally-deployed Research Software Engineer: you will guide users to make the most of the available simulation tooling and proactively co-develop applications that unblock their R&D program, while gathering precious feedback and ideas for the next platform improvements

WHO YOU ARE

  • We are looking for a software practitioner with a user-first mindset, interested in tackling a diverse mix of challenges: from the optimization of scientific computing workflows to building cloud- and web-based systems for data management, sharing and exploration

  • Proficient in Python

  • You enjoy staying up to date with current software development best practices and tools, e.g. agentic development or modern data pipelines and scheduling solutions

  • You enjoy diving into new problems with a continuous learning attitude, absorbing relevant domain knowledge in a dynamic start-up environment; no fusion background needed, familiarity with scientific software use cases is a plus

  • Familiarity with one or more of the following is desirable but not required: full-stack web development (React, TypeScript, FastAPI), Pydantic, JAX, cloud services and cloud-based applications; data management systems

  • You don't need to tick every box. If this role excites you, please apply

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30-45 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

description: Le Groupe QUALTECH - 5 sociétés, 7 sites et 350 salariés - est un regroupement de Laboratoires spécialisés dans les analyses de laboratoire (microbiologie, biologie moléculaire, chimie, extraction d’ADN, etc), le conseil, la recherche et la formation. Notre but est de garantir une expertise qualitative à nos clients en termes de contrôle, de qualité et de fiabilité dans le secteur del’agro-alimentaire. En rejoignant son laboratoire AGROBIO spécialisé en microbiologie, vous participez à son expertise dans le monde de la recherche et de l’analyse agro-alimentaire Vos missions Dans le cadre d'un renforcement d'équipe dans notre laboratoire AGROBIO, nous vous attendons pour prélever des échantillons (alimentaires, d’eau et de surface) et réaliser des audits dans les cuisines de nos clients situés dans la région de LYON (départements 69 42 26 01 38 42 43 et ponctuellement 73 74 71). Vous allez avoir l'opportunité de rencontrer les différents acteurs locaux et de découvrir leur activité, qu'ils soient spécialisés dans la restauration collective (crèches, lycées, maisons de retraite, restaurants d'entreprise, armé, etc.) ou plus traditionnelle. Vous êtes le 1er maillon de cette longue chaîne menant à une analyse de haute fiabilité grâce à la collaboration de chacun. Derrière vous, une équipe logistique présente à tout moment pour vous aider, des techniciens de laboratoire impatients de traiter vos échantillons et des clients à rassurer sur leurs bonnes pratiques vis-à-vis du grand public. Et avec vous des outils de travail : un véhicule de service, une carte d’essence et de télépéage, un téléphone, une tablette ainsi que des paniers repas. description: Du studierst und willst mehr als einen „Nebenjob“? Du willst Verantwortung, klare Ziele und ein Umfeld, in dem Leistung zählt? Dann ist diese Werkstudentenrolle dein Einstieg in die Finanzberatung, mit strukturiertem Onboarding, Coaching und einem klaren Weg in ein Trainee-Programm. Diese Rolle ist unternehmerisch geprägt und bietet dir die Möglichkeit, dich aktiv einzubringen, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und dich fachlich wie persönlich weiterzuentwickeln. Leistung und Eigeninitiative spielen dabei eine zentrale Rolle, gleichzeitig wirst du durch strukturiertes Onboarding, Coaching und ein erfahrenes Team unterstützt. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C1+) sind erforderlich, da die Ausbildung, die Kommunikation im Team sowie die Perspektive Richtung IHK vollständig auf Deutsch stattfinden. Dein Aufgabenbereich Startphase (erste Wochen): Terminaufbau: Du vereinbarst Kundentermine (Telefon, Netzwerk, Leads) und baust eine saubere Pipeline auf. Prozesslernen: Du lernst Gesprächsleitfäden, Bedarfsermittlung, Nachbereitung und Dokumentationsstandards. Performance-Optimierung: Du arbeitest mit KPIs, bekommst Feedback und verbesserst systematisch deine Ergebnisse. Im weiteren Verlauf: Analyse & Vorbereitung: Du unterstützt bei der Analyse von Kundensituationen und bereitest Beratungsunterlagen strukturiert vor. Kundenkontakt: Du begleitest Gespräche (je nach Stand), übernimmst Follow-ups und sorgst für klare nächste Schritte. title: (Senior) Product Owner | Full Time (m/w/d)
description: Who Are We ? 🚧 Picture logistics that run like clockwork – fast, smart, and seamless. Autonomous logistics does not start with self-driving trucks. It starts with CONROO. At CONROO, we are building an intelligent infrastructure that drives terminals and depots towards autonomy by connecting truck drivers, terminals, and depots through continuous data flows. We replace manual and paper-based processes with real-time, data-driven workflows, turning chaos into connected systems and making truck handling fully digital. Every step we automate today lays the foundation for terminals and depots to operate autonomously tomorrow. We are CONROO and we are driving logistics to autonomy. 💼 About This Role As a (Senior) Product Owner at CONROO, you'll be one of the people steering where our product goes next. You'll spend time with customers and stakeholders to really understand what they need, then turn that into requirements the team can actually build from. You'll work closely with our developers day to day, answering questions, and making calls when priorities need to shift. It's a role with real ownership in the sense that what you decide matters, and you'll see it show up in the product. 🎖 What Success Looks Like In your first month You become familiar with the company, product, development process, customers, and key business areas and projects. You work closely with Tech, Sales, and other teams to understand customer needs, business objectives, and product priorities. You join Scrum ceremonies and observe how requirements and priorities are managed. You align and guide a cross-functional team. Setting clear priorities, offering direction, and helping people do their best work. By 3 months You analyse and manage project requirements and stakeholder demands. You independently create, prioritize, and maintain the product backlog based on customer needs and business objectives. You take ownership of user stories, acceptance criteria, and product requirements. You take an active role in Scrum management and coordination. You ensure our product meets UX standards, quality standards, and relevant regulatory requirements. You will communicate product vision, goals, priorities, and progress to internal and external stakeholders. You communicate directly with customers and stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into actionable requirements. You will have full ownership of assigned projects and topics and manage them with increasing autonomy. By 6 months You independently manage projects and requirements from initial stage through implementation. You have full ownership of Scrum processes and ensure effective collaboration and communication across teams. You proactively identify customer needs, product opportunities, risks, and areas for improvement. You contribute significantly to product development and prioritisation. You consistently improve project management, requirements management, and quality processes where needed. You operate autonomously while keeping relevant stakeholders aligned and informed. You become the trusted point of contact for product-related topics across Tech, Sales, and other teams. 🚀 What You Need to Be Successful You have a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Business Informatics, Information Technology, or a related field. You bring 5+ years of experience as a Product Owner in a SaaS environment. You have experience working with SCRUM and agile development processes. You have experience in specifying requirements and developing user and technical stories. You possess a solid understanding of technology, software development, and digital products. You quickly grasp complex processes & technical requirements allowing you to create tailored solutions that deliver value for both clients and the business. You bring strong communication skills and are confident working with a wide range of stakeholders, from C-level executives and internal teams to customers. You bring strong organizational skills and are comfortable managing and prioritizing multiple requirements. You are fluent in both German and English. You are based in Nuremberg, Munich, or the surrounding area and are able to work from our Nuremberg or Munich office at least three days per week. ⚙️ Must Have Tools & Technologies You have experience working with Jira or similar project management tools. You are familiar with Figma or similar design and collaboration tools. You have experience working with CRM systems. 💡It’s a Plus If You Have Previous experience in the logistics industry. Experience working in a startup or scale-up environment. 🌟 How We Set You Up to Be Successful At CONROO, we don’t just define what success looks like – we actively support you in getting there through a structured, hands-on onboarding process during your first six months with us. Onboarding sessions with your manager and our Head of Product and Engineering Alex, to understand your role, goals, and priorities. Onboarding sessions with our COO, Ksenia and CEO, Felix, to learn about CONROO’s vision, strategy, and business. HR onboarding with our People Partner, Hind, covering our values, tools, policies, and processes. Product onboarding with our Product Owner, Özgür. A buddy system during your first two months to help you onboard smoothly, get up to speed, and have a go-to person for questions. Clear goals for your first 1, 3, and 5 months, with expectations defined from day one so you know how success is measured. We know that starting a new role can be overwhelming. That’s why we provide clear documentation, a structured to-do list, and role-specific materials to help you get up to speed quickly. 👥 About Our Team We’re a team of around 30 curious minds working from our offices in Munich and Nuremberg – and remotely across Germany. We value ownership and a mindset driven by continuous learning. We take ideas seriously, see them through, and aren’t afraid to roll up our sleeves when challenges arise. As we grow, we keep raising the bar, looking for smarter, better ways to work – and have fun in the process together along the way. 🤝Why Us 💫 A mission that matters: Be part of a company that’s working on something meaningful and a purpose you can stand behind. 🏝️ Workation: Switch up your usual scenery and spend up to 30 days working remotely from a different location. 🎉 CONROO Time Off : Some moments deserve more than a celebration! Enjoy extra days off for special milestones like your birthday, wedding, or welcoming a new family member. 👊 Witness your actions shape our direction: You’re given the ownership and trust to make decisions that matter and the results are visible. 🏔️ Company getaway: Two annual team getaways where we work, unwind, and connect – away from the office. We went to the Austrian Alps last year, where should we go next? 🏢 Multiple office locations: Join us in one of our vibrant offices in Munich, Nuremberg, or Duisburg. 🎟️ Employee discounts: Use our employee discount portal to access attractive deals from top brands across tech, travel, fashion, home, and more – online and in-store. 🌍 International team: With 10 nationalities across a team of around 30 people, you’ll be part of a naturally diverse environment where different perspectives come together. 🧠 Hungry for knowledge? raw.jobDescription:
Hi there! We are Testlio, a global software testing company with its own freelance network. Our freelancers test apps from companies across the globe. Testlio is a great place for people who value the freedom and flexibility of remote work.

At the moment, we are looking for freelance software testers based in Réunion or Monaco to participate in a software testing project for one of our clients, a globally know premier sporting league based out of the United States. We're currently in the process of testing out their app and subscription flow, and we'd love to welcome you as part of the testing team.

Benefits of being a freelancer at Testlio

  • Schedule: You can create your schedule and work on other testing runs that interest you.
  • Location: Testlio is a 100% remote company. Seriously, you can work from the coffee shop, your home, or while waiting for class.
  • Growth: You’ll be testing global-scale mobile apps and have the chance to boost your skills and grow your career.
  • Payment: You are paid by the hour, not by the bug. This means you get paid even if you did not uncover any bugs.

Requirements

  • Age: You have to be at least 18 years old.
  • Location: Must be physically located in Réunion or Monaco. The use of a VPN is prohibited.
  • Language: Must at least be comfortable speaking English.
  • Availability: Approximately 1h total for the setup + 90 minutes for the testing task, spread over a couple of days.
  • Devices: Laptop/ PC
  • Experience: No experience needed, we can provide training and instructions.

What does testing look like?

  • Type of testing: Payments testing.
  • Type of work: You will be asked to test out our client's subscription flow to make sure that it works accurately in your country.
  • Tasks: For this workspace, we will be validating our client's overall subscription flow. The workspace will be divided into 3 parts:
    • You will be invited to participate in a paid project onboarding, where you can check the details and documentation prior to testing
    • You will receive a pre-payment from us that will be used in the next stage of the workspace, approximately $20 - $25 USD.
    • You will be asked to use the pre-payment amount to help us test our client's subscription purchase.
  • Pay rate: $18 USD / h.
  • Payment: Payment will be made via PayPal or Payoneer.

How to start?

  1. Fill out the questionnaire. A member of our Recruitment Team will contact you with the next steps via email.
  2. If you are not a match with our requirements visit our Community page instead to find out more about how you can participate in other projects.

If you have any questions or need help, please contact Opportunities@testlio.com using the code FRENCHPAYMENTS in the Subject line/email body so we can quickly identify your request.

Once you are ready, please fill out the initial application below. Those who meet the requirements will receive further information to participate in this paid testing opportunity.

title: Senior Software Engineer

description:

From Manchester to New York, we’re powered by a team of over 2500 people who work together, lead by example, and think BIG.  

With us, you’ll go further, faster. What are you waiting for? 

Life at THG Nutrition

THG Nutrition is home to some of the world’s most trusted and best-loved wellbeing and nutrition brands, including Myprotein, the world’s largest online sports nutrition brand, alongside Myvegan, Myvitamins and MP Activewear.

Our brands and people exist to break boundaries — to power and empower those who want more. We move fast, challenge convention, and back ourselves to win. These values shape how we work every day.

Role: Senior Assistant Merchandiser 
Brand: Myprotein
Reporting to: Merchandising Manager
Location: THG ICON 1, 7-9 Sunbank Lane, WA15 0AF (fully office based)

We are seeking a highly organised, analytical, and proactive Senior Assistant Merchandiser to join the MP Activewear Clothing team. This role supports the merchandising function through delivering reporting and analysis that drives key business KPIs, while helping to manage intake and optimise stock performance. The successful candidate will also support the development of junior team members and contribute to the overall success of the team.
You will work closely with the Merchandiser and wider teams to help drive sales performance through assisting with range planning, while maintaining strong control over intake and managing key intake deliverables.

  • Strong commercial awareness, numerical and analytical skills, with excellent attention to detail.
  • Highly organised, proactive and able to manage multiple priorities independently.
  • Confident communicator with strong problem-solving skills.
  • Strong IT skills, particularly Excel.
  • Positive, self-motivated team player with a continuous improvement mindset 

What’s in it for me? 

Career Development 

  • Access bespoke development programmes that have been designed and developed by our in-house L&D team. 
  • Continued development through our upskilling programme that is delivered in partnership with an industry-leading training provider. 

Enhanced Leave 

  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays. 
  • Don’t want to work on your birthday? We don’t either! Enjoy your day off on us! 
  • Enhanced maternity and paternity pay, depending on length of service.  
  • Up to 10 days compassionate leave. 
  • Buy back up to 3 days each year. 
  • Unlock 2 days volunteer leave after 12-months. 

Wellbeing Support 

  • Access face-to-face and virtual appointments with our in-house GP.
     
  • Access our 247 Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) which is provided by Bupa.  
  • State-of-the-art on-site gym.

Other Perks 

  • Save up to 12% on the cost of personal tech through our salary sacrifice scheme. 
  • Subsidised bus pass from Manchester City Centre to our ICON office.  
  • Up to 50% staff discount on THG brands. 

  • On-site staff shop.
     
  • Know someone who would be perfect for THG? Refer them and get up to £1000 when they pass their probation. 
  • Anniversary gifts when you hit 5 and 10 years of service. 

THG is proud to be a Disability Confident Committed employer. If you are invited to interview, please let us know if there are any reasonable adjustments we can make to the recruitment process that will enable you to perform to the best of your ability.

raw.description:
About Seamflow

Every plane, medical device, lift, battery and building has to be tested, inspected and certified before it reaches the world. It's the invisible layer that keeps the physical economy safe, and it still runs on Word documents, PDFs, spreadsheets and email. Seamflow is the software layer for that industry. We build AI-powered workflows for certification bodies, notified bodies and inspection companies: scheduling and resource planning, technical review, conformity assessment, field inspection, and document intelligence over messy real-world files.

Where we are:

  • Live in production inside some of the largest enterprises in the industry

  • $4.5M seed, 14x oversubscribed, co-led by Northzone and Initialized Capital, the funds behind Spotify, Klarna, Coinbase and Reddit. Angels include Charlie Songhurst and Mario Götze.

  • Demand is outstripping what we can build. That's the reason this role exists.

The team

Most of our engineers were olympiad medallists in maths, physics or informatics before they were engineers. The team has come to us from Google, Amazon, X, Yandex, McKinsey and Bain, and from founding-engineer seats at startups that went on to multi-billion-dollar valuations. We hire against a very high bar, and this role exists to raise it further.

The role

A Front End Design Engineer thinks in finished interfaces, not mockups or components in isolation. A technical reviewer at a notified body spends their day inside a 400-page technical file, cross-referencing clauses, checking test reports against standards, and deciding whether a medical device is safe to sell. Today they do that in Word, Acrobat and a spreadsheet someone built in 2011. The interface they use decides how fast they work and whether they trust the AI sitting next to them.

You own that interface. Layout, typography, interaction, motion, the design system underneath it, and the React that ships it. You decide how a reviewer sees a finding, how they correct a model that got it wrong, and how a hundred fields of dense regulatory data become something a person can actually read. You sketch it, build it, ship it, then sit next to someone using it and find out what you got wrong. You'll ship to production in your first week.

What we're looking for

We care far more about taste and engineering strength than about matching a list of tools. If you're excellent, we'll hire you whether you've spent the last three years in React, Svelte, Vue or something we haven't heard of. Our stack is learnable in a fortnight. Judgement, craft and speed are not.

What we're actually screening for:

  • You've designed and built an interface that real people used every day. Not a Dribbble shot, not a component library nobody adopted. Something that shipped, got used, and got better.

  • You have taste, and you can defend it. Typography, spacing, motion, hierarchy. You notice when something is a few pixels off and you can explain why it matters.

  • You build the whole thing. Design, frontend, the state and data it sits on. You don't hand the code to someone else once the Figma is done, and you don't hand the design to someone else once the code is.

  • You can design for density. Expert users, complex workflows, hundreds of fields on a screen. Making that clear is much harder than making a landing page beautiful.

  • You go to the source. You'll watch a technical reviewer work through a real file, and you'll design for what they actually do rather than what the process diagram says.

Signals we like, none of them required:

design engineering or front-end roles at somewhere like Linear, Vercel, Notion or Figma, a design system you built and maintained, work on interfaces where people review or correct AI output, founder or ex-founder, founding team experience, EF / YC / Antler, early or stealth-stage startup.

This is probably not for you if

  • You want a strict boundary between work and life. We run one of the most ambitious startup cultures in Europe: fast paced, extremely high ownership, and in person in Shoreditch.

  • You want a well-defined ticket handed to you each morning.

  • You want to specialise narrowly and stay in your lane.

What you get

  • Real equity, and compensation that reflects a high bar

  • Genuine ownership of product surface area from day one, with the founders in the room

  • Relocation support and visa sponsorship, handled properly

  • Lunch and dinner covered, 24/7 gym access, and any tool that makes you faster

  • A small team with high standards, high trust, and no politics

If this sounds like your kind of problem, apply. A short note on the hardest thing you've built goes further with us than a polished CV.

Experience mentoring engineers and raising the engineering bar across organizations through technical leadership and operational excellence. Drive long-term technical strategy across critical product areas, balancing immediate delivery needs with scalability, operational excellence, and platform sustainability. Product systems that scale reliably across platforms, enterprise environments, and growing customer complexity. raw.jobDescription:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

We are hiring a Principal Engineer to help define the technical direction for core product experiences at 1Password.

This is a senior individual contributor role for an engineer who can translate ambitious product strategy into systems that scale technically and operationally. You will drive architecture, engineering standards, and technical direction across the product ecosystem, working across client applications, distributed services, data platforms, and shared infrastructure to build experiences that are secure, reliable, performant, and maintainable.This is not a role scoped to a single team or subsystem. The expectation is organization-level technical leadership: shaping how Product Engineering approaches complex cross-cutting problems, guiding long-term architectural investments, and establishing the technical patterns and operational standards other teams build against.

You will operate across the full lifecycle of product engineering work, from architecture and system design through production operations and long-term evolution. Success in this role requires balancing product velocity with engineering durability, making pragmatic technical tradeoffs, and driving alignment across teams with different priorities and constraints.

You will help evolve the next generation of 1Password’s product architecture, including the responsible integration of AI capabilities into core product experiences. Security and privacy by default, cross-platform consistency, operational resilience, and enterprise-scale reliability are foundational requirements that must be reflected in every architectural decision.

If you want to build systems used daily by millions of individuals and hundreds of thousands of businesses, and solve engineering problems where distributed systems, reliability, usability, security, and intelligent automation all matter simultaneously, this is that role.

How we’re using AI today

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.

This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

What we're looking for:

  • You have designed and operated large-scale distributed systems where reliability, scalability, maintainability, and operational excellence matter.

  • You have deep experience driving architecture and technical direction across multiple teams, organizations, or product domains.

  • You have strong systems-thinking instincts and can reason effectively about platform boundaries, distributed systems constraints, developer ergonomics, and long-term technical sustainability.

  • You have experience building customer-facing product systems across clients, APIs, distributed services, cloud infrastructure, and data platforms.

  • You have experience building or scaling event-driven systems, microservices architectures, or shared platform infrastructure in production environments.

  • You have practical experience integrating AI or ML capabilities into production applications and understand the engineering tradeoffs involved in introducing AI into trust-sensitive product experiences.

  • You have strong instincts for privacy-preserving and security-conscious system design, including thoughtful handling of telemetry, user data, permissions, and auditability.

  • You are effective at driving alignment across teams with different incentives, priorities, and technical perspectives.

  • You communicate clearly with engineers, executives, and cross-functional partners, and can explain complex technical tradeoffs in practical terms.

  • You are comfortable operating in ambiguity and helping organizations make durable technical decisions before every variable is known.

Bonus points for:

  • Experience in identity, authentication, authorization, secrets management, enterprise security, or trust-oriented product domains.

  • Experience building large-scale event-driven or multi-region distributed systems in cloud environments.

  • Experience building cross-platform applications or shared platform architectures at scale.

  • Experience with developer platforms, internal engineering frameworks, CI/CD systems, or large-scale infrastructure modernization initiatives.

  • Experience integrating LLMs or AI-assisted workflows into customer-facing SaaS applications.

  • Experience with endpoint trust, browser or extension security, enterprise administration workflows, or device posture systems.

  • Experience mentoring engineers and raising the engineering bar across organizations through technical leadership and operational excellence.

What you can expect:

  • Define architecture and technical direction for core product capabilities spanning clients, distributed services, data platforms, and shared infrastructure.

  • Establish engineering standards and reusable architectural patterns for scalable, maintainable, and resilient product systems across Product Engineering.

  • Drive long-term technical strategy across critical product areas, balancing immediate delivery needs with scalability, operational excellence, and platform sustainability.

  • Partner closely with Product, Design, Security, Privacy, Infrastructure, and Data teams to ensure technical decisions support both customer outcomes and long-term operational durability.

  • Guide how AI-powered capabilities are integrated into customer-facing product experiences, ensuring systems are reliable, observable, operationally safe, and aligned with customer trust expectations.

  • Define engineering expectations for AI-enabled product systems, including evaluation frameworks, rollout safety, telemetry, fallback behavior, auditability, and operational controls.

  • Establish shared platform capabilities and infrastructure patterns that allow teams to build product features consistently across clients, services, APIs, and AI-assisted workflows.

  • Influence and drive key architectural decisions around distributed systems design, event-driven architectures, synchronization models, scalability, performance, reliability, extensibility, and platform interoperability.

  • Help teams navigate difficult technical tradeoffs, unblock large cross-functional initiatives, and reduce systemic engineering complexity across the organization.

  • Raise the operational bar for production systems through stronger reliability practices, observability standards, incident readiness, performance analysis, and engineering discipline.

  • Mentor and influence engineers across the organization through technical leadership, architecture reviews, design guidance, and hands-on problem solving.

What success looks like:
Success in this role means Product Engineering can scale product development without sacrificing reliability, maintainability, security, or customer trust. That includes:

  • Durable architectural patterns that enable teams to move faster with less duplication and lower operational overhead.

  • Product systems that scale reliably across platforms, enterprise environments, and growing customer complexity.

  • Engineering teams making more consistent technical decisions with clearer standards and stronger shared foundations.

  • AI-powered product experiences that are useful, measurable, trustworthy, and operationally safe.

  • Reduced systemic friction across development, delivery, observability, and cross-team coordination.

  • Stronger operational resilience, including improved reliability, debuggability, rollout safety, and incident response readiness.

  • Technical investments that improve long-term engineering velocity instead of creating organizational drag or platform fragmentation.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process.

We believe in the power of remote work, but recognize that in-person connection is important to help us achieve our mission. While we are a remote-first company, travel for in-person engagement is a part of almost all roles, and we require our employees to be ready and willing to take part. Frequency will depend on role and responsibilities, and may include, but is not limited to: annual department-wide offsites, team meetings, and customer/industry events.

Health and wellbeing
👶 Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
🩺 Competitive health benefits
🏝 Generous PTO policy

Growth and future

🌎 Remote-first work environment

Accommodation is available upon request at any point during our recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please speak to your talent acquisition partner or email us at nextbit@agilebits.com and we’ll work to meet your needs.

You'll own projects, collaborate with stakeholders, and design robust systems to deliver important functionality and measurably improve the experience for our partners and customers. The company Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don't wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that's as flexible and responsive as they are. That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed. We've already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive. The team iwoca partners with a variety of third-party platforms, ranging from large banks and comparison sites to small fintechs that serve SME customers. These partners use iwoca’s Lending API to embed iwoca loans into their own customer journey. Partnerships are an important and fast-growing source of customers for iwoca. The Partner Flow team builds new features and optimises existing flows to provide the best possible experience for iwoca's partners and the customers they refer to us. The team’s responsibilities include: Continually improving our Lending API and other developer tools, so that partners can integrate with iwoca quickly and easily. Adding new functionality to facilitate deeper integrations and ensure iwoca is the best embedded finance provider on the market. Improving the conversion rate of customers who come to us through partners - streamlining the journey, running RCTs (randomised control trials) and building models alongside our embedded data scientist to find what works. The team is made up of three engineers, a data scientist plus a team lead, working closely with an internal team of commercial stakeholders. This role is one of two new engineering hires as we grow the team to meet our ambition. Partner Flow is remote/hybrid-friendly, meeting up for team days in the office once or twice a month, but not on a fixed schedule. They work in an Agile fashion with two-week sprints and a daily standup. The role You’ll work on challenging projects all over iwoca’s codebase - anywhere there are improvements to be made for partners and partner-referred customers. You’ll be encouraged to bring your own ideas and take responsibility for areas of functionality. Autonomy: Own features and projects from scoping and design through to production. Collaborate with other engineers to meet the team’s goals, whilst being trusted to define your own solutions and work independently on your part of the problem. Design and maintain robust, flexible, and maintainable systems to ensure scalability and fast-paced development. Impact: Deliver new functionality critical to onboarding important new partners. Run experiments (RCTs) and optimise the funnel to measurably improve how partner-referred customers convert. Leave code, docs, and processes in better shape than you found them. Purpose and product thinking: Work on systems that genuinely help businesses get the funding they need. Collaborate with our partners and internal stakeholders to design effective solutions. Use data to make decisions, uncover insights, and refine strategies. AI: We're pushing hard on AI-assisted development. Engineers here write clear technical specs, let skills and agents implement boiler-plate, and hold a high bar on code review — the person, not the model, is accountable for what merges. We expect AI output to be validated for correctness, performance and security like any other change. We give the team unlimited tokens across all models and expect people to experiment. The requirements Essential: Experience designing and building scalable back-end systems, ideally in Python. Experience working with relational databases, ideally PostgreSQL, with an understanding of performance and maintainability considerations. Experience building and maintaining APIs that are easy to use, reliable, and well-documented. Experience managing projects end to end, from understanding business problems to designing and delivering technical solutions. Pragmatism in balancing delivery speed with long-term system health. Clear, concise written and verbal communication, focusing on outcomes and impact. A genuine team player: you support your teammates, share knowledge, and care about the team's success as much as your own. AI fluency. Experience using AI coding tools to accelerate real delivery, and a genuine interest in getting better at it - with a pragmatic sense of where it adds value and where it doesn't. Bonus: Front-end development experience, particularly with React and Typescript. Experience with DevOps practices, including containerisation and CI/CD pipelines. Experience with experimentation (e.g. A/B tests or RCTs) or using data to drive product decisions.
