raw.title: Backend Engineer - Partner Flow
raw.description:
Backend Engineer - Partner Flow Team

Hybrid in London / Remote within the UK

We’re looking for a Backend Engineer to join the Partner Flow team.

This role is a chance to shape how thousands of small businesses find their way to iwoca. You'll join the team that owns iwoca's partner integrations — the Lending API and embedded flows that let third-party platforms, from major banks to fintechs, offer iwoca loans inside their own customer journeys. You'll own projects, collaborate with stakeholders, and design robust systems to deliver important functionality and measurably improve the experience for our partners and customers.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don't wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that's as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We've already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

iwoca partners with a variety of third-party platforms, ranging from large banks and comparison sites to small fintechs that serve SME customers. These partners use iwoca’s Lending API to embed iwoca loans into their own customer journey. Partnerships are an important and fast-growing source of customers for iwoca.

The Partner Flow team builds new features and optimises existing flows to provide the best possible experience for iwoca's partners and the customers they refer to us. The team’s responsibilities include:

  • Continually improving our Lending API and other developer tools, so that partners can integrate with iwoca quickly and easily.

  • Adding new functionality to facilitate deeper integrations and ensure iwoca is the best embedded finance provider on the market.

  • Improving the conversion rate of customers who come to us through partners - streamlining the journey, running RCTs (randomised control trials) and building models alongside our embedded data scientist to find what works.

The team is made up of three engineers, a data scientist plus a team lead, working closely with an internal team of commercial stakeholders. This role is one of two new engineering hires as we grow the team to meet our ambition.

Partner Flow is remote/hybrid-friendly, meeting up for team days in the office once or twice a month, but not on a fixed schedule. They work in an Agile fashion with two-week sprints and a daily standup.

The role

You’ll work on challenging projects all over iwoca’s codebase - anywhere there are improvements to be made for partners and partner-referred customers. You’ll be encouraged to bring your own ideas and take responsibility for areas of functionality.

Autonomy:

  • Own features and projects from scoping and design through to production.

  • Collaborate with other engineers to meet the team’s goals, whilst being trusted to define your own solutions and work independently on your part of the problem.

  • Design and maintain robust, flexible, and maintainable systems to ensure scalability and fast-paced development.

Impact:

  • Deliver new functionality critical to onboarding important new partners.

  • Run experiments (RCTs) and optimise the funnel to measurably improve how partner-referred customers convert.

  • Leave code, docs, and processes in better shape than you found them.

Purpose and product thinking:

  • Work on systems that genuinely help businesses get the funding they need.

  • Collaborate with our partners and internal stakeholders to design effective solutions.

  • Use data to make decisions, uncover insights, and refine strategies.

AI:

  • We're pushing hard on AI-assisted development. Engineers here write clear technical specs, let skills and agents implement boiler-plate, and hold a high bar on code review — the person, not the model, is accountable for what merges. We expect AI output to be validated for correctness, performance and security like any other change.

  • We give the team unlimited tokens across all models and expect people to experiment.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Experience designing and building scalable back-end systems, ideally in Python.

  • Experience working with relational databases, ideally PostgreSQL, with an understanding of performance and maintainability considerations.

  • Experience building and maintaining APIs that are easy to use, reliable, and well-documented.

  • Experience managing projects end to end, from understanding business problems to designing and delivering technical solutions.

  • Pragmatism in balancing delivery speed with long-term system health.

  • Clear, concise written and verbal communication, focusing on outcomes and impact.

  • A genuine team player: you support your teammates, share knowledge, and care about the team's success as much as your own.

  • AI fluency. Experience using AI coding tools to accelerate real delivery, and a genuine interest in getting better at it - with a pragmatic sense of where it adds value and where it doesn't.

Bonus:

  • Front-end development experience, particularly with React and Typescript.

  • Experience with DevOps practices, including containerisation and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Experience with experimentation (e.g. A/B tests or RCTs) or using data to drive product decisions.

  • Working knowledge of modern data tooling - ideally Snowflake and dbt - used to build analytical or reporting pipelines.

The salary

We expect to pay from £60,000—£85,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

title: Sr. Staff Machine Learning Systems Engineer
description: Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve. Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals . About the Role: How do we make advanced AI/ML not just powerful but trustworthy enough to run in a regulated healthcare environment? We're looking for a Senior Staff engineer who can own that question end to end: the data pipelines that feed our models and evaluations, and the evaluation infrastructure — judges, scorers, statistical regression gates, red-team testing — that decides whether AI models are effective and safe to ship to patients. This is a leadership role for someone who works comfortably across disciplines. You'll set technical direction for how we build, version, and trust the data and judgments that our AI products are evaluated against. Your scope will expand from raw data ingestion and feature/dataset pipelines, through evaluation methodology and statistical rigor, to the reporting surfaces that let clinical and product teams act on what we learn. You'll spend most of your time on problems that don't have an existing playbook: ambiguous, cross-team, and genuinely hard to reason about. The job is to bring clarity to that ambiguity, chart a path the rest of the team and organization can follow, and see it through from idea to production, building the relationships and buy-in along the way to make it stick. You Will: Own the evaluation as a whole, not just a slice of it Set the technical direction for our evaluation systems; metric, judge and scorer design, the statistical methodology behind regression decisions, and the infrastructure that tracks and categorizes failures over time. Design and scale the data pipelines — ingestion, transformation, dataset versioning, labeling and calibration workflows — that both evaluation and downstream data science work depend on. Proactively address challenges in scaling and complexity AI evaluation. Lead projects that span teams and quarters Define how we evaluate any new AI service from scratch. Drive multi-team initiatives like replacing manual, inconsistent review processes with statistically sound, automated gates. Own our approach to adversarial and red-team evaluation as a risk-reduction program, designing the test suites and failure taxonomies that catch safety and edge-case issues before they reach patients. Work through complex, cross-team technical disagreements and drive alignment across engineering, product and AI leaders. Turn hard, ambiguous problems into solutions other teams can build on Originate new approaches and methodology that becomes a reusable standard rather than a one-off fix. Take vague, cross-team pain points ("we do this manually and it's inconsistent") all the way from a rough idea to a fully-specified, shipped system, without needing to hand off any part of the journey. Lead major platform improvements; re-architecting core systems, removing brittle logic, modernizing how things run with impact that's felt org-wide, not just on your own team. Grow the people and the network around you Build real working relationships across ML engineering, data science, platform engineering, clinical, legal, and product, the kind of trust that gets you looped in early, before decisions are locked in. Become a go-to voice on evaluation methodology and data pipeline design: share what you've learned in internal talks, write things up so other teams can use them, and expect your ideas to shape how others approach similar problems. Mentor other engineers, including experienced ones, and help raise the technical and statistical bar of the teams you work with. You Have: 10+ years of experience in ML infrastructure, data engineering, or evaluation/testing systems, with a track record of impact that reaches beyond a single team or project. Hands-on depth in evaluation systems: designing and calibrating LLM judges/scorers, building statistically sound regression-testing methodology (e.g., paired significance testing with proper correction for multiple comparisons), measuring agreement against human labels, and designing adversarial/red-team evaluation approaches. Hands-on depth in data pipeline engineering: dataset versioning, feature and benchmark pipelines, labeling and calibration workflows, and high-throughput ingestion and transformation systems. A history of building things that became the standard approach for others — not just solving your own problem, but changing how a broader group of people tackle a category of problem. Experience leading multi-team projects to completion, including navigating and resolving genuine technical disagreement along the way. A track record of mentoring other engineers, including senior ones, and visibly raising the bar for the teams around you. Excellent communication — comfortable adapting the same idea for different audiences, and confident building support for it well before launch. Strong Python, and enough statistical fluency to design and defend a testing framework that real production decisions ride on. Nice to Have: Experience with Databricks, MLflow, Unity Catalog, or similar data/eval platforms. Experience building reporting tools for people without direct engineering access (e.g., automated Slack digests, spreadsheet reports for non-technical teams). Prior experience in a regulated industry (healthcare, fintech, life sciences). A track record of company-wide talks or write-ups that changed how other teams approached a problem. Our Benefits (there are more but here are some highlights): Competitive salary & equity compensation for full-time roles Unlimited PTO, company holidays, and quarterly mental health days Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental & vision, and parental leave Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP) 401k benefits with employer matching contribution Offsite team retreats We are committed to building a workforce that reflects diverse perspectives and prioritizes ethics, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply—even if you're not sure if your background or experience is a perfect match. Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals.

About the Role:

How do we make advanced AI/ML not just powerful but trustworthy enough to run in a regulated healthcare environment? We're looking for a Senior Staff engineer who can own that question end to end: the data pipelines that feed our models and evaluations, and the evaluation infrastructure — judges, scorers, statistical regression gates, red-team testing — that decides whether AI models are effective and safe to ship to patients.

This is a leadership role for someone who works comfortably across disciplines. You'll set technical direction for how we build, version, and trust the data and judgments that our AI products are evaluated against. Your scope will expand from raw data ingestion and feature/dataset pipelines, through evaluation methodology and statistical rigor, to the reporting surfaces that let clinical and product teams act on what we learn.

You'll spend most of your time on problems that don't have an existing playbook: ambiguous, cross-team, and genuinely hard to reason about. The job is to bring clarity to that ambiguity, chart a path the rest of the team and organization can follow, and see it through from idea to production, building the relationships and buy-in along the way to make it stick.

You Will:

Own the evaluation as a whole, not just a slice of it

  • Set the technical direction for our evaluation systems; metric, judge and scorer design, the statistical methodology behind regression decisions, and the infrastructure that tracks and categorizes failures over time.

  • Design and scale the data pipelines — ingestion, transformation, dataset versioning, labeling and calibration workflows — that both evaluation and downstream data science work depend on.

  • Proactively address challenges in scaling and complexity AI evaluation.

Lead projects that span teams and quarters

  • Define how we evaluate any new AI service from scratch. Drive multi-team initiatives like replacing manual, inconsistent review processes with statistically sound, automated gates.

  • Own our approach to adversarial and red-team evaluation as a risk-reduction program, designing the test suites and failure taxonomies that catch safety and edge-case issues before they reach patients.

  • Work through complex, cross-team technical disagreements and drive alignment across engineering, product and AI leaders.

Turn hard, ambiguous problems into solutions other teams can build on

  • Originate new approaches and methodology that becomes a reusable standard rather than a one-off fix.

  • Take vague, cross-team pain points ("we do this manually and it's inconsistent") all the way from a rough idea to a fully-specified, shipped system, without needing to hand off any part of the journey.

  • Lead major platform improvements; re-architecting core systems, removing brittle logic, modernizing how things run with impact that's felt org-wide, not just on your own team.

Grow the people and the network around you

  • Build real working relationships across ML engineering, data science, platform engineering, clinical, legal, and product, the kind of trust that gets you looped in early, before decisions are locked in.

  • Become a go-to voice on evaluation methodology and data pipeline design: share what you've learned in internal talks, write things up so other teams can use them, and expect your ideas to shape how others approach similar problems.

  • Mentor other engineers, including experienced ones, and help raise the technical and statistical bar of the teams you work with.

You Have:

  • 10+ years of experience in ML infrastructure, data engineering, or evaluation/testing systems, with a track record of impact that reaches beyond a single team or project.

  • Hands-on depth in evaluation systems: designing and calibrating LLM judges/scorers, building statistically sound regression-testing methodology (e.g., paired significance testing with proper correction for multiple comparisons), measuring agreement against human labels, and designing adversarial/red-team evaluation approaches.

  • Hands-on depth in data pipeline engineering: dataset versioning, feature and benchmark pipelines, labeling and calibration workflows, and high-throughput ingestion and transformation systems.

  • A history of building things that became the standard approach for others — not just solving your own problem, but changing how a broader group of people tackle a category of problem.

  • Experience leading multi-team projects to completion, including navigating and resolving genuine technical disagreement along the way.

  • A track record of mentoring other engineers, including senior ones, and visibly raising the bar for the teams around you.

  • Excellent communication — comfortable adapting the same idea for different audiences, and confident building support for it well before launch.

  • Strong Python, and enough statistical fluency to design and defend a testing framework that real production decisions ride on.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Databricks, MLflow, Unity Catalog, or similar data/eval platforms.

  • Experience building reporting tools for people without direct engineering access (e.g., automated Slack digests, spreadsheet reports for non-technical teams).

  • Prior experience in a regulated industry (healthcare, fintech, life sciences).

  • A track record of company-wide talks or write-ups that changed how other teams approached a problem.

Our Benefits (there are more but here are some highlights):

  1. Recruiter Screen: A 30-minute conversation to learn more about your background, walk through the role, and ensure mutual alignment on expectations, values, and logistics.

  2. Hiring Manager Interview: A deeper dive into your relevant experience, skillset, and working style. This is your first opportunity to connect directly with the person who may be your future manager.

  4. Values Interview: A conversation with team members focused on how you align with our core values and leadership principles.

  5. References: We connect with a few folks you’ve worked closely with to get a better picture of your working style and impact.

  6. Offer: If all goes well, we’ll move to the offer stage!

title: Test a Streaming Platform in France
description: Have you ever wished an app worked a little better? At Testlio , we help some of the world's leading technology and consumer brands improve their apps and digital products by collecting feedback from real people. Our global community of freelance testers has helped companies deliver better experiences to millions of users. We're currently looking for people based in France to help test a regional streaming platform that offers both on-demand and live content. Testing may include evaluating overall application stability, user experience, playback behavior, and localization quality on Samsung AND/OR Hisense Smart TV environments. No professional software testing experience is required. If you're comfortable following instructions and sharing feedback, we'd love to hear from you. We will send you the USD amount, which you can then transfer/convert to EUR if it is more convenient to you. Benefits of being a freelancer at Testlio Schedule: You can create your schedule and work on other testing runs that interest you. Location: Testlio is a 100% remote company. Seriously, you can work from the coffee shop, your home, or while waiting for class. Growth: You’ll be testing global-scale mobile apps and have the chance to boost your skills and grow your career. Payment: You are paid by the hour, not by the bug. This means you get paid even if you did not uncover any bugs. How to start? Please fill out the initial application. Those who meet the requirements will receive further information to participate in this paid testing opportunity.

raw.jobDescription:
About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Backend Developer who thrives in a deeply hands-on environment and enjoys being close to the code on a daily basis. This role is heavily focused on building, optimising, and scaling backend services in a high-load system where performance and reliability are critical.

You’ll be working on complex, real-time challenges at the core of our platform - improving latency, ensuring high availability, and making systems more efficient at scale. This is not a coordination-heavy role; it’s for someone who enjoys writing production code, solving tough engineering problems, and seeing the direct impact of their work.

If you’re product-driven, take ownership, and prefer a “build first, improve fast” approach while working on systems where every millisecond matters - this role will feel like home.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work as part of a cross-functional team owning a core product within the platform

  • Design, build, and deliver new backend features end-to-end in a distributed environment

  • Write high-quality, production-level code daily, contributing directly to a high-load, scalable system

  • Take ownership of services handling financial transactions at scale, with a strong focus on reliability and accuracy

  • Proactively suggest and implement improvements in architecture, processes, and development practices

  • Participate in code and architectural reviews to maintain high engineering standards

  • Solve complex business and technical challenges with pragmatic, efficient solutions

  • Participating in on-call rotations within the squad to ensure the reliability and availability of our systems

  • Play an active role in ongoing tech transformation initiatives across the platform

  • Collaborate closely with engineers, product, and other stakeholders to deliver impactful solutions used by millions globally

Requirements

  • Solid experience with Node.js/TypeScript is ideal, but we also welcome experts in other OOP languages such as Java, Python, C++, C#, or Go

  • Strong understanding of asynchronous programming techniques

  • Deep production experience with Kafka: confident reasoning about consumer-group rebalances and their impact on in-flight processing, offset-commit strategies under retries and duplicate delivery, and the limits of "exactly-once" semantics

  • Experience designing idempotent, retry-safe handlers for at-least-once pipelines: transactional outbox, idempotency keys, and deduplication

  • Experience building services with gRPC or similar RPC frameworks

  • Strong knowledge of relational databases such as MySQL or PostgreSQL, plus production experience with at least one NoSQL technology at scale, such as DynamoDB, MongoDB, or Redis

  • Hands-on experience running services on Kubernetes and AWS/GCP: deployment, autoscaling, resource limits, and production debugging

  • Production operations experience: on-call ownership of a high-load system, including incident response, impact assessment, root-cause analysis, and post-incident improvements

Nice to Have

  • Experience with ClickHouse or other columnar/analytical databases

  • Experience with multi-region / failover architectures: data replication, regional isolation, and graceful degradation

  • Practical use of AI coding agents such as Cursor or Claude Code as part of daily development: effective prompting, reviewing, and validating AI-generated code

  • Understanding of application security and industry best practices

  • Gambling domain experience

What We Offer

  • Competitive Salary

  • Quarterly Bonuses

  • Unlimited Paid Time Off

  • Unlimited Paid Sick Leave

  • Remote & Flexible Working

  • Private Medical Insurance

  • Financial Support for Life Events

  • Professional Development Budget

  • International Exposure

  • Regular Company Events

*Benefits may vary depending on location and contractual agreement

Recruitment process

1. HR interview (30-45mins)

2. Interview with a Hiring Manager (45mins)

3. Technical interview with live coding (90mins)

4. Final Interview with C-level (60 mins)

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that your personal data will be processed in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description: About Numan Founded in 2018, we’ve already grown to be a 300+ team distributed across the globe, united by a singular mission: empowering people to take control of their health. Numan is transforming health: we’ve built a cutting-edge platform that integrates diagnostics, medication, supplements, digital programmes, and doctor consultations. Giving people the tools they need to maximise life. To deliver on our transformative mission, we are guided by our 5 company values: • Patients first. • Learn fast. • Own the quality. • Succeed together. • Care deeply. Backed by top-tier investors, Numan is already having a positive impact on hundreds of thousands of patients here in the UK, and we want you to help us deliver this mission! The role As Numan enters an exciting new chapter of AI-powered analytics, we're looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to sit at the core of our data platform and drive better decisions across the entire business. This is one of the most varied analytics engineering roles in digital health. Your work will span multiple domains - from commercial performance and marketing effectiveness through to health outcomes analytics and clinical operations - giving you a genuinely broad view of the business and the full patient journey. We are embarking on a strategic investment in AI-powered analytics, with a full remit to explore and adopt the latest and greatest technologies. You'll be shaping which tools, approaches, and practices Numan adopts as a company. Reporting to the Head of Data Engineering and collaborating closely with data scientists, analysts, and stakeholders across the business. You'll be: Designing, building, and maintaining scalable, well-tested dbt data models that power analytics across commercial, marketing, health outcomes, and clinical operations domains. Acting as a senior technical voice within the analytics engineering function, setting standards for data modelling, testing, documentation, and code quality. Leading end-to-end delivery of analytical projects: scoping requirements, managing dependencies, identifying critical path and risks, and communicating progress to stakeholders. Mentoring data scientist and analyst data modelling capabilities ; build a culture of best practices, code review, and continuous learning across the data team. Partnering with clinical, commercial, and product teams to translate complex domain requirements into robust, well-documented data models. Evaluating, trialing, and championing AI-powered analytics tooling - shaping Numan's strategic direction on emerging technologies and what we adopt as a company. Driving data quality, reliability, and governance across the transformation layer, proactively monitoring consumption and resolving issues before they impact stakeholders. We're looking for someone who has: 3–5+ years of experience in an analytics engineering, data engineering, or business intelligence role. Proven track record of owning end-to-end data model design across multiple business domains — ideally spanning at least two of: commercial, marketing, health outcomes, or clinical/operational analytics. Strong stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical audiences including clinical and commercial teams. Experience setting technical standards and delivering high-quality work within a small, high-performing data team. Self-motivated and pragmatic, with a strong instinct for high-impact solutions over over-engineering. Genuine curiosity about AI and emerging analytics technologies, with a desire to help shape how Numan adopts them. Expert-level SQL: window functions, CTEs, advanced aggregations, and cloud warehouse-specific optimisation. Deep proficiency in dbt: models, macros, tests, packages, documentation, exposures, and CI/CD integration. Strong working knowledge of Google BigQuery (or equivalent cloud data warehouse): query optimisation, incremental loading strategies, and cost management. Experience with Looker (LookML) or an equivalent BI layer, with a solid understanding of consumption-layer design. Dimensional data modelling expertise: star schemas, slowly changing dimensions, and when to denormalise. Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to deliver clear, insight-led presentations that tell a compelling story to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Understanding of data privacy, governance, and compliance requirements — with particular sensitivity to regulated healthcare data. Practical experience with AI-assisted analytics workflows, or a strong demonstrated appetite to work at the frontier of AI in analytics. It's a bonus if you have: Worked in a digital consumer scale-up, with experience of delivering high quality work at pace. Hands-on experience evaluating or implementing AI/LLM tooling in a data or analytics context (e.g. semantic layers, natural language querying, AI-assisted documentation). Our benefits include... 📈 - Share options. 🏖 - 25 days holiday, plus bank holidays (increasing to 30 the longer you stay with Numan). 🩺 - Health insurance with Vitality . 🚘 - Electric car salary sacrifice scheme with Octopus . 🧸 - Enhanced maternity and parental leave. 🥳 - A day off on your Birthday! 🐥 - Nursery benefit provided by YellowNest . 💼 - Employee assistance programme (access to therapy, financial planning and discounts). ⚖️ - Generous pension (includes both employee and employer contributions). 💻 - Flexible working options, including a dog-friendly office in Farringdon. 📚 - Personal training and development budget via Learnerbly. 👟 - Wellhub membership, giving you access to over 2,000 locations in the UK. 🚲 - Cycle to work scheme. 🚆 - Season ticket loan. % - Discount on Numan products for your friends and family. 🤲 - Paid volunteering days. 📅 - An additional 2 weeks off once you reach your 5th anniversary with Numan. Diversity at Numan At Numan, people are at the heart of who we are. We recognise and value the unique perspectives and experiences that individuals from all backgrounds bring. We promote innovation and creativity, enabling us to tackle things from various viewpoints and are committed to equal opportunities and continuously strive to create a workplace where everyone feels respected, heard, and valued. title: Distinguished Engineer
description: At Brevo, we’re not just building a CRM. With our technology, we’re helping millions of organizations build lasting relationships with their customers. From emails and SMS to WhatsApp, Chat, and Marketing Automation, our tools are intuitive, powerful, and built to scale with every ambition. We give businesses a clear view of the customer journey, so they can focus on what matters: connection. As a certified B Corp , we’re proud to grow with purpose, committed to high standards of social and environmental impact, not just performance. Today, more than 500,000 businesses across 180 countries —from NGOs like Amnesty International to global brands like Carrefour, eBay, Louis Vuitton, and Michelin—trust Brevo to engage their audiences, cut through complexity, and deliver results. Our reliable technology and 75+ integrations help them create unparalleled customer experiences, without the usual tech headaches. We recently exceeded 200m ARR and reached a major milestone by becoming a Unicorn , backed by strong growth and global expansion - and we’re just getting started! The role : We are looking for a Distinguished Engineer based in our Paris office to lead the technical transformations that are too large, too cross-cutting, or too critical to belong to a single engineering team. This is a company-wide IC role with direct report to the CTO and explicit authority to drive major technical decisions across Product Engineering, Platform, Infrastructure and Data. This isn't an advisory role, it's a mandate to change how Brevo Engineering works at a foundational level. What you will do: You will own a small number of high-impact technical transformations end to end: architecture, implementation strategy, migration, adoption and retirement of legacy systems. Examples include: rebuilding our CI/CD and deployment architecture across hundreds of services and repositories; replacing fragmented logging and observability patterns with an OpenTelemetry-based platform backed by ClickHouse; redesigning how we use Kafka and introducing stronger platform abstractions around messaging; turning ClickHouse into a first-class internal product rather than a database consumed inconsistently across teams; defining and driving common standards around service communication, reliability, runtime architecture and developer platforms. These initiatives will cross organizational boundaries and require changes to both infrastructure and application code. Your responsibility is to own the projects end to end, driving them through every stage and resolving whatever obstacles arise until it is delivered. Who you are: You have already operated at Principal, Distinguished, Senior Principal, Fellow, or equivalent level within a significantly larger engineering organization. You have repeatedly led transformations involving hundreds of engineers or large service fleets, distributed systems and production infrastructure, complex migrations where old and new worlds had to coexist, strong technical disagreement across senior teams, and architecture decisions with broad and lasting consequences. You move fluidly between a system design discussion, a code review, a production incident, a migration plan, and an executive-level technical decision. You bring deep expertise in several of the following: Kubernetes, CI/CD, Kafka, ClickHouse, OpenTelemetry, distributed databases, service communication, developer platforms, and large-scale observability. Whoever you are, wherever you’re from, if this role speaks to you, we’d love to hear from you. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Devices & IOT Field Engineering Manager
description: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable and growing. We are hiring an Embedded Linux Field Engineering Manager to lead a regionally-focused team of Field engineers in Presales and Professional Services activities, by helping customers with solution architecture, design and delivery. Our Embedded mission is to enable companies to make fleets of very secure connected devices. Canonical provides Ubuntu, Ubuntu Core and a unique Long Term Support, with secure update and management mechanisms. Our customers create mission-critical control systems, gateways and appliances that need to meet stringent quality and security requirements, and we aspire to bring this level of security to the wider consumer electronics and device market. Our Field Engineers are thought leaders helping our customers through their journey toward a more secure and durable solution.. They are accomplished technologists that take a hands-on approach to embedded Linux strategy and delivery. They have a passion to help customers achieve ambitious technical and business goals, and to show how the Canonical approach to open source and connected devices brings best-of-breed thinking to the emerging field of edge compute. They also care to develop their colleagues, helping them deepen their understanding of the technology, their ability to manage time, and their awareness of customer business thinking for continuous improvement and personal development. This career opportunity requires a unique blend of skills. Successful candidates will know Linux well, understand how a distribution works, what are the unique challenges of Internet Of Things, and will also carry team building and management skills. They also enjoy the pace of change and diversity of client engagements with driven and ambitious technology entrepreneurs. Competitive, business-focused technologists at heart, they are also team drivers that take pride in team and company wins. What we offer colleagues We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. Headquarters: United States
URL: http://www.halcyon.ai

What we do:
Halcyon is the industry’s first dedicated, adaptive security platform that combines multiple proprietary advanced prevention engines along with AI models focused specifically on stopping ransomware.

Who we are:
Halcyon was formed in 2021 by a team of cyber industry veterans after battling the scourge of ransomware (and advanced threats) for years at some of the largest global security vendors. Comprised of leaders from Cylance (now Blackberry), Accuvant (now Optiv), Fireye and ISS X-Force (now IBM), Halcyon is focused on building products and solutions for mid-market and enterprise customers.

As a remote-native, completely distributed global team, we recognize great talent can exist anywhere. We invite you to apply to a job you’re interested in and we'll work a plan to meet your needs.

The Role  

  

At Halcyon, we’re building a world-class anti-ransomware platform grounded in innovation and resilience. As part of that vision, we’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our cloud team. You’ll lead the development and evolution of our data platform and API services, working within a modern tech stack that blends Scala and Rust.   

You’ll join a team focused on building scalable, maintainable backend systems that serve both internal and customer-facing functions. Your primary focus will be on Rust and Scala services, with opportunities to shape our transition to Rust where it makes sense. Python development experience is highly valued, particularly for supporting our security analysis platform which includes malware analysis engines, automated threat detection, and machine learning workflows.  

Responsibilities  

  • Lead the design and delivery of features across our data platform and public API services, including ingestion, transformation, and enrichment of security data. 
  • Drive system design, architecture, and data flow decisions in partnership with product and platform engineering. 
  • Build, deploy, and own Scala-based backend services in production, keeping them reliable, secure, and performant. 
  • Help shape and execute our migration of selected APIs from Scala to Rust, ensuring consistency and continuity along the way. 
  • Set the bar for code quality, documentation, and operational excellence.  
  • Lead design reviews, code reviews and take part in on-call and incident response. 
  • Support and enhance our Python-based security analysis platform, including malware analysis engines, automated threat detection, and machine learning model workflows.  

Skills and Qualifications  

  • 5+ years of backend engineering experience, with recent experience in a JVM-based codebase.  
  • A track record of designing and owning distributed systems from start to finish. 
  • Experience with Rust, or a well-formed view of when it’s the right tool, and the ability to help guide a migration. 
  • Strong understanding of APIs, messaging systems (Kafka), and modern data stores (Postgres, DynamoDB, OpenSearch).  
  • Experience building services in a cloud-native environment, preferably AWS.  
  • Working knowledge of containers and Kubernetes.  
  • Comfortable working in a remote-first, asynchronous team environment.  

Bonus Skills and Qualifications  

  • Familiarity with functional programming patterns and idiomatic Scala.  
  • Experience with Databricks and ClickHouse (or similar lakehouse and analytical/OLAP data stores). 
  • Experience with Terraform, Helm, and GitHub Actions.  
  • Familiarity with observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch).  
  • Prior work on security products, data pipelines, or high-availability systems.  
  • Python development experience, particularly with security analysis tools and malware detection frameworks (YARA, PE analysis, binary analysis).  
  • Familiarity with machine learning workflows, AutoML, and MLflow for model deployment and management.  
  • Experience with binary analysis libraries (LIEF, ssdeep, TLSH) and security tooling integration. 

Benefits:

 Halcyon offers the following benefits to eligible employees:

  • Comprehensive healthcare (medical, dental, and vision) with premiums paid in full for employees and dependents.

  • 401k plan with a generous employer contribution.

  • Short and long-term disability coverage, basic life and AD&D insurance plans.

  • Medical and dependent care FSA options.

  • Flexible PTO policy.

  • Parental leave.

  • Generous equity offering.

The Company reserves the right to modify or change these benefits programs at any time, with or without notice.​

Base Salary Range: $120,000 - $170,000

Bonus Target: 10%

The actual amount may differ based on non-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location. title: Senior Scrum Master
description:
At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of the Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces.

We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.

Ready to join us?

 

Your Role

We're looking for a Senior Scrum Master to join our team in London. Our products help the world's top teams and athletes perform at their best. We need an experienced Agile leader to help the squads building them do the same.

As a Senior ScrumMaster, you'll:

  • Coach the system, not just the team. You'll guide squads toward high autonomy while focusing on broader organizational design issues, such as resolving friction across business units, managing dependencies, and establishing scaling patterns.
  • Architect outcomes, not processes. You'll move fluidly across frameworks, adapting events to what the team needs to deliver value. You will act as an outcome architect, designing information flow and decision rhythms rather than functioning as a framework fundamentalist.
  • Anticipate, not react. You'll utilize predictive delivery intelligence and cross-team dependency mapping to resolve impediments before they surface, keeping coordination moving in the right direction even as the pace of delivery accelerates.
  • Foster psychological safety. You'll build environments where candor is safe, failure is treated as a data point, and conflict is constructive. You'll ensure teams feel secure enough to take on hard problems and navigate the shifting dynamics brought on by AI-assisted development.
  • Align and design for visibility. You'll map value streams to see where decisions stall and design cross-BU communication layers. You will maintain the signal through the noise, ensuring stakeholders know what's changed and what decisions are needed.

Location

Time spent collaborating with your teammates in-office will be a regular part of how you work. We're currently considering applicants within commuting distance of our London office. You'll be expected to work more days in-office than remote, but will have the freedom to coordinate your specific in-office schedule with your team.

Must-Haves

  • An experienced Agile practitioner. You have three or more years as a Scrum Master and have guided squads to improved, sustainable results and can scale your coaching capacity to influence broader organizational maturity.
  • A systems thinker. You see beyond the squad level, actively identifying and breaking down siloed organizational designs to reduce friction and eliminate duplicated efforts across Business Units.
  • Data-driven and predictive. You know how to use both qualitative and quantitative signals to establish predictive metrics that forecast delivery risk and guide investment decisions.
  • A clear communicator. You design lightweight operating guardrails and information flows that keep dependencies transparent and align stakeholders at every level without creating overhead that slows teams down.
  • A champion of responsible speed. You optimize for quality, anticipated dependencies, commitments kept, and team sustainability, ensuring that the speed of code generation never outpaces our coordination speed.

Nice-to-Haves

  • AI fluency. You have an interest in or experience with AI-assisted development tools and AI-powered agile tools, such as automated bottleneck detection or real-time sentiment and health monitoring.
  • A diverse Agile toolbelt. You're familiar with multiple frameworks (Kanban, Lean, SAFe, etc) and know when and how to blend them for better outcomes.
  • Global team experience. Our product teams span the U.S. and Europe, and you're comfortable collaborating across time zones and cultures.

Our Role

  • Champion work-life harmony. We'll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time above any required statutory leave, company-wide holidays, remote work options and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too. Plus, every five years, we give you a paid sabbatical to unplug and recharge.
  • Guarantee autonomy. We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you'll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas.
  • Encourage career growth. We're lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We'll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing.
  • Provide an environment to help you succeed. We've invested in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you're at the office or working remotely, we'll provide you the tech you need to do your best work.
  • Support your wellbeing. Depending on location, we offer medical and retirement benefits for employees—but no matter where you're located, we have resources like our Employee Assistance Program and employee resource groups to support your mental health.

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is displayed below—starting salaries will typically fall near the middle of this range.

We make compensation decisions based on an individual's experience, skills and education in line with our internal pay equity practices. 

This role will also be eligible for a long-term incentive (LTI) award. Any bonuses awarded are based on individual and company performance paid at Hudl's discretion. 

Base Salary Range
£48,000—£80,000 GBP

title: Senior Projectmanager
description: Jouw Missie bij CCS Geen dag is hetzelfde in deze rol. Samen met je collega’s zorg je ervoor dat wij succesvol onze softwareoplossingen bij klanten implementeren en dat onze klanten een excellente dienstverlening krijgen! Voor deze complexe systeemimplementaties en integratieprojecten zoeken we een zeer ervaren projectmanager. Je leert de verzekeringsbranche kennen en klanten helpen. Dat doe je niet alleen: je werkt samen met enthousiaste collega’s in een projectteam. Voordelen voor de sollicitant Als projectmanager krijg je veel verantwoordelijkheid, help je klanten en samen met je projectteam zet je mooie resultaten neer. Je kunt deels thuiswerken, deels op ons kantoor in Woerden en bij verschillende klanten in Nederland. Tijdelijk werken vanuit het buitenland kan ook dankzij onze workation-regeling (maximaal 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar). Bij ons draait het om klantgericht werken én werkplezier. Daarom is er volop ruimte voor ontspanning en plezier. Denk aan een levend tafelvoetbaltoernooi, pubquiz en een bier- & wijnproeverij. Ons actieve Fun-team zorgt elke maand weer voor iets leuks. En als je reislust nog niet is gestild met 25 vakantiedagen en een workation, dan kun je zelfs tot 20 extra verlofdagen bijkopen. Genoeg redenen om verder te lezen en te ontdekken of deze functie iets voor jou is, toch? Een voorbeeld van je werkdag Opstarten: Aan het begin van je werkdag heb je een dagstart met zowel collega’s als projectteamleden van de klant. Hierin bespreken jullie de voortgang, resultaten en eventuele hulpvragen. Na de dagstart: Allereerst neem je nog wat tijd met een van de consultants naar aanleiding van de dagstart. Je coacht en begeleidt de consultant en helpt deze met een hulpvraag. Vervolgens ga je aan de slag met het opstellen van de voortgangsrapportage. Hiermee zorg je voor proactieve en transparante rapportage over het project aan de klant. De stuurgroep met de klant is volgende week, vandaag spreek je samen met de delivery manager deze stuurgroep voor. Wat zijn de belangrijkste punten voor de klant en voor CCS en hoe vliegen we die aan. Na de lunch: Je checkt nog een paar tickets qua voortgang op het planboard, waarbij je de samenhang met de planning checkt. Vervolgens ga je naar de werksessie met het CCS projectmanagement guild. Hier werken jullie aan tickets om de CCS Prince2Agile projectmethodiek verder te verbeteren. Dat doe je niet alleen: je werkt samen met enthousiaste collega’s in een projectteam.

Voordelen voor de sollicitant

Als projectmanager krijg je veel verantwoordelijkheid, help je klanten en samen met je projectteam zet je mooie resultaten neer. Je kunt deels thuiswerken, deels op ons kantoor in Woerden en bij verschillende klanten in Nederland. Tijdelijk werken vanuit het buitenland kan ook dankzij onze workation-regeling (maximaal 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar).

Bij ons draait het om klantgericht werken én werkplezier. Daarom is er volop ruimte voor ontspanning en plezier. Denk aan een levend tafelvoetbaltoernooi, pubquiz en een bier- & wijnproeverij. Ons actieve Fun-team zorgt elke maand weer voor iets leuks.

En als je reislust nog niet is gestild met 25 vakantiedagen en een workation, dan kun je zelfs tot 20 extra verlofdagen bijkopen. Genoeg redenen om verder te lezen en te ontdekken of deze functie iets voor jou is, toch?

title: ML Runtime Engineer
description: Wanna join the adventure? Loft's AI for Space group is building the stack that runs real machine learning in orbit; turning raw sensor data into decisions on the satellite itself, so insight reaches the customer in minutes instead of hours. The AI Engineering team is where models meet the spacecraft. We own the full path from a partner's trained model to something that actually runs — fast — on flight hardware: compiling ONNX models into optimized engines for each accelerator, the Space Inference Engine and its execution providers, the SDK that packages models for flight, and the perf tooling that proves a model fits its power, thermal, and latency budget before it ever leaves the ground. As we open the platform to a growing roster of defense and Earth-observation partners, the team's scope and the range of silicon we target are expanding fast. As our ML Runtime Engineer , you'll own model compilation and the performance tooling behind it. We're looking for someone scrappy — the kind of engineer who takes an unfamiliar model and an unforgiving power budget, digs into the graph, and gets it running on real hardware without waiting for the path to be handed to them. To help legal professionals work with greater reliability, efficiency and peace of mind, through a single, comprehensive and secure platform. Today, 27,000 legal professionals across five countries (France, Italy, Germany, Spain and Luxembourg) trust us to do just that. The result in 2026: close to 30,000 customers across 5 countries. The German market? It just blew out its first birthday candle. Doctrine is the European leader in legal AI. But a German lawyer doesn't work like a French one, and in-house counsel in Berlin don't have quite the same needs as their Paris counterparts. Every market has its own playbook. That's where you come in: putting Doctrine's growth in Germany into overdrive. The team you're joining A Growth team of 4: your future manager, one Growth on Italy, two on France. On the other side of the table, a team of full-funnel Account Executives ready to turn the leads you generate into wins. And the best part: everything is open to challenge. Got a better idea? We're all ears. Internationalization : design and roll out local campaigns built for the codes and expectations of the German market (no copy-paste from France). Inbound Lead Gen : team up with our agency to build campaigns that hit hard on Meta, LinkedIn and Google, and pull in as many qualified leads as possible. Outbound Lead Gen : pinpoint the right contacts for the sales teams and fire up activation campaigns (enrichment, automation, sequences, performance tracking). Nurturing : build and run nurturing campaigns on our leads, plus product-usage campaigns with existing customers, to max out conversion and retention. Fluency in German, it's a plus. Strong communicator who lets the data do the talking when it's time to decide. Creative and curious about user psychology, to design programs that leave a mark. Knowledge is power: information is at the heart of Doctrine's mission, and we constantly strive to grow. Release early, release often and listen to your customers: we believe in the power of iteration and in constantly listening to our market, our customers and their challenges. raw.description:
Our Mission ⚖️

At Doctrine, we're building Europe's leading legal AI platform.

Our belief? Law shouldn't be slowed down by repetitive tasks. It should be augmented by a specialised AI, designed to understand, analyse and produce legal reasoning at the highest standard.

Our ambition? To help legal professionals work with greater reliability, efficiency and peace of mind, through a single, comprehensive and secure platform.

Today, 27,000 legal professionals across five countries (France, Italy, Germany, Spain and Luxembourg) trust us to do just that.

Our growth is guided by a clear approach: a global vision, grounded in a deep understanding of local specificities.

Behind this ambition, a team of around 250 people, united around one goal: supporting lawyers and legal professionals at every stage of their work, from research to drafting.

And we're just getting started.


We grow fast. Really fast. Organically (new products, new countries) and through acquisitions: 5 companies snapped up in 3 years, including a fresh one in Spain. The result in 2026: close to 30,000 customers across 5 countries. The German market? It just blew out its first birthday candle.

Doctrine is the European leader in legal AI. But a German lawyer doesn't work like a French one, and in-house counsel in Berlin don't have quite the same needs as their Paris counterparts. Every market has its own playbook. That's where you come in: putting Doctrine's growth in Germany into overdrive.

 

The team you're joining

A Growth team of 4: your future manager, one Growth on Italy, two on France. We're hunting for the 5th avenger to complete the squad and take full ownership of the German market. On the other side of the table, a team of full-funnel Account Executives ready to turn the leads you generate into wins.

The starting point (pretty sweet, honestly 👀)

  • A high-growth SaaS model, and a profitable one (yes, both)
  • Rock-solid product-market fit with real momentum: close to 30,000 lawyers and legal professionals already on board
  • A top-tier Go-to-Market team (Marketing, RevenueOps & Sales) to help you uncover new pockets of growth
  • An established spot as the European leader of a category we helped invent: legal AI
  • A cutting-edge tooling stack and a loaded content library to fire on the right levers and shut down objections

Your missions

Inside the Growth team, hand in hand with Sales, PMM and Product, you spend your days sharpening the German funnel, a mix of inbound and outbound. And the best part: everything is open to challenge. Got a better idea? We're all ears.

  • Internationalization: design and roll out local campaigns built for the codes and expectations of the German market (no copy-paste from France).
  • Inbound Lead Gen: team up with our agency to build campaigns that hit hard on Meta, LinkedIn and Google, and pull in as many qualified leads as possible.
  • Outbound Lead Gen: pinpoint the right contacts for the sales teams and fire up activation campaigns (enrichment, automation, sequences, performance tracking).
  • Nurturing: build and run nurturing campaigns on our leads, plus product-usage campaigns with existing customers, to max out conversion and retention.
  • Field Marketing & Product Growth: back the PMM team on product launches and be field marketing's right hand on our events, webinars and product launches.

The profile we're looking for

You're our 5th avenger if you're not afraid to build campaigns day in, day out and copywriting is your thing (better yet, you love it). 

Hard skills

  • AI is your copilot: this role runs 100% with AI, campaign production, copywriting, analysis, automation. A daily reflex, not a gimmick.
  • Hands-on experience with marketing automation, sales engagement and CRM tools (Salesforce, HubSpot, Outreach, Intercom, Lemlist…).
  • A solid grasp of how data flows between tools, to build, challenge and optimize customer and prospect journeys.
  • A real appetite for copywriting and for understanding what makes our audience tick.
  • A drive to build strategies that last, not just quick & dirty wins.
  • Analytical skills (SQL is a nice bonus).

Soft skills

  • Fluency in English is required to communicate with the team. 
  • Fluency in German, it's a plus.
  • Strong communicator who lets the data do the talking when it's time to decide.
  • Creative and curious about user psychology, to design programs that leave a mark.
  • A real team player: you move through cross-functional teams and get everyone's stakes to land the best action plans.

Our stack 🛠️

Salesforce · HubSpot · Outreach · Intercom · Lemlist · Mixpanel · Google Analytics · Metabase · Zapier/Make

What's in it for you ☀️

🏡 A flexible remote work policy, allowing up to three days of remote work per week (depending on your team).

🌴 A flexible leave policy

🌱 Real internal mobility opportunities

🏄‍♂️ Regular team events

📚 A genuine focus on individual and collective learning, with a €750 annual budget for any training related to your role, plus team-wide and company-wide training sessions

🏋️‍♀️ A Gymlib subscription for sports and wellness activities

🧘 Free access to the Moka.care mental health support platform, including up to 6 individual sessions per year

👩‍⚕️ Health insurance with Alan

🍱🚲 A Swile card for meal vouchers and sustainable mobility allowance (€66.60/month)

💡 Discounts and perks via our Works Council (CSE) on the Happypal platform

🍏 Brand new Apple equipment

Our values 🤝

At Doctrine, our 4 values guide us every day as we work to move things forward.

Challenge the status quo: we champion bold ideas that drive change across an entire industry.

Liberty and responsibility: we encourage autonomy, individual impact and ownership.

Knowledge is power: information is at the heart of Doctrine's mission, and we constantly strive to grow.

Release early, release often and listen to your customers: we believe in the power of iteration and in constantly listening to our market, our customers and their challenges.

 Our hiring process 🚀

  1. A 30-min intro call with one of our Talent Acquisition Managers to understand your career goals and walk you through what we're building at Doctrine.

(The process can be adapted to fit your personal and professional constraints if needed.)

raw.description:
Notre mission ⚖️

Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.

Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence.

Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.

Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.


Le contexte
 
Nous cherchons plusieurs Account Managers (AM) pour rejoindre les équipes qui couvrent nos différents segments :
  • Cabinet d'avocats  - SMB
  • Cabinets d'avocats - Grands comptes
  • Entreprises et directions juridiques - SMB
  • Entreprises et directions juridiques - Grand comptes
 
Notre équipe commerciale est organisée comme beaucoup de SaaS B2B, avec des BDR qui s'occupent de la relation commerciale avant-vente et qui portent une bonne part de la qualification et de la prospection, des AE qui s'occupent de négocier la vente, et des AM qui sont en charge de la relation commerciale post-vente.
 
Pourquoi être AM chez Doctrine ?
- Occuper un poste centré sur la vente aux clients existants et très varié, avec du cross-sell et de l'upsell mais aussi des composantes relationnelles et produit ;
- Connaître et vendre le produit le plus performant du marché, avec une capacité d’innovation prouvée année après année ;
- S’appuyer sur des équipes Ops et Marketing bien staffées et de haut niveau, au service de la performance des Sales au quotidien ;
- Pouvoir évoluer dans une équipe avec des profils divers, qui met l'accent sur la formation et l’accompagnement dès le premier jour ;
- Bénéficier d'un package attractif au variable déplafonné.

Les missions
  • Aller chercher de l'ARR supplémentaire et de la croissance via de l'upsell ou du cross-sell
  • Prévenir et minimiser l’attrition
  • Gérer, développer et nourrir un portefeuille de clients en développant des relations solides avec les utilisateurs et les décideurs
  • Contribuer au développement direct de notre produit en remontant les retours des clients aux équipes techniques et produits
  • Maintenir un niveau de satisfaction client élevé

    • Le profil idéal
  • Tu as une expérience de quelques années dans la vente, ou en tant que juriste.
  • Tu aimes vendre et convaincre ton interlocuteur : tu ne t'arrêtes pas tant qu'on ne t'a pas dit oui.
  • Une formation/expérience juridique confirmée est un vrai plus... mais n’est pas un prérequis pour travailler chez Doctrine !
  • Tu es autonome, curieux.se et apprends rapidement
  • Tu es à l'aise dans la communication orale et écrite, et tu parles parfaitement français
  • Tu es capable de gérer plusieurs tâches et de gérer des priorités changeantes dans des délais serrés
  • Tu es impatient.e de prendre ton téléphone et de discuter avec les clients

    • Ce qui t'attend si tu rejoins Doctrine 🤝

    • Contribuer à un projet ambitieux, avec un impact réel et positif sur la société : rendre le droit plus accessible et plus ouvert.
    • Un onboarding très complet permettant une intégration et une montée en compétence rapides.
    • Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien.
    • Rejoindre une entreprise avec une vie d’équipe riche et dynamique : conférences, team-buildings, déjeuner, offsite, afterwork, etc.

    Nos valeurs 🤝

    Chez Doctrine, nos 4 valeurs nous accompagnent au quotidien et dans notre ambition de faire bouger les choses.

    • Challenge the status quo : nous défendons les idées audacieuses qui contribuent à l’évolution de tout un secteur.
    • Liberty and responsibility : nous encourageons l’autonomie, l’impact de chacun·e et l’ownership.
    • Knowledge is power : l'information est au cœur de la mission de Doctrine, et nous cherchons constamment à progresser.
    • Release early, release often and listen to your customers : nous croyons au pouvoir de l’itération et à l’importance d’écouter en permanence notre marché, nos client·e·s et leurs problématiques.
     

    Nos avantages pour faire la différence ☀️

    🏡 Une politique de télétravail flexible permettant - selon les équipes - jusqu’à trois jours de télétravail par semaine.

    🌴 Une politique de congés flexibles

Your mission is to build scalable motions that accelerate expansion opportunities while ensuring customers continue to realize value from the platform. Therefore, your successful automatization processes will also help shape globally the entire KAM team. As a transversal role, you will work closely with Client Success Partners, Revenue Operations, Marketing, and internal experts (digital pedagogy, platform structuring, IT) to deploy automated engagement strategies, optimize renewal processes, and generate upsell opportunities efficiently across your portfolio. We are eager to retain the best talent in our teams, and we encourage internal mobility after 2–3 years of continuous success to build fulfilling career paths. This role offers strong growth opportunities toward strategic account management, revenue operations, or large account ownership positions. title: Design System Manager - Consultant.e
description: Mindset Chez Thiga, nous considérons qu’un Design System n’est pas seulement un ensemble de composants ou de règles : c’est un produit à part entière . Un produit pensé pour évoluer, répondre aux besoins des équipes, et accompagner la croissance de l’entreprise. Créer et faire vivre un Design System demande une vision , une stratégie claire , et une gouvernance solide . Il faut piloter son adoption, anticiper ses usages à grande échelle, et s’assurer qu’il réponde aux enjeux à la fois du Design et de la Tech. C’est un levier puissant pour faire monter en maturité les organisations, structurer la collaboration entre les équipes, et diffuser une culture produit forte. Aujourd'hui, un Design System bien structuré est aussi la condition sine qua non pour tirer pleinement parti de l'IA dans les workflows design et prototypage. Tokens cohérents, composants documentés, nomenclature rigoureuse autant de fondations qui permettent d'exploiter les outils d'IA générative (Figma Make, Lovable, v0...) de manière fiable et scalable. Le.la Design System Manager de demain est celui.celle qui anticipe ces usages et structure son système en conséquence. Les Design System Managers que nous recherchons pensent leur système comme un produit vivant, automatisé au maximum, et conçu pour connecter Design et Ingénierie dans un workflow sans friction . How we work together 🤝 Mettre en place des rituels d'adoption et d'amélioration continue :offices hours, sessions de feedback, contribution guidelines pour que le DS soit co-construit et adopté par toutes les équipes. Aligner Design et Engineering en continu : organiser des syncs réguliers avec les équipes dev pour garantir la cohérence entre les composants Figma et leur implémentation code. Le DS ne vit pas dans Figma seul; il vit dans la production. Piloter l'alignement stratégique multi-équipes : s'assurer que Produit, Tech, Design et business partagent la même vision et roadmap du DS, intégrée au même niveau que les autres produits. Répondre aux besoins des utilisateurs et contributeurs : centraliser les demandes, prioriser les évolutions, et faciliter la contribution fluide de designers, développeurs et PMs. Fédérer autour d'une culture DS partagée : faire du DS un produit vivant et co-créé, en favorisant des échanges transparents et en embarquant les équipes dans sa vision long terme How we get work done 🚀 Définir et piloter la roadmap du DS : feuille de route alignée sur les priorités produit et business, avec des objectifs mesurables à court et long terme. Automatiser les workflows du DS au maximum : pipelines de tokens, synchronisation design to code en temps réel, scripts de génération de documentation, réduire au minimum les tâches manuelles et les risques de désynchronisation. Structurer le DS pour l'IA et le prototypage rapide : concevoir une architecture de composants et de tokens qui rende le DS exploitable par les outils d'IA générative (Figma Make, Cursor, v0, Lovable...). Cela implique : nomenclature stricte,variantes bien définies, props documentées, et une logique de composants qui s'aligne avec les patterns du code. Garantir la cohérence design-code : mettre en place des outils de vérification automatique pour s'assurer que ce qui est designé est bien ce qui est développé sans avoir à le vérifier manuellement. Promouvoir les bonnes pratiques à grande échelle : formations, ateliers, documentation vivante pour que le DS soit utilisé de manière fluide et scalable par toutes les équipes. Mesurer l'impact et itérer : KPIs d'adoption, indicateurs de qualité, retours qualitatifs pour évaluer l'impact du DS et ajuster les priorités How our work creates impact 🎯 Accélérer le delivery produit : composants prêts à l'emploi, pipelines automatisés et prompts IA calibrés sur le DS. Les équipes conçoivent et développent plus vite, avec moins de friction Rendre le prototypage IA fiable et scalable : un DS bien structuré devient le langage commun entre les designers et les outils d'IA les prototypes générés sont cohérents avec la prod, pas jetables Garantir la qualité et la cohérence design à l'échelle : expérience utilisateur homogène, identité de marque renforcée, dette design et technique réduite Réduire la dette et simplifier la maintenance : moins de doublons, moins de variantes inutiles, un code plus accessible et plus performant Faire monter l'organisation en maturité design : culture de collaboration Design × Tech structurée, vision stratégique du design renforcée, documentation vivante comme levier de montée en compétence Compétences 💼 Vision système et stratégie DS : u sais définir une stratégie de DS et la décliner en roadmap concrète, en alignement avec les priorités produit, tech et business. Tu fais preuve de leadership pour porter cette vision et embarquer les équipes. Alignement Design-Engineering : tu as une solide compréhension des enjeux front-end (tokens, design-to-code, systèmes de composants) et tu dialogues en égal avec les développeurs pas seulement pour les convaincre, mais pour co-construire les bonnes solutions. Automatisation et tooling DS : tu maîtrises les pipelines de tokens, les outils de documentation (Storybook, Zeroheight) et tu as une appétence pour l'automatisation des workflows DS. IA et prototypage avancé : tu comprends comment un DS structuré permet de tirer parti des outils d'IA générative pour le design et le prototypage. Tu anticipes ces usages dans les décisions d'architecture du DS. Gestion de produit interne : tu pilotes le DS comme un vrai produit : besoins utilisateurs, priorisation, KPIs, itération continue. Communication et influence : tu sais formuler des livrables synthétiques et stratégiques (vision, roadmap, modèles de gouvernance, dashboards) pour aligner des interlocuteurs variés équipes opérationnelles, direction produit, stakeholders. Outils : figma (Variables, Dev Mode, Make), Storybook, Zeroheight, Notion, Jira/Linear, Style Dictionary, et une bonne aisance avec les environnements no-code/low-code et outils IA de prototypage. Anglais courant : à l'écrit comme à l'oral Qualités 🌟 Tu penses en systèmes : tu comprends les logiques systémiques et sais structurer un DS cohérent, extensible, et exploitable par l'IA Tu automatises par réflexe : tu cherches à réduire les tâches manuelles et à construire des workflows robustes qui s'auto-maintiennent. Tu es le pont entre Design et Tech : tu parles les deux langages et tu sais créer les conditions d'un alignement durable entre les équipes. Tu portes une vision : tu es capable de convaincre, d'aligner et d'embarquer des designers comme des ingénieurs, des opérationnels comme des dirigeants. Tu pilotes ton DS comme un produit : besoins utilisateurs internes, KPIs, roadmap priorisée tu traites le DS avec la même rigueur qu'un produit client. Tu restes curieux·se et en veille : sur les outils, les pratiques et l'évolution rapide des Design Systems et des usages IA dans le design Expérience 📇 Tu as au moins 5 ans d'expérience en Product Design, Design System Management ou un rôle similaire, avec une trajectoire confirmée ou senior Tu as déjà créé ou fortement structuré un Design System de zéro ou à grande échelle , pas seulement contribué à l'un Tu as mis en place des pipelines de tokens, des processus d'automatisation et des intégrations design to code Tu as expérimenté avec des outils d'IA générative , dans un contexte design ou DS (Figma Make, Cursor, v0, Lovable, ou équivalent) Tu as travaillé aussi bien en scale-up qu'en grand groupe, ce qui te donne une bonne lecture des modèles d'organisation et des leviers pour faire évoluer la maturité design. Tu as travaillé en méthodologie agile et sais comment intégrer le DS dans ces processus de delivery. Ce que nous offrons 🎊 Un on-boarding pour rencontrer tes collègues De l’apprentissage avec minimum 5 jours de formations à l’année, des sessions de partage hebdomadaires et du contenu pour te faire monter en compétences Du mentoring sur ta mission par un pair plus confirmé Du confort avec deux jours de télétravail par semaine (selon ton client) complétés par un accès à un catalogue de matériels, ainsi qu’un Macbook Air ou un PC selon ta préférence. Du fun avec des Thigapéros, des Team building et un séminaire (en prêtant attention à notre empreinte carbone). Et pleins d’autres avantages comme une carte Swile, le remboursement de ton abonnement de transport à 50%/forfait mobilité durable, etc. Les étapes du process 🎢 Un pré-entretien téléphonique avec une membre de l’équipe Recrutement L'évaluation de ton portfolio par nos Designers Une rencontre avec un.e Principal, un.e Manager de la Tribe ou un Partner pour s’assurer que nous partageons les mêmes valeurs et ambitions Un entretien plus opérationnel avec un ou deux membres senior de notre équipe pour évaluer ta compréhension du rôle de Design System Manager, ta capacité à résoudre des problèmes liés au Design System, tes convictions, tes attentes, etc. Une dernière rencontre pour finaliser le process, s’accorder sur une ambition commune, des objectifs et un périmètre d’intervention 🤝 Thiga accueille toutes les personnes compétentes et passionnées et s'engage en faveur de la diversité culturelle, l'égalité de genre et l'emploi des travailleurs handicapés — au contraire nous considérons la diversité comme une grande richesse !
