title: Software Engineering Manager
description: Bouw aan de software van morgen. Ontwikkel de engineers die het mogelijk maken. Van medische apparatuur en industriële automatisering tot semicon-oplossingen: achter ieder succesvol high-tech product schuilt sterke software. Ben jij de leider die softwareteams helpt excelleren, nieuwe technologieën zoals AI omarmt en tegelijkertijd bouwt aan de engineers van morgen? Dan komen we graag met je in contact. Bij ons speel je een sleutelrol in de verdere ontwikkeling van onze Software Engineering-organisatie. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de groei, kwaliteit en prestaties van een team van circa 45 (embedded) softwareprofessionals en zorgt ervoor dat zij de juiste omgeving, richting en ondersteuning krijgen om complexe technologische uitdagingen succesvol aan te gaan. Je beweegt je op het snijvlak van technologie, leiderschap en organisatieontwikkeling. Daarbij richt jij je niet alleen op de resultaten van vandaag, maar bouw je ook aan de softwareorganisatie van morgen. Je creëert een omgeving waarin vakmanschap, kennisdeling, innovatie en continue verbetering centraal staan. Daarnaast volg je technologische ontwikkelingen op de voet en stimuleer je de inzet van moderne technologieën om softwareontwikkeling slimmer, sneller en effectiever te maken. Jouw verantwoordelijkheden Je geeft leiding aan een team van ongeveer 45 embedded software engineers en ondersteunt hen in hun professionele en persoonlijke groei. Je geeft richting aan AI-gedreven transformatie binnen het softwareteam én de bredere organisatie, en neemt je team en collega’s mee in nieuwe manieren van werken. Je stimuleert een cultuur van technische excellentie, eigenaarschap en samenwerking. Je zorgt voor de juiste balans tussen projectresultaten, de ontwikkeling van je team en langetermijndoelstellingen. Je werkt samen met architecten, technical leads en projectteams aan de verdere professionalisering van softwareontwikkeling binnen Benchmark. Je bewaakt de benodigde capaciteit, competenties en inzetbaarheid van de afdeling. Je speelt een actieve rol in het aantrekken, ontwikkelen en behouden van softwaretalent. Je versterkt de samenwerking met internationale engineeringteams binnen Benchmark. Je vertegenwoordigt Software Engineering binnen het Competence Management Team en levert een actieve bijdrage aan organisatiebrede besluitvorming. Je stimuleert het gebruik van moderne ontwikkelmethodieken en tooling om kwaliteit, productiviteit en innovatie te versterken. Je vertaalt technologische ontwikkelingen naar concrete verbeteringen in processen, werkwijzen en engineering excellence. Samen met de managers van Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering en Test Development Engineering werk je aan een toekomstbestendige engineeringorganisatie. Daarbij zoek je continu naar manieren om samenwerking tussen disciplines te versterken en technologische ontwikkelingen succesvol naar de praktijk te vertalen. Waarom deze functie? Deze rol biedt een unieke combinatie van people leadership, technologie en strategische impact. Je krijgt de ruimte om onze softwareorganisatie verder vorm te geven, talent te ontwikkelen en invloed uit te oefenen op de manier waarop complexe high-tech producten worden ontworpen en ontwikkeld. Tegelijkertijd krijg je de mogelijkheid om de toepassing van nieuwe technologieën, waaronder AI, binnen de organisatie verder te verkennen en te helpen verankeren. Wat biedt Benchmark? Bij Benchmark werk je aan producten die ertoe doen! Daarnaast zijn wij bij uitstek een organisatie waar je vrijheid krijgt, waar ondernemerschap wordt beloond en waarin je de ruimte krijgt om je ideeën tot uitvoering te brengen. We bieden je een dynamische omgeving met de ruimte om snel stappen te maken, door te groeien en verantwoordelijkheid te nemen. Je bent onderdeel van een wereldwijd bedrijf waar de nuchtere Twentse cultuur bewaard is gebleven. Bij ons krijg je uitdagend werk, veel vertrouwen en ruimte om jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen. Je werkt met nuchtere collega’s in een informele cultuur, met goede voorwaarden om duurzaam te presteren. Daarnaast bieden wij: Een aantrekkelijk salaris Een bonusregeling gekoppeld aan de prestaties van jouw team en de organisatie. Een managementcontract met veel ruimte voor ondernemerschap, eigen verantwoordelijkheid en impact op de verdere ontwikkeling van de organisatie. Persoonlijke groei en ontwikkeling , waarbij we samen een ontwikkelpad creëren dat aansluit op jouw ambities en de behoeften van de organisatie. Flexibiliteit in de inrichting van je werkweek, met ruimte om werk en privé op een manier te combineren die voor jou werkt. Een sterk kennisgedreven engineeringklimaat , waarin samenwerking, kennisdeling en innovatie centraal staan. Via initiatieven zoals Lunch & Learn-sessies en Pitch Discovery Sessions krijg je volop ruimte om te leren, te inspireren en nieuwe ideeën te ontwikkelen. Wie ben jij? Of je nu een ervaren engineering manager bent of toe bent aan je eerste grotere leiderschapsrol, jij krijgt energie van technologie én het ontwikkelen van mensen. Je weet professionals te verbinden, richting te geven en samen resultaten te behalen in een complexe high-tech omgeving. Met jouw technische achtergrond, nieuwsgierigheid en leiderschapspotentieel bouw je mee aan de volgende generatie engineers én innovaties. Herken jij jezelf hierin? Dan maken we graag kennis met je. Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in embedded software, elektrotechniek, natuurkunde of een vergelijkbare technische richting. Je hebt een stevige achtergrond in embedded systems en voldoende technische diepgang om met engineers en architecten te sparren over technische keuzes en ontwikkelrichtingen. Minimaal zeven jaar ervaring binnen een hightech-ontwikkelomgeving, inclusief enkele jaren in een leidinggevende rol of een technische leiderschapsrol. Aantoonbare ervaring met het aansturen, coachen en ontwikkelen van engineeringteams binnen een complexe technische organisatie. Het vermogen om technische visie, organisatiedoelstellingen en talentontwikkeling succesvol met elkaar te verbinden. Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden en een goede beheersing van zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal. Serious Tech Bij Benchmark werk je voor bedrijven die impact maken met hun innovaties. Zo ontwikkelen we nieuwe producten die de veiligheid of gezondheid verbeteren of juist het gemak vergroten. Deze producten worden geleverd vanaf het productontwerp tot en met volumeproductie en soms ook rechtstreeks aan de eindgebruiker. Dit gehele proces wordt geheel in Almelo uitgevoerd, waar we samenwerken met ongeveer 650 collega’s We werken aan innovaties voor, onder andere, semicon, gezondheidszorg, aerospace en industrie. Van productontwerp tot volumeproductie: het hele proces komt hier samen. Technisch ligt de lat hoog, maar de cultuur blijft nuchter en dichtbij. raw.title: Software Engineering Manager
raw.description:
Bouw aan de software van morgen. Ontwikkel de engineers die het mogelijk maken.

Van medische apparatuur en industriële automatisering tot semicon-oplossingen: achter ieder succesvol high-tech product schuilt sterke software. Ben jij de leider die softwareteams helpt excelleren, nieuwe technologieën zoals AI omarmt en tegelijkertijd bouwt aan de engineers van morgen? Dan komen we graag met je in contact.

 

Bij ons speel je een sleutelrol in de verdere ontwikkeling van onze Software Engineering-organisatie. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de groei, kwaliteit en prestaties van een team van circa 45 (embedded) softwareprofessionals en zorgt ervoor dat zij de juiste omgeving, richting en ondersteuning krijgen om complexe technologische uitdagingen succesvol aan te gaan.

 

Je beweegt je op het snijvlak van technologie, leiderschap en organisatieontwikkeling. Daarbij richt jij je niet alleen op de resultaten van vandaag, maar bouw je ook aan de softwareorganisatie van morgen. Je creëert een omgeving waarin vakmanschap, kennisdeling, innovatie en continue verbetering centraal staan. Daarnaast volg je technologische ontwikkelingen op de voet en stimuleer je de inzet van moderne technologieën om softwareontwikkeling slimmer, sneller en effectiever te maken.

 

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

  • Je geeft leiding aan een team van ongeveer 45 embedded software engineers en ondersteunt hen in hun professionele en persoonlijke groei.

  • Je geeft richting aan AI-gedreven transformatie binnen het softwareteam én de bredere organisatie, en neemt je team en collega’s mee in nieuwe manieren van werken.

  • Je stimuleert een cultuur van technische excellentie, eigenaarschap en samenwerking.

  • Je zorgt voor de juiste balans tussen projectresultaten, de ontwikkeling van je team en langetermijndoelstellingen.

  • Je werkt samen met architecten, technical leads en projectteams aan de verdere professionalisering van softwareontwikkeling binnen Benchmark.

  • Je bewaakt de benodigde capaciteit, competenties en inzetbaarheid van de afdeling.

  • Je speelt een actieve rol in het aantrekken, ontwikkelen en behouden van softwaretalent.

  • Je versterkt de samenwerking met internationale engineeringteams binnen Benchmark.

  • Je vertegenwoordigt Software Engineering binnen het Competence Management Team en levert een actieve bijdrage aan organisatiebrede besluitvorming.

  • Je stimuleert het gebruik van moderne ontwikkelmethodieken en tooling om kwaliteit, productiviteit en innovatie te versterken.

  • Je vertaalt technologische ontwikkelingen naar concrete verbeteringen in processen, werkwijzen en engineering excellence.

 

Samen met de managers van Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering en Test Development Engineering werk je aan een toekomstbestendige engineeringorganisatie. Daarbij zoek je continu naar manieren om samenwerking tussen disciplines te versterken en technologische ontwikkelingen succesvol naar de praktijk te vertalen.

 

Waarom deze functie?

Deze rol biedt een unieke combinatie van people leadership, technologie en strategische impact. Je krijgt de ruimte om onze softwareorganisatie verder vorm te geven, talent te ontwikkelen en invloed uit te oefenen op de manier waarop complexe high-tech producten worden ontworpen en ontwikkeld. Tegelijkertijd krijg je de mogelijkheid om de toepassing van nieuwe technologieën, waaronder AI, binnen de organisatie verder te verkennen en te helpen verankeren.

 

Wat biedt Benchmark?

Bij Benchmark werk je aan producten die ertoe doen! Daarnaast zijn wij bij uitstek een organisatie waar je vrijheid krijgt, waar ondernemerschap wordt beloond en waarin je de ruimte krijgt om je ideeën tot uitvoering te brengen. We bieden je een dynamische omgeving met de ruimte om snel stappen te maken, door te groeien en verantwoordelijkheid te nemen. Je bent onderdeel van een wereldwijd bedrijf waar de nuchtere Twentse cultuur bewaard is gebleven.

 

Bij ons krijg je uitdagend werk, veel vertrouwen en ruimte om jezelf te blijven

ontwikkelen. Je werkt met nuchtere collega’s in een informele cultuur, met goede

voorwaarden om duurzaam te presteren.

 

Daarnaast bieden wij:

  • Een aantrekkelijk salaris

  • Een bonusregeling gekoppeld aan de prestaties van jouw team en de organisatie.

  • Een managementcontract met veel ruimte voor ondernemerschap, eigen verantwoordelijkheid en impact op de verdere ontwikkeling van de organisatie.

  • Persoonlijke groei en ontwikkeling, waarbij we samen een ontwikkelpad creëren dat aansluit op jouw ambities en de behoeften van de organisatie.

  • Flexibiliteit in de inrichting van je werkweek, met ruimte om werk en privé op een manier te combineren die voor jou werkt.

  • Een sterk kennisgedreven engineeringklimaat, waarin samenwerking, kennisdeling en innovatie centraal staan. Via initiatieven zoals Lunch & Learn-sessies en Pitch Discovery Sessions krijg je volop ruimte om te leren, te inspireren en nieuwe ideeën te ontwikkelen.

 

Wie ben jij?

Of je nu een ervaren engineering manager bent of toe bent aan je eerste grotere leiderschapsrol, jij krijgt energie van technologie én het ontwikkelen van mensen. Je weet professionals te verbinden, richting te geven en samen resultaten te behalen in een complexe high-tech omgeving. Met jouw technische achtergrond, nieuwsgierigheid en leiderschapspotentieel bouw je mee aan de volgende generatie engineers én innovaties. Herken jij jezelf hierin? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

 

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in embedded software, elektrotechniek, natuurkunde  of een vergelijkbare technische richting.

  • Je hebt een stevige achtergrond in embedded systems en voldoende technische diepgang om met engineers en architecten te sparren over technische keuzes en ontwikkelrichtingen.

  • Minimaal zeven jaar ervaring binnen een hightech-ontwikkelomgeving, inclusief enkele jaren in een leidinggevende rol of een technische leiderschapsrol.

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met het aansturen, coachen en ontwikkelen van engineeringteams binnen een complexe technische organisatie.

  • Het vermogen om technische visie, organisatiedoelstellingen en talentontwikkeling succesvol met elkaar te verbinden.

  • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden en een goede beheersing van zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal.

 

Serious Tech
Bij Benchmark werk je voor bedrijven die impact maken met hun innovaties. Zo ontwikkelen we nieuwe producten die de veiligheid of gezondheid verbeteren of juist het gemak vergroten. Dit gehele proces wordt geheel in Almelo uitgevoerd, waar we samenwerken met ongeveer 650 collega’s

 

We werken aan innovaties voor, onder andere, semicon, gezondheidszorg, aerospace en industrie. Van productontwerp tot volumeproductie: het hele proces komt hier samen. Technisch ligt de lat hoog, maar de cultuur blijft nuchter en dichtbij. Je werkt met mensen die verantwoordelijkheid nemen, elkaar helpen en samen willen blijven verbeteren.

 

Seriously you?

As a software engineer for Identity Management products of Canonical, you will modernize and expand the capabilities of the identity management solutions we use for authentication and authorization in our products, as well as our canonical.com and ubuntu.com websites. Your work on Identity Management will directly impact the users of all Canonical products. In addition, you will help write Juju charms to manage operational concerns.

Technical excellence and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to own the design and delivery of the system, facilitate integrations and work with your team on strategy and execution.

Location: This role will be based remotely in the EMEA and AMER regions.

The role entails

  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team, leading technical efforts and discussions
  • Write clean web service APIs to support both CLI and web frontend clients, using Go (Golang) and Python
  • Design and implement new features and enhancements from spec to production and ongoing operations at scale
  • Review code produced by other engineers, helping set quality standards
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
  • Create and enhance management, authentication and authorization API endpoints
  • Craft end-user authentication flows from design to implementation
  • Write Juju charms (operators) to manage operational concerns
  • Modernize the identity stack of our websites and products by driving adoption of best-of-breed IAM technologies
  • Deliver great products that users love by maintaining a culture of quality and engineering excellence
  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks per year for internal and external events

What we are looking for in you

  • You are a staff-level or experienced senior software engineer, with specific experience building identity and access management products
  • You are familiar with the open source software, standards, protocols and concepts in the identity space (e.g. OpenID, OAuth, LDAP)
  • You have experience implementing authorization frameworks in distributed systems
  • You value secure coding and standards, and enjoy working on teams that do the same
  • You are comfortable with Ubuntu as a development and deployment platform

In addition:

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path

raw.jobDescription:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring multiple positions from early-career engineers to experienced architects focused on the different dimensions of dependable software: cybersecurity, quality, and safety.

What does it take to bring the world’s open source software into mission-critical systems? At Canonical, we are driving the engineering discipline needed to build secure, reliable, and high-quality products that our automotive and industrial partners can depend on. Ubuntu is already the world’s most widely used Linux distribution in general; we want to make it the world’s best choice for the automotive and industrial sectors too.

We operate at the boundary between upstream open source innovation and the industrial regulatory realities. Our engineers define the concepts, architectures, processes, verification strategies, and certification artifacts to transform a general-purpose platform into a dependable, certifiable foundation for automotive and industrial compute. This is systems-level engineering at scale, requiring precision, rigor, and a deep understanding of how complex software behaves in constrained, regulated environments.

We are looking for engineers and architects who combine an open source hacker and builder mindset with respect for rigorous, standards-driven engineering. You will work across Canonical engineering teams and with leading industrial partners, helping to build this capability from the ground up and shaping how open source enters the most demanding technical domains.

Location: This is a remote role based in the EMEA region.

The role entails

  • Translate automotive and industrial cybersecurity, quality and safety standards into actionable engineering requirements and perform gap analyses against current capabilities.
  • Drive the creation of structured engineering artifacts, including requirements, traceability models, risk analysis, test strategies, and certification documentation.
  • Collaborate with Canonical engineering teams to align development practices with industrial compliance needs.
  • Design, implement, and execute verification and validation activities required to qualify Ubuntu and other components for regulated environments.
  • Develop and improve automation and tooling to scale traceability, testing, compliance evidence generation, and reporting.
  • Engage with industrial partners to understand their expectations, align external expectations and internal capabilities, and support audits and technical reviews.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of Canonical’s internal processes and standards capability as the team scales.

What we are looking for in you

  • Strong software engineering foundation with experience in developing complex systems on Linux.
  • Professional experience with C, C++, and Python in production environments.
  • Demonstrated experience working within automotive, industrial, or other regulated environments governed by safety, cybersecurity, or quality standards (such as ISO 26262, ISO/SAE 21434, IEC 61508, IEC 62443, SOTIF, or (A)SPICE), and applying them in practice.
  • Experience in system or software architecture, implementation, or verification and validation of complex embedded systems.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce precise technical documentation.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively in a distributed team and engage with industrial partners.

Additional experience that is valuable

  • Contributions to open source projects, particularly in the area of Software Defined Vehicles.
  • Knowledge of Debian packaging.
  • Experience with Rust or safety-critical software development.

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal-opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity we will give your application fair consideration.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!

title: Demo Engineer
description: About this role As Ashby ’s first Demo Engineer, you’ll own the systems that make our demo environments reliable, current, and tailored — the infrastructure the entire go-to-market team leans on to show Ashby at its best. Today, AEs and SEs maintain and configure their own demo accounts by hand. That doesn’t scale: reps lose selling time, demos drift out of date, and every new product release widens the gap between what Ashby can do and what we can actually show live. Your job is to close that gap. This is a net-new role. Right now, the work is split between ad hoc effort and a new set of disposable demo templates the Internal Platform team is building. You’ll own the layer on top of that foundation — customizing and extending those templates, generating realistic demo data, tailoring environments for specific verticals and new markets, and making sure every feature is demoable before it ships. You’ll sit within Solutions Engineering, reporting to the Global Head of Solutions Engineering, and partner closely with Internal Platform and Product teams. Your work will be split roughly 70/30: about 70% owning, customizing, and extending the demo template system and the data and content inside it, and about 30% running demo readiness as a program — release readiness, documentation, and enablement so the GTM team always has current, credible demos to work with. The best person for this job is genuinely hands-on technical — working with internal tools and configuration files, using APIs, and general data preparation — who gets energy from building leverage for a whole team rather than fixing one demo at a time. You could be a great fit if: 🛠 You’re comfortable working in JSON, calling REST / developer APIs, using AI tools, and scripting to configure and customize environments. 🏗 You’re a builder, not just an operator. raw.jobDescription:
About this role

As Ashby’s first Demo Engineer, you’ll own the systems that make our demo environments reliable, current, and tailored — the infrastructure the entire go-to-market team leans on to show Ashby at its best. Today, AEs and SEs maintain and configure their own demo accounts by hand. That doesn’t scale: reps lose selling time, demos drift out of date, and every new product release widens the gap between what Ashby can do and what we can actually show live. Your job is to close that gap.

This is a net-new role. Right now, the work is split between ad hoc effort and a new set of disposable demo templates the Internal Platform team is building. You’ll own the layer on top of that foundation — customizing and extending those templates, generating realistic demo data, tailoring environments for specific verticals and new markets, and making sure every feature is demoable before it ships. You’ll sit within Solutions Engineering, reporting to the Global Head of Solutions Engineering, and partner closely with Internal Platform and Product teams.

Your work will be split roughly 70/30: about 70% owning, customizing, and extending the demo template system and the data and content inside it, and about 30% running demo readiness as a program — release readiness, documentation, and enablement so the GTM team always has current, credible demos to work with.

The best person for this job is genuinely hands-on technical — working with internal tools and configuration files, using APIs, and general data preparation — who gets energy from building leverage for a whole team rather than fixing one demo at a time.

You could be a great fit if:

  • 🛠 You’re comfortable working in JSON, calling REST / developer APIs, using AI tools, and scripting to configure and customize environments.

  • 🏗 You’re a builder, not just an operator. You get energy from creating systems and tooling that make a whole team more effective over time.

  • 🎥 You care deeply about demo quality. You understand what makes a product demo land, and you’re thoughtful about data realism and the narrative a demo needs to support.

  • 🧠 You have strong product intuition and can learn a deeply configurable product quickly, understanding how the different pieces connect.

  • 🔁 You have an iterative mindset. You like testing what works, refining over time, and improving based on what you learn from the field.

  • 🧩 You’re a systems thinker who would rather standardize and automate than manually repeat the same setup.

  • ⚡ You’re comfortable with ambiguity and enjoy a 0→1 role where the infrastructure is still being built around you.

  • 🤝 You partner well cross-functionally — with Engineering and with GTM — and can translate their needs into reliable systems.

  • 💙 You have empathy for the go-to-market teams you support and the Talent Acquisition space they sell into.

Bonus points for:

  • 📊 You’ve built demo environments, demo data, or sandbox/trial environments at a SaaS company before.

  • 🧰 You’ve written automation scripts or tooling to generate data or configure environments at scale.

  • 🎬 You’ve built and maintained a library of reusable, templated environments or assets that others relied on.

  • 🤝 You have experience with HR tech, ATS workflows, or recruiting operations.

Examples of things you’ll work on:

  • 🧱 Own the scaled demo system — customize and extend the demo environment infrastructure to support the GTM team.

  • 🗂 Generate realistic demo data — standardize and automate how demo environments are populated to eliminate manual setup.

  • 🎯 Build vertical- and market-specific demos — create tailored content for target verticals and additional languages as we move upmarket and expand internationally.

  • 🚦 Own demo readiness for new releases — make sure every feature is correctly configured and demoable in demo environments before it ships to GA.

  • 🧪 Stand up trial and sandbox environments — create templated environments prospects can use to test Ashby during the sales cycle.

  • 📚 Document how it all works — maintain clear documentation so the GTM team knows when and how to use each demo environment.

Why become a Demo Engineer at Ashby?

You’ll define a role that doesn’t exist yet. This is a net-new role designed around a real business need. You won’t inherit a mature playbook — you’ll build the infrastructure that lets the whole GTM team demo at a higher level.

Your work will compound. A great live demo helps one deal. A reliable, current, well-documented demo system improves every demo the entire go-to-market team runs. If you like creating leverage, this role has a lot of it.

The product gives you something real to work with. Ashby has strong product-market fit, and that matters here. You’re not manufacturing excitement around a weak product — you’re making it effortless to show something that already resonates when it’s shown well.

You’ll sit at the intersection of Engineering and GTM. This is a rare blend of technical building and understanding what the field actually needs. You’ll help translate our product releases into live deals — and connect the two.

The surface area keeps growing. As we ship new features and expand into new product areas, new verticals, and new geographies, demo needs compound with each release. There is a lot to build, and it only gets more interesting.

Reasons you shouldn’t apply:

  • If you want to be customer-facing or closing deals, this isn’t the right role — the impact here happens behind the scenes.

  • If you’re not genuinely hands-on technical — comfortable in JSON, APIs, and data — the core of this job will be frustrating.

  • If you need a fully built environment and a finished playbook, the ambiguity of a 0→1 role with infrastructure still being built will feel uncomfortable.

  • If continuously maintaining and updating environments as the product changes sounds tedious rather than satisfying, this won’t be a fit.

  • If you’d rather build production product features than internal tooling and demo systems, you’ll likely want a different engineering role.

Interview Process

Our interview process is thorough — we want to make sure this role is the right fit for you and that you’re the right fit for Ashby. Details on the process for this role will be shared by your recruiter.

Benefits

  • You’ll get the time to do things the right way; we put a lot of emphasis on high quality work and avoid quick hacks as much as possible.

  • Sell a product that our customers are truly excited about.

  • Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!

  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby — do it when you feel financially comfortable.

  • $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

About Ashby

We’re building the next generation of recruiting software and we’re starting with a suite of products that helps talent leaders, recruiters, and hiring managers run an efficient and data-driven hiring process.

We are well funded and backed by great investors, including Y Combinator, Elad Gil and Lachy Groom. We have thousands of amazing customers including Snowflake, OpenAI, Shopify, Ramp, Notion, and Zapier (and many others who we cannot name!).

We're in the talent acquisition software business. We run the end-to-end hiring process through our own platform, and ensure a level playing field for all candidates. title: Junior Data Specialist
description: Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business. ABOUT THE ROLE The Jr. Data Specialist is the accuracy backbone of every standard website build. You take scraped, client-provided, and MLS-fed content into our CMS and turn it into a complete, correct, and compliant site — ensuring the site foundation is technically sound before it reaches the design phase. WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR Content Accuracy & Verification Quality Assurance: Review and validate all data for accuracy and completeness before submission or approval. Data Accuracy: Verify names, titles, contact information, addresses, statistics, awards, and credentials against authoritative source materials before entering data. Content Quality: Review all website content for spelling, grammar, punctuation, and formatting accuracy across agent profiles, neighborhood pages, blogs, developments, testimonials, and other client-facing content. Site Data Population Agent Profile Management: Populate and maintain agent profiles by accurately entering biographies, headshots, social media links and display order, email addresses, phone numbers, license numbers, and image alt text. Property Management: Maintain accurate property listings, including MLS synchronization, manually uploaded images, placeholder logos, and functional property links, tours, and videos. Neighborhood & Development Pages: Ensure neighborhood and development pages are complete and accurate, including descriptions, heading structure, hyperlinks, and map boundaries. Content Management: Organize blogs and press content chronologically, remove duplicate testimonials, and keep client logos accurate and up to date. Compliance & Standards Compliance Requirements: Ensure website content complies with applicable state, MLS, and brokerage requirements by implementing required disclosures, licensing information, Realtor® trademark usage, and state-required license numbers. Responsive QA: Verify that all detail pages are fully responsive, visually consistent, and easy to navigate across mobile and tablet devices. Process & Communication Task Management: Own the timely delivery of assigned work by meeting the team's handling-time expectations and maintaining accurate task statuses that reflect current project progress. Self-QA Before Handoff: Complete the DS Self-QA standards before handing work to QA — every source-of-truth request confirmed, compliance checked, data and links verified. Work is not handed off until it is genuinely complete. On-Time Ownership: Own the delivery timeline of your assigned tasks, and resolve QA passbacks promptly so the project keeps moving. Reporting: Flag recurring source errors, missing documentation, or MLS/feed issues to your Team Lead or a Data Specialist/Senior Data Specialist. Raise Risk Early: Communicate workload, dependency, or delivery risk before a deadline is missed — not after. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR Experience 0-1 years of experience with data entry, content management, or web content QA. Extreme precision in proofreading and data mapping. High technical aptitude for learning new CMS logic and property-feed behavior. Familiarity with a CMS/back-end platform (WordPress-like) is a plus Fresh graduates encouraged to apply — training provided Skills & Mindset Meticulous attention to detail and a strong cross-referencing habit Strong written English (spelling, grammar, punctuation) Google searching and Google Apps proficiency Reliable, quick learner, strong work ethic, thinks like an owner Core Values Professionalism – Show up prepared, respectful, and dependable. Ownership – Take responsibility for outcomes and follow through. Communication – Be proactive, transparent, and timely. Collaboration – Work well with others and contribute to team success. Excellence – Deliver high-quality work with attention to detail. Adaptability – Thrive in a fast-paced, remote environment. Integrity – Do the right thing, even when no one is watching. Never mark QA notes or tasks complete before the work is actually implemented. OTHER REQUIREMENTS Must be a Philippine resident Must be willing to work during graveyard hours Must own a laptop or desktop Must have a valid government ID Must have an existing bank account or willing to open one if hired Must have a stable internet connection that is at least 100 mbps and have a back-up connection Must live in area where there is stable power supply that is not interrupted by constant power outages Compensation Additional Information Join us in shaping the future of real estate The real estate industry is in the midst of a seismic shift, and the future belongs to those who break new ground. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the proptech and marketing sectors, Luxury Presence challenges the status quo of what technology can do for real estate agents, leaders, and brokerages. We're a team of agile and tenacious innovators working collaboratively to drive the industry forward. Together, we build game-changing products that empower modern real estate entrepreneurs to dominate their markets. From award-winning web design to agile SEO solutions to cutting-edge AI tools, we deliver tech that anticipates market shifts and keeps our clients ahead of their competition. Founded in 2016 by Stanford Business School alum Malte Kramer, Luxury Presence has grown to a global team ranked on the Inc. 5000 fastest-growing companies list three years in a row. We're backed by world-class investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners, NextEquity Partners, Toba Capital, and Switch Ventures, and have raised $89 million to date. More than 18,000 real estate businesses rely on our platform, including 30% of the Wall Street Journal RealTrends top agents and teams. Additionally, many of the industry's most powerful brokerages rely on Luxury Presence as a trusted business partner. Every year since 2020, Luxury Presence has ranked on BuiltIn's Best Place to Work lists. HousingWire named our founder and CEO a 2024 Tech Trendsetter, we've received several Tech100 Awards, and we just scored an Inman Innovation Award for Best AI-Powered Platform. Luxury Presence is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.

Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Jr. Data Specialist is the accuracy backbone of every standard website build. You take scraped, client-provided, and MLS-fed content into our CMS and turn it into a complete, correct, and compliant site — ensuring the site foundation is technically sound before it reaches the design phase.

WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

Content Accuracy & Verification

  • Quality Assurance: Review and validate all data for accuracy and completeness before submission or approval.

  • Data Accuracy: Verify names, titles, contact information, addresses, statistics, awards, and credentials against authoritative source materials before entering data.

  • Content Quality: Review all website content for spelling, grammar, punctuation, and formatting accuracy across agent profiles, neighborhood pages, blogs, developments, testimonials, and other client-facing content.

Site Data Population

  • Agent Profile Management: Populate and maintain agent profiles by accurately entering biographies, headshots, social media links and display order, email addresses, phone numbers, license numbers, and image alt text.

  • Property Management: Maintain accurate property listings, including MLS synchronization, manually uploaded images, placeholder logos, and functional property links, tours, and videos.

  • Neighborhood & Development Pages: Ensure neighborhood and development pages are complete and accurate, including descriptions, heading structure, hyperlinks, and map boundaries.

  • Content Management: Organize blogs and press content chronologically, remove duplicate testimonials, and keep client logos accurate and up to date.

Compliance & Standards

  • Compliance Requirements: Ensure website content complies with applicable state, MLS, and brokerage requirements by implementing required disclosures, licensing information, Realtor® trademark usage, and state-required license numbers.

  • Responsive QA: Verify that all detail pages are fully responsive, visually consistent, and easy to navigate across mobile and tablet devices.

Process & Communication

  • Task Management: Own the timely delivery of assigned work by meeting the team's handling-time expectations and maintaining accurate task statuses that reflect current project progress.

  • Self-QA Before Handoff: Complete the DS Self-QA standards before handing work to QA — every source-of-truth request confirmed, compliance checked, data and links verified. Work is not handed off until it is genuinely complete.

  • On-Time Ownership: Own the delivery timeline of your assigned tasks, and resolve QA passbacks promptly so the project keeps moving.

  • Reporting: Flag recurring source errors, missing documentation, or MLS/feed issues to your Team Lead or a Data Specialist/Senior Data Specialist.

  • Raise Risk Early: Communicate workload, dependency, or delivery risk before a deadline is missed — not after.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Experience

  • 0-1 years of experience with data entry, content management, or web content QA.

  • Extreme precision in proofreading and data mapping.

  • High technical aptitude for learning new CMS logic and property-feed behavior.

  • Familiarity with a CMS/back-end platform (WordPress-like) is a plus

  • Fresh graduates encouraged to apply — training provided

Skills & Mindset

  • Meticulous attention to detail and a strong cross-referencing habit

  • Strong written English (spelling, grammar, punctuation)

  • Google searching and Google Apps proficiency

  • Reliable, quick learner, strong work ethic, thinks like an owner

Core Values

  • Professionalism – Show up prepared, respectful, and dependable.

  • Ownership – Take responsibility for outcomes and follow through.

  • Communication – Be proactive, transparent, and timely.

  • Collaboration – Work well with others and contribute to team success.

  • Excellence – Deliver high-quality work with attention to detail.

  • Adaptability – Thrive in a fast-paced, remote environment.

  • Integrity – Do the right thing, even when no one is watching. Never mark QA notes or tasks complete before the work is actually implemented.

OTHER REQUIREMENTS

  • Must be a Philippine resident

  • Must be willing to work during graveyard hours

  • Must own a laptop or desktop

  • Must have a valid government ID

  • Must have an existing bank account or willing to open one if hired

  • Must have a stable internet connection that is at least 100 mbps and have a back-up connection

  • Must live in area where there is stable power supply that is not interrupted by constant power outages

Compensation

Additional Information

Join us in shaping the future of real estate

The real estate industry is in the midst of a seismic shift, and the future belongs to those who break new ground. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the proptech and marketing sectors, Luxury Presence challenges the status quo of what technology can do for real estate agents, leaders, and brokerages.

We're a team of agile and tenacious innovators working collaboratively to drive the industry forward. Together, we build game-changing products that empower modern real estate entrepreneurs to dominate their markets. From award-winning web design to agile SEO solutions to cutting-edge AI tools, we deliver tech that anticipates market shifts and keeps our clients ahead of their competition.

Founded in 2016 by Stanford Business School alum Malte Kramer, Luxury Presence has grown to a global team ranked on the Inc. 5000 fastest-growing companies list three years in a row. We're backed by world-class investors, including Bessemer Venture Partners, NextEquity Partners, Toba Capital, and Switch Ventures, and have raised $89 million to date.

More than 18,000 real estate businesses rely on our platform, including 30% of the Wall Street Journal RealTrends top agents and teams. Additionally, many of the industry's most powerful brokerages rely on Luxury Presence as a trusted business partner.

Every year since 2020, Luxury Presence has ranked on BuiltIn's Best Place to Work lists. HousingWire named our founder and CEO a 2024 Tech Trendsetter, we've received several Tech100 Awards, and we just scored an Inman Innovation Award for Best AI-Powered Platform.

Luxury Presence is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.

raw.jobDescription:
About Us_
// At Masabi, we’re driving the fare payment revolution, powering the journeys of millions all over the world. We build fare collection platforms that allow riders to seamlessly buy and present tickets for public transport either on their mobile phones, from a ticket machine, or even by tapping their bank card to travel.

Our Justride platform is used in over 250 locations globally, including some of the largest cities in the world. With our industry-first mobile ticketing SDK, we’ve partnered with large players in the transport space, including Uber, Moovit and Transit.

Your own journey is important to us too. Choosing a role here means joining a network of innovators from all walks of life; a group of passionate individuals who consistently deliver. Here, you’ll find the tools you need to build the career you want. Whether you’re taking the direct route or trying a new path, we’ll support you no matter what.

The Role_

At Masabi, we’re powering the journeys of millions by making public transport payments simple, accessible and seamless.

We’re building our next data platform. Our ticketing, validation and payment services already publish events to Kafka, and over the coming year we’re turning those events into a governed lakehouse on AWS that transit agencies, internal teams and our APIs can query. It will replace our current Elasticsearch-based data store.

You’ll join a small Data team of software engineers who design as well as build: choosing approaches, measuring performance and cost, and writing your choices down. You’ll bring software engineering practices to a data platform, from well-tested services and CI checks to infrastructure as code. What you build will shape how agencies and our own teams use their data.

Location_

This is a fully remote contract role for people based in Romania

Responsibilities_

  • Build and run the services that ingest Kafka topics into Apache Iceberg tables on AWS, including partitioning, compaction, deduplication and backfills of historical data

  • Write clean, well-tested, maintainable code, using AI tools with good judgement, and contribute to code reviews and shared engineering standards

  • Work with the teams that produce the data on data contracts, including Avro schemas with field-level classification, schema evolution rules and the CI checks that enforce them

  • Build privacy and access into the platform: personal data erasure, retention and per-agency access control

  • Build the query layer behind our customer-facing data API, and give others access through Athena

  • Evaluate technical approaches, measure performance and cost, and document the choices you make

  • Migrate existing dashboards, reports and finance extracts onto the new platform

  • Later, build the curated layer of shared metrics and business-ready datasets for BI tools and an AI analytics assistant

About You_

What you’ll need:

  • Solid software engineering fundamentals: you write production code, test it properly and work comfortably with Git and CI pipelines

  • AI fluency: you use AI coding tools daily and check their output carefully, especially for SQL, schema changes and anything that affects data correctness

  • Good SQL and some experience building or running data pipelines, so you’re comfortable working with data from source to query

  • A solid grasp of data modelling

  • Clear, confident communication in written and spoken English

What will help you thrive:

  • Experience running a lakehouse or data warehouse in production

  • Production experience with Kafka and schemas (ideally Avro)

  • Experience handling personal data, including privacy, retention and access control

  • You’re comfortable making design decisions and explaining the trade-offs, in writing as well as in conversation

  • You enjoy working closely with the teams that produce the data, not just the ones that use it

  • Nice to have: JVM experience (Kotlin or Java), Apache Iceberg, Terraform, AWS Lake Formation, DuckDB

We don’t expect you to tick every box. What matters most is curiosity, a willingness to learn, and the motivation to take ownership of your work.

What You’ll Learn_

  • How to build a data platform from the ground up for a global fare payment platform used by transit agencies and millions of riders

  • Hands-on experience with a modern lakehouse stack: Iceberg, Athena, Lake Formation, Kafka and Avro on AWS

  • How to shape technical direction in a small team, where your design choices and write-ups set the standard

  • How to use AI tools well in real engineering work, in a team that encourages them and cares about getting the results right

Our Stack_

  • Java or Kotlin

  • AWS: S3, Apache Iceberg, Athena, Lake Formation (and potentially more query engines)

  • PostgreSQL, DuckDB

  • Kafka with Avro

  • Terraform, GitLab CI

Careers at Masabi are for people going places - driven by a mission to make transit fair and accessible for all.

// We are a network of innovators from all walks of life, passionate about making a difference. At Masabi, we operate with openness and trust, creating an environment where everyone feels empowered to bring their whole, authentic selves to work.

Whoever you are, just be yourself.
// We welcome applications from underrepresented groups, including disabled and neurodivergent people, and can make adjustments at any stage of the process. You’re also welcome to share your pronouns whenever you feel comfortable. Together, we simplify journeys, remove barriers, and improve daily life for millions.

Why Join Masabi?

  • Driven by Purpose – We believe in journeys made simple. The work isn’t always easy, but the best things never are.

  • Encouraged to Accelerate – Masabi is going places and our people are in the driving seat. Whether you’re taking the direct route or exploring new paths, we support your journey.

  • Advancing with Empathy – We put people first and foster a culture of learning, not blame. No matter your cargo, we share the load.

We’re already powering journeys - are you ready to join us?

Sr. Solutions Architect (L6)

The Role

As a Sr. Solutions Architect, you are an expert-level technical leader responsible for the organization's most complex customer engagements. You drive consumption strategy, own executive-level relationships, and serve as the definitive technical authority for your accounts. You have declared your archetype—a recognized technical specialization that makes you a force multiplier across your team and region. You operate at the intersection of deep technical expertise, strategic account planning, and executive influence.

The Impact You Will Have

  • Drive the technical and consumption strategy for the organization's most complex customer engagements, directly influencing platform adoption and revenue growth.
  • Own senior-level technical relationships — serving as a trusted advisor on enterprise data and AI strategy
  • Lead the most complex architecture engagements: multi-workload platforms, enterprise-wide migrations, real-time systems, and AI/ML at scale
  • Operate as an Expert on the Databricks Platform with a declared archetype — actively mentoring others and driving horizontal impact across your team
  • Develop and execute competitive strategies for your customers, positioning Databricks against incumbent and emerging platforms
  • Orchestrate cross-functional teams (DSAs, SSAs, Partners, Product) to deliver enterprise-grade solutions
  • Coach and develop junior SAs (L3–L5) on technical depth, customer engagement, and use case prioritization
  • Contribute to Field Engineering thought leadership through customer-facing content, workshops, and community engagement

What We Look For

  • 8+ years in solutions architecture, principal engineering, technical pre-sales leadership, or a senior customer-facing technical role
  • Expert-level coding proficiency — Python, SQL, and ideally Spark/PySpark. You will complete a live coding assessment and a platform build during the interview
  • Deep expertise in enterprise data architecture: distributed systems at scale, streaming/real-time, lakehouse design patterns, data governance frameworks, and cloud-native platforms
  • Expert-level Databricks Platform knowledge (or equivalent depth in competing platforms with demonstrated rapid learning ability)
  • Declared technical specialization with recognized depth — e.g., real-time architectures, ML/AI platforms, data governance, large-scale migrations, or industry-specific solutions
  • Proven track record of driving consumption growth and platform adoption in large accounts
  • Executive presence — ability to influence Directors, VPs, and C-level stakeholders on long-term data and AI strategy
  • Experience leading competitive displacements and complex enterprise evaluations
  • Strong strategic thinking — connecting technical architecture decisions to business outcomes and revenue impact
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a quantitative discipline (or equivalent experience); advanced degrees are valued

Nice to Have:

  • Databricks certifications
  • Prior experience at Databricks, Snowflake, AWS, Google, Microsoft, or a top-tier data/AI company
  • Published thought leadership (blogs, conference talks, open source contributions)
  • Industry vertical expertise with executive-level domain credibility

Interview Process: Recruiter Screen → Hiring Manager Screen → Design and Architecture Interview → Live Coding Assessment → Build, Demo, Pitch! Presentation → Reference Check

Pay Range Transparency

Databricks is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The pay range(s) for this role is listed below and represents the expected salary range for non-commissionable roles or on-target earnings for commissionable roles. Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to job-related skills, depth of experience, relevant certifications and training, and specific work location. Based on the factors above, Databricks anticipates utilizing the full width of the range. The total compensation package for this position may also include eligibility for annual performance bonus, equity, and the benefits listed above. For more information regarding which range your location is in visit our page here.

Local Pay Range

$219,100—$301,300 USD

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

raw.jobDescription:
The Role

As a Sr. Solutions Architect, you are an expert-level technical leader responsible for the most complex strategic customer engagements within the Digital Native Business. You drive consumption strategy, own executive-level relationships, and serve as the definitive technical authority for your accounts. You have declared your archetype—a recognized technical specialization that makes you a force multiplier across your team and region. You operate at the intersection of deep technical expertise, strategic account planning, and executive influence.

The Impact You Will Have

  • Drive the technical and consumption strategy for the organization's most complex customer engagements, directly influencing platform adoption and revenue growth.
  • Own senior-level technical relationships — serving as a trusted advisor on enterprise data and AI strategy
  • Lead the most complex architecture engagements: multi-workload platforms, enterprise-wide migrations, real-time systems, and AI/ML at scale
  • Operate as an Expert on the Databricks Platform with a declared archetype — actively mentoring others and driving horizontal impact across your team
  • Develop and execute competitive strategies for your customers, positioning Databricks against incumbent and emerging platforms
  • Orchestrate cross-functional teams (DSAs, SSAs, Partners, Product) to deliver enterprise-grade solutions
  • Coach and develop junior SAs (L3–L5) on technical depth, customer engagement, and use case prioritization
  • Contribute to Field Engineering thought leadership through customer-facing content, workshops, and community engagement

What We Look For

  • 8+ years in solutions architecture, principal engineering, technical pre-sales leadership, or a senior customer-facing technical role
  • Expert-level coding proficiency — Python, SQL, and ideally Spark/PySpark. You will complete a live coding assessment and a platform build during the interview
  • Deep expertise in enterprise data architecture: distributed systems at scale, streaming/real-time, lakehouse design patterns, data governance frameworks, and cloud-native platforms
  • Expert-level Databricks Platform knowledge (or equivalent depth in competing platforms with demonstrated rapid learning ability)
  • Declared technical specialization with recognized depth — e.g., real-time architectures, ML/AI platforms, data governance, large-scale migrations, or industry-specific solutions
  • Proven track record of driving consumption growth and platform adoption in large accounts
  • Executive presence — ability to influence Directors, VPs, and C-level stakeholders on long-term data and AI strategy
  • Experience leading competitive displacements and complex enterprise evaluations
  • Strong strategic thinking — connecting technical architecture decisions to business outcomes and revenue impact
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a quantitative discipline (or equivalent experience); advanced degrees are valued

Nice to Have:

  • Databricks certifications
  • Prior experience at Databricks, Snowflake, AWS, Google, Microsoft, or a top-tier data/AI company
  • Published thought leadership (blogs, conference talks, open source contributions)
  • Strategic account expertise with executive-level domain credibility

Interview Process: Recruiter Screen → Hiring Manager Screen → Design and Architecture Interview → Live Coding Assessment → Build, Demo, Pitch! Presentation → Reference Check

Pay Range Transparency

Databricks is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The pay range(s) for this role is listed below and represents the expected salary range for non-commissionable roles or on-target earnings for commissionable roles. Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to job-related skills, depth of experience, relevant certifications and training, and specific work location. Based on the factors above, Databricks anticipates utilizing the full width of the range. The total compensation package for this position may also include eligibility for annual performance bonus, equity, and the benefits listed above. For more information regarding which range your location is in visit our page here.

Local Pay Range

$219,100—$301,300 USD

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

Benefits

At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

Compliance

If access to export-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.

title: Embedded AI Engineer, On-Device Models
description: Company Overview Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram. Company Operating Rhythm At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance. Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do. Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5. About the Role Deepgram's speech models are among the fastest and most accurate in the world, and we have deep machinery for running them on NVIDIA GPUs. Our customers need them on everything else: non-NVIDIA accelerators, embedded SoCs, mobile application processors, DSPs and NPUs, and purpose-built devices with tight memory, compute, thermal, and power budgets. When a target platform's standard kernels and runtime can't run a Deepgram model well enough, someone has to go below them. That is this role. As an Embedded AI Engineer on the Partner Platform Engineering team, you work at the lowest layer of our edge stack. You write and optimize custom kernels and operators for specific hardware, collapse models onto device-specific execution units, and do the target-side quantization and assembly-level tuning that standard toolchains can't. You hand what you build up to Applied ML Engineers, who fit Deepgram models to your kernels. Your work is what makes a new hardware platform viable for Deepgram at all. This role is a great fit for a senior embedded engineer who has spent their career close to the metal and wants to point that at speech AI, or a staff-level engineer who wants to define how Deepgram's models get onto new silicon. We'll set the level to your experience. What You'll Do Write and optimize custom kernels and operators (C, C++, Rust, and platform assembly or intrinsics) for non-NVIDIA accelerators, embedded SoCs, DSPs, and NPUs where the vendor's standard operator set is insufficient for Deepgram models. Own target-side optimization: collapse models onto device execution units through quantization, operator fusion, memory layout, and architecture-specific compilation to meet latency, memory, power, and thermal budgets. Integrate with vendor NPU/DSP toolchains and edge inference runtimes, and extend them with custom operators when the graph doesn't map cleanly. Deliver kernels and runtime components as reusable building blocks that Applied ML Engineers can target when adapting models, with clear interfaces and documented constraints. Build performance-critical runtime code for embedded environments, including embedded Linux, bare-metal, and RTOS targets. Establish per-platform benchmarking and validation for latency, accuracy, power, memory footprint, and utilization, and catch regressions before they ship. Partner with silicon and platform vendors on SDK integration and low-level performance tuning for new chipsets and reference platforms. Feed hardware constraints back to Applied ML and Research so model designs are easier to land on constrained targets. You'll Love This Role If You Find deep satisfaction in making a large model run on hardware that was never meant to run it, and still hitting accuracy and latency targets. Reach for the profiler and the ISA manual before you reach for a bigger chip. Would rather write the kernel than wait for the vendor to ship it. Care about the details that don't show up in a cloud benchmark: cold start, power draw, thermals, memory fragmentation, cache behavior. Prefer hard, constrained, ship-it problems over open-ended research. Care about the details that don't show up in a cloud benchmark: cold-start time, power draw, thermals, and memory fragmentation. It's Important To Us That You Have Experience delivering production systems on resource-constrained hardware — embedded systems, mobile, edge AI, or small low-power devices. Strong proficiency in C, C++, and/or Rust, with experience writing performance-critical code for constrained environments. Hands-on experience with model optimization for on-device deployment, including quantization, pruning, knowledge distillation, or architecture-specific compilation. Familiarity with edge inference runtimes (e.g., ONNX Runtime, TensorRT, TFLite, ExecuTorch) and/or vendor-specific NPU/DSP toolchains. A strong understanding of hardware-software interaction — CPU/GPU/NPU/DSP architectures, memory hierarchies, fixed-point/integer arithmetic, and power management — and how they affect inference performance. Experience working close to the metal: bare-metal or RTOS environments (e.g., FreeRTOS, Zephyr), embedded Linux, or microcontroller and edge SoC development. Strong communication skills and a builder mindset — you can scope an ambiguous optimization problem, drive it to a measurable result, and explain the tradeoffs clearly. It Would Be Great if You Had Experience with real-time audio processing on embedded platforms — DSP pipelines, audio codec optimization, wake-word or always-on listening, or streaming inference on microcontrollers and edge SoCs. Depth in ML optimization techniques — custom quantization schemes, mixed-precision inference, or neural architecture search for edge targets. Background in hardware evaluation and benchmarking — systematically comparing accelerators, SoCs, or GPUs for specific workload profiles. Experience shipping AI features in consumer products at scale, and the instinct for what "production quality" means on a battery-powered device. Familiarity with model compilation and optimization toolchains and their tradeoffs across hardware targets. Experience with secure, robust on-device deployment practices — code signing, encrypted model storage, and safe update mechanisms. Notice : We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @ deepgram.com email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.

This is not a research role and not a cloud-serving role. It is applied ML for edge deployment. It is a great fit for a senior engineer who has already shipped models to non-GPU or edge hardware and wants to do it across many platforms, or a staff-level engineer who wants to define how Deepgram ports speech models to new hardware.   • Port Deepgram speech models to non-NVIDIA and edge platforms, adapting model structure and parameters so they run within the target's existing operator set, runtime, and kernels with minimal modification.

  • Own serving-side model decisions for edge targets: quantization and precision choices, operator substitution, graph rewrites, and architecture tweaks that fit a model to a device's constraints while holding accuracy and latency.

  • Validate every port on real hardware: build accuracy, latency, throughput, and memory benchmarks per platform, and catch regressions before a customer does.

  • Have already fought to get a model running on hardware that wasn't built for it, and want to do that across many platforms.

  • Prefer changing the model to fit the hardware over changing the hardware to fit the model, and know when each is the right call.

  • Like being the bridge between the team writing kernels and the team training models.

  • Comfort building automation around model conversion and deployment.

  • A builder mindset and clear communication: you can scope a port on an unfamiliar platform and drive it to a measured result.

  • Experience with speech, audio, or streaming/real-time models specifically.

  • Exposure to writing or reading low-level kernels (CUDA, Metal, NEON, or vendor DSP code), enough to collaborate closely with embedded engineers.

  • Experience with model security or integrity on deployed devices: signing, encrypted model storage, safe updates.

  • Familiarity with several accelerator families (Qualcomm, Apple, ARM, Intel, AMD, or custom NPUs) and their quirks.

title: Senior Devops Engineer (Interim)
description:
Bouw aan mission-critical technologie op grote schaal
Bij Schuberg Philis zijn we gespecialiseerd in het leveren van mission-critical IT-oplossingen die de bedrijfsvoering van onze klanten ondersteunen, met betrouwbaarheid en uitmuntendheid in elke laag. Onze toewijding aan kwaliteit en innovatie drijft ons om op zoek te gaan naar een Senior Devops engineerr met een passie voor het bouwen van robuuste en efficiënte systemen die essentieel zijn voor het succes van onze klanten. Door deel uit te maken van ons team speel je een rol in het vormgeven van de toekomst van kritieke digitale infrastructuren, waarbij je gebruikmaakt van de geavanceerde mogelijkheden om complexe uitdagingen op te lossen en grenzen te verleggen in veeleisende omgevingen.

De opdracht:

Je wordt technisch verantwoordelijk voor de end-to-end software release pipeline voor een platform dat uiteindelijk softwaredistributie naar circa 8 miljoen devices ondersteunt.
De omgeving is nog volop in ontwikkeling. Je krijgt daarom veel verantwoordelijkheid voor het ontwerpen, bouwen en professionaliseren van de release-, test- en deploymentketen.


Belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden:
 
  • Ontwerpen en operationaliseren van een end-to-end release-, test- en deploymentketen.
  • Ontwerpen en verbeteren van GitHub Actions Workflows voor build, test, validatie, gates en gecontroleerde releases.
  • Inrichten en professionaliseren van de AWS-omgeving, CI/CD en repositorystructuur.
  • Borgen van software supply-chain security, waaronder SBOM, signing, vulnerability scanning en traceerbaarheid.
  • Architectuur vertalen naar concrete technische ontwerpen en werkpakketten.
  • Integraties realiseren met testomgevingen, repositories en PKI/key management.
  • Samenbrengen van engineering, security, testing, operations en externe leveranciers.


Gewenste ervaring:

We zoeken een hands-on senior engineer/technical lead met sterke ervaring in:

  • AWS
  • GitHub & GitHub Actions
  • CI/CD en Infrastructure as Code
  • Linux en runners
  • Release- en deployment automation
  • Artifact- en containerrepositories, bijvoorbeeld Sonatype Nexus
  • Software supply-chain security
  • Technische architectuur en platform engineering
  • Technische aansturing van engineers

Ervaring met PKI, KMS/HSM, containers, embedded software, Yocto, OTA-updates, IoT/device management of hardware-in-the-loop testing is een sterke pré.

Everyone we work with and consider working with has a right to equal treatment. The hiring and appraisal process at Schuberg Philis is designed to be thorough and equitable, implementing fair payment, benefits, and opportunities across all demographics. 
 
It is our desire to be a company that brings together multiple nationalities, cultures, religions, genders, abilities, and talents within and across our teams. We welcome colleagues from diverse backgrounds to join Schuberg Philis and actively support diversity and inclusion in the tech industry.
